   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Functional Programming Primitives v3.0
   3| | * Zero-dependency utility belt. All functions are pure, curried, and total.
   4| | * Enhanced with Result monad, Task, and pipe composition.
   5| | */
   7| |import memoizee from "memoizee";
   8| |import pRetry from "p-retry";
   9| |import pTimeout, { TimeoutError } from "p-timeout";
  10| |import justDebounce from "just-debounce";
  11| |import justThrottle from "just-throttle";
  12| |import { dequal } from "dequal";
  16|▼|export const pipe =
  17| |  <A>(a: A) =>
  18| |  <B>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>): B =>
  19| |    fns.reduce((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a) as unknown as B;
  21|▼|export const compose =
  22| |  <A>(...fns: Array<(x: any) => any>) =>
  23| |  (a: A) =>
  24| |    fns.reduceRight((acc: any, fn) => fn(acc), a);
  26|▼|export const flow =
  27| |  <A extends any[], B>(...fns: Array<(...args: any[]) => any>) =>
  28| |  (...args: A): B =>
  29| |    fns.reduce(
  30| |      (acc, fn, i) => (i === 0 ? fn(...args) : fn(acc)),
  31| |      undefined as any
  32| |    ) as B;
  33| |// ============================================================================
  34| |// Array Operations (Pure)
  35| |// ============================================================================
  37|▼|export const map = <T, U>(fn: (x: T, i: number) => U) => (arr: readonly T[]): U[] =>
  38| |  arr.map(fn);
  40|▼|export const filter = <T>(fn: (x: T, i: number) => boolean) => (arr: readonly T[]): T[] =>
  41| |  arr.filter(fn);
  43|▼|export const reduce = <T, U>(fn: (acc: U, x: T, i: number) => U, init: U) => (arr: readonly T[]): U =>
  44| |  arr.reduce(fn, init);
  46|▼|export const flatMap = <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => readonly U[]) => (arr: readonly T[]): U[] =>
  47| |  arr.flatMap(fn);
  49|▼|export const find = <T>(fn: (x: T) => boolean) => (arr: readonly T[]): T | undefined =>
  50| |  arr.find(fn);
  52|▼|export const some = <T>(fn: (x: T) => boolean) => (arr: readonly T[]): boolean =>
  53| |  arr.some(fn);
  55|▼|export const every = <T>(fn: (x: T) => boolean) => (arr: readonly T[]): boolean =>
  56| |  arr.every(fn);
  58|▼|export const groupBy = <T, K extends string | number>(keyFn: (x: T) => K) => (arr: readonly T[]): Map<K, T[]> => {
  59| |  const map = new Map<K, T[]>();
  60| |  for (const item of arr) {
  61| |    const key = keyFn(item);
  62| |    const existing = map.get(key);
  63| |    if (existing) existing.push(item);
  64| |    else map.set(key, [item]);
  65| |  }
  66| |  return map;
  67| |};
  69|▼|export const toMap = <T, K>(keyFn: (x: T) => K) => (arr: readonly T[]): Map<K, T> => {
  70| |  const map = new Map<K, T>();
  71| |  for (const item of arr) map.set(keyFn(item), item);
  72| |  return map;
  73| |};
  75|▼|export const sortBy = <T>(compare: (a: T, b: T) => number) => (arr: readonly T[]): T[] =>
  76| |  [...arr].sort(compare);
  78|▼|export const partition = <T>(fn: (x: T) => boolean) => (arr: readonly T[]): [T[], T[]] => {
  79| |  const pass: T[] = [];
  80| |  const fail: T[] = [];
  81| |  for (const item of arr) (fn(item) ? pass : fail).push(item);
  82| |  return [pass, fail];
  83| |};
  85|▼|export const unique = <T>(arr: readonly T[]): T[] => [...new Set(arr)];
  87|▼|export const chunk = <T>(size: number) => (arr: readonly T[]): T[][] => {
  88| |  const result: T[][] = [];
  89| |  for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i += size) result.push(arr.slice(i, i + size) as T[]);
  90| |  return result;
  91| |};
  93|▼|export const zip = <A, B>(a: readonly A[], b: readonly B[]): [A, B][] =>
  94| |  a.map((x, i) => [x, b[i]!] as [A, B]);
  96| |// ============================================================================
  97| |// Object Operations (Pure)
  98| |// ============================================================================
 100|▼|export const pick = <T extends object, K extends keyof T>(...keys: K[]) => (obj: T): Pick<T, K> => {
 101| |  const result = {} as Pick<T, K>;
 102| |  for (const key of keys) if (key in obj) result[key] = obj[key];
 103| |  return result;
 104| |};
 106|▼|export const omit = <T extends object, K extends keyof T>(...keys: K[]) => (obj: T): Omit<T, K> => {
 107| |  const result = { ...obj };
 108| |  for (const key of keys) delete result[key];
 109| |  return result as Omit<T, K>;
 110| |};
 112|▼|export const merge = <T extends object>(...sources: Partial<T>[]) => (target: T): T =>
 113| |  Object.assign({}, target, ...sources);
 115| |export const mergeDeep = <T extends Record<string, any>>(target: T, source: Partial<T>): T => {
 116| |  const output = { ...target };
 117| |  for (const key of Object.keys(source)) {
 118| |    const sv = source[key as keyof T];
 119| |    const tv = target[key as keyof T];
 120| |    if (sv && typeof sv === "object" && !Array.isArray(sv) && tv && typeof tv === "object" && !Array.isArray(tv)) {
 121| |      (output as any)[key] = mergeDeep(tv as any, sv as any);
 122| |    } else if (sv !== undefined) {
 123| |      (output as any)[key] = sv;
 124| |    }
 125| |  }
 126| |  return output;
 127| |};
 129|▼|export const entries = <T extends object>(obj: T): [keyof T, T[keyof T]][] =>
 130| |  Object.entries(obj) as any;
 132|▼|export const fromEntries = <K extends string, V>(entries: [K, V][]): Record<K, V> =>
 133| |  Object.fromEntries(entries) as Record<K, V>;
 135| |// ============================================================================
 136| |// Side-Effect Management
 137| |// ============================================================================
 139|▼|export const tap = <T>(fn: (x: T) => void) => (x: T): T => { fn(x); return x; };
 140|▼|export const id = <T>(x: T): T => x;
 141|▼|export const constant = <T>(x: T) => (): T => x;
 142|▼|export const noop = (): void => {};
 144| |// ============================================================================
 145| |// Result Monad (Error handling without exceptions)
 146| |// ============================================================================
 148|▼|export type Result<T, E = string> =
 149| |  | { readonly ok: true; readonly value: T }
 150| |  | { readonly ok: false; readonly error: E };
 152|▼|export const ok = <T>(value: T): Result<T, never> => ({ ok: true, value });
 153|▼|export const err = <E>(error: E): Result<never, E> => ({ ok: false, error });
 155| |export const isOk = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: true; value: T } => r.ok;
 156| |export const isErr = <T, E>(r: Result<T, E>): r is { ok: false; error: E } => !r.ok;
 158|▼|export const unwrapOr = <T>(fallback: T) => (r: Result<T>): T =>
 159| |  r.ok ? r.value : fallback;
 161|▼|export const unwrapOrElse = <T, E>(fn: (e: E) => T) => (r: Result<T, E>): T =>
 162| |  r.ok ? r.value : fn(r.error);
 164|▼|export const mapResult = <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) => <E>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
 165| |  r.ok ? ok(fn(r.value)) : r;
 167|▼|export const flatMapResult = <T, U, E>(fn: (x: T) => Result<U, E>) => (r: Result<T, E>): Result<U, E> =>
 168| |  r.ok ? fn(r.value) : r;
 170|▼|export const mapErr = <E, F>(fn: (e: E) => F) => <T>(r: Result<T, E>): Result<T, F> =>
 171| |  r.ok ? r : err(fn(r.error));
 173|▼|export const tryCatch = <T>(fn: () => T): Result<T, unknown> => {
 174| |  try { return ok(fn()); }
 175|!|  catch (error) { return err(error); }
 176| |};
 178|▼|export const tryCatchAsync = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<Result<T, unknown>> => {
 179| |  try { return ok(await fn()); }
 180|!|  catch (error) { return err(error); }
 181| |};
 183|▼|export const tryCatchOr = <T>(fallback: T, fn: () => T): T => {
 184| |  try { return fn(); }
 185| |  catch { return fallback; }
 186| |};
 188| |// ============================================================================
 189| |// Task (Lazy async computation)
 190| |// ============================================================================
 192|▼|export type Task<T> = () => Promise<T>;
 194|▼|export const taskMap = <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => U) => (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
 195| |  async () => fn(await task());
 197|▼|export const taskChain = <T, U>(fn: (x: T) => Task<U>) => (task: Task<T>): Task<U> =>
 198| |  async () => fn(await task())();
 200|▼|export const taskFromResult = <T>(value: T): Task<T> => async () => value;
 202| |// ============================================================================
 203| |// Predicate & Comparison
 204| |// ============================================================================
 206|▼|export const not = <T>(fn: (x: T) => boolean) => (x: T): boolean => !fn(x);
 207|▼|export const and = <T>(...fns: ((x: T) => boolean)[]) => (x: T): boolean => fns.every(fn => fn(x));
 208|▼|export const or = <T>(...fns: ((x: T) => boolean)[]) => (x: T): boolean => fns.some(fn => fn(x));
 210|▼|export const equals = <T>(a: T) => (b: T): boolean => a === b;
 211|▼→|export const deepEquals = (a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean => dequal(a, b);
 213| |// ============================================================================
 214| |// String Utilities
 215| |// ============================================================================
 217|▼|export const capitalize = (s: string): string => s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
 218|▼|export const camelCase = (s: string): string => s.replace(/[-_\s]+(.)?/g, (_, c) => c ? c.toUpperCase() : "");
 219|▼|export const kebabCase = (s: string): string => s.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1-$2").toLowerCase();
 220|▼|export const snakeCase = (s: string): string => s.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2").toLowerCase();
 222| |// ============================================================================
 223| |// Number Utilities
 224| |// ============================================================================
 226|▼|export const clamp = (min: number, max: number) => (n: number): number =>
 227| |  Math.min(Math.max(n, min), max);
 229|▼|export const range = (start: number, end: number, step = 1): number[] => {
 230| |  const result: number[] = [];
 231| |  for (let i = start; i < end; i += step) result.push(i);
 232| |  return result;
 233| |};
 235| |// ============================================================================
 236| |// Async Utilities
 237| |// ============================================================================
 239|▼|export const delay = (ms: number): Task<void> =>
 240| |  () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
 242|▼|export const retry =
 243| |  <T>(attempts: number, delayMs = 0) =>
 244| |  (fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> =>
 245| |    pRetry(fn, {
 246| |      retries: Math.max(0, attempts - 1),
 247| |      factor: 1,
 248| |      minTimeout: delayMs,
 249| |      maxTimeout: delayMs,
 250| |      randomize: false,
 251| |    });
 253|▼|export const memoize = <A extends any[], R>(
 254| |  fn: (...args: A) => R
 255| |): ((...args: A) => R) =>
 256|→|  memoizee(fn, {
 257| |    normalizer: (args: A) => JSON.stringify(args),
 258| |    maxAge: 10 * 60 * 1000,
 259| |  }) as (...args: A) => R;
 262|▼|export const debounce = <A extends any[]>(
 263| |  ms: number,
 264| |  fn: (...args: A) => void
 265| |) => justDebounce(fn, ms);
 268|▼|export const throttle = <A extends any[]>(
 269| |  ms: number,
 270| |  fn: (...args: A) => void
 271| |) => justThrottle(fn, ms);

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Structured Logger
   3| | * All side-effecting I/O is centralized here. Compiler phases receive a Logger
   4| | * interface and remain pure except for logging calls.
   5| | */
   7|▼|export interface Logger {
   8| |  debug(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
   9| |  info(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  10| |  warn(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  11| |  error(msg: string, meta?: Record<string, unknown>): void;
  12| |  /** Time a phase and log duration. */
  13| |  time<T>(label: string, fn: () => T): T;
  14| |}
  16| |/** No-op logger for tests and silent mode. */
  17| |export const silentLogger: Logger = {
  18| |  debug: () => {},
  19| |  info: () => {},
  20| |  warn: () => {},
  21| |  error: () => {},
  22| |  time: (_, fn) => fn(),
  23| |};
  25| |/** Console logger with emoji prefixes and structured metadata. */
  26|▼|export const consoleLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  27| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  28| |    if (verbose) console.log(`[debug] ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  29| |  },
  30| |  info(msg, meta) {
  31| |    console.log(`ℹ️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  32| |  },
  33| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  34| |    console.warn(`⚠️  ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  35| |  },
  36| |  error(msg, meta) {
  37| |    console.error(`❌ ${msg}`, meta ?? "");
  38| |  },
  39| |  time(label, fn) {
  40| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  41| |    const result = fn();
  42| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  43| |    console.log(`⏱️  ${label} completed in ${elapsed}ms`);
  44| |    return result;
  45| |  },
  46| |});
  48| |/** Enterprise-grade JSON logger for CI/CD pipelines. */
  49|▼|export const jsonLogger = (verbose = false): Logger => ({
  50| |  debug(msg, meta) {
  51| |    if (verbose) console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "debug", msg, ...meta }));
  52| |  },
  53| |  info(msg, meta) {
  54| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "info", msg, ...meta }));
  55| |  },
  56| |  warn(msg, meta) {
  57| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "warn", msg, ...meta }));
  58| |  },
  59| |  error(msg, meta) {
  60| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "error", msg, ...meta }));
  61| |  },
  62| |  time(label, fn) {
  63| |    const t0 = performance.now();
  64| |    const result = fn();
  65| |    const elapsed = (performance.now() - t0).toFixed(2);
  66| |    console.log(JSON.stringify({ level: "metric", phase: label, durationMs: parseFloat(elapsed) }));
  67| |    return result;
  68| |  },
  69| |});

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Flux Compiler Type System
   3| | * All types are immutable interfaces (readonly) where possible.
   4| | * No implementation here — pure contracts.
   5| | */
   7| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   8| |// HTTP & Routing

>src/compiler/utils/hash.ts
e:fnv1a|computeSignatureHash|segmentHash|canUseDenseArray|generatePerfectHash
f:fnv1a(str: string):number
f:computeSignatureHash(methodIdx: number, path: string):number
f:segmentHash(seg: string):number
f:canUseDenseArray(hashes: readonly number[]):boolean
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Hash Utilities
   3| | * Pure functions for FNV-1a, signature hashing, segment hashing, and
   4| | * perfect hash generation. No side effects. No mutations.
   5| | */
   7| |/** FNV-1a 32-bit hash. Pure. */
   8|▼|export const fnv1a = (str: string): number => {
   9| |  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  10| |  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
  11| |    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
  12| |    hash += (hash << 1) + (hash << 4) + (hash << 7) + (hash << 8) + (hash << 24);
  13| |  }
  14| |  return hash >>> 0;
  15| |};
  17| |/**
  18| | * Combine method index (3 bits) + path hash (29 bits) into single u32.
  19| | * Method indices: GET=0, POST=1, PUT=2, PATCH=3, DELETE=4, HEAD=5, OPTIONS=6, ALL=7
  20| | */
  21|▼|export const computeSignatureHash = (methodIdx: number, path: string): number => {
  22| |  const pathHash = fnv1a(path);
  23| |  return ((methodIdx & 0x07) << 29) | (pathHash >>> 3);
  24| |};
  26| |/** DJB2-style segment hash for trie node comparison. Pure. */
  27|▼|export const segmentHash = (seg: string): number => {
  28| |  let h = 5381;
  29| |  for (let i = 0; i < seg.length; i++) {
  30| |    h = ((h << 5) + h) + seg.charCodeAt(i); // h * 33 + c
  31| |    h |= 0;
  32| |  }
  33| |  return h >>> 0;
  34| |};
  36| |/**
  37| | * Check if a set of hashes can use a dense array strategy.
  38| | * Dense is viable when hash range < 3x count (space vs time tradeoff).
  39| | */
  40|▼|export const canUseDenseArray = (hashes: readonly number[]): boolean => {
  41| |  if (hashes.length === 0) return false;
  42| |  const min = Math.min(...hashes);
  43| |  const max = Math.max(...hashes);
  44| |  return (max - min) < hashes.length * 3;
  45| |};
  47| |/**
  48| | * Generate a perfect hash function for small static sets (≤100 items).
  49| | * Uses brute-force seed search. Returns null if no seed found.
  50| | * Pure — no mutation of input.
  51| | */
  52| |export const generatePerfectHash = (
  53| |  hashes: readonly number[]
  54| |): { readonly g: readonly number[]; readonly v: readonly number[] } | null => {
  55| |  if (hashes.length === 0 || hashes.length > 100) return null;
  56| |  const n = hashes.length;
  57| |  const seen = new Set<number>();
  58| |  for (const h of hashes) {
  59| |    if (seen.has(h)) return null; // collisions in input make perfect hash impossible
  60| |    seen.add(h);
  61| |  }
  63| |  for (let seed = 0; seed < 1000; seed++) {
  64| |    const buckets = new Map<number, number>();
  65| |    let ok = true;
  66| |    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  67| |      const idx = ((hashes[i]! + seed) % n + n) % n;
  68| |      if (buckets.has(idx)) { ok = false; break; }
  69| |      buckets.set(idx, i);
  70| |    }
  71| |    if (ok) return { g: [seed], v: hashes };
  72| |  }
  73| |  return null;
  74| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Lazy body parsing for production performance.
   3| | *
   4| | * Body parsing is deferred until actually needed.
   5| | * Uses Bun-native parsers:
   6| | * - req.json()
   7| | * - req.text()
   8| | * - req.formData()
   9| | * - req.arrayBuffer()
  10| | */
  12|▼|export class BodyParseError extends Error {
  13| |  constructor(
  14| |    message: string,
  15| |    public status = 400
  16| |  ) {
  17| |    super(message);
  18| |    this.name = "BodyParseError";
  19| |  }
  20| |}
  22|▼|export interface LazyBodyOptions {
  23| |  maxJsonBytes?: number;
  24| |  maxTextBytes?: number;
  25| |  maxFormBytes?: number;
  26| |  maxFileBytes?: number;
  27| |}
  29|▼|type BodyKind =
  30| |  | "none"
  31| |  | "json"
  32| |  | "text"
  33| |  | "formData"
  34| |  | "arrayBuffer"
  35| |  | "blob";
  37|▼|export interface LazyBody {
  38| |  (): Promise<unknown>;
  40| |  json<T = unknown>(): Promise<T>;
  41| |  text(): Promise<string>;
  42| |  form(): Promise<Record<string, string>>;
  43| |  multipart(): Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  44| |  formData(): Promise<FormData>;
  46| |  file(name?: string): Promise<File | null>;
  47| |  files(name?: string): Promise<File[]>;
  49| |  arrayBuffer(): Promise<ArrayBuffer>;
  50| |  blob(): Promise<Blob>;
  52| |  /**
  53| |   * Returns the raw request stream if the body has not been consumed.
  54| |   * Useful for proxying or streaming uploads downstream.
  55| |   */
  56| |  stream(): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null;
  58| |  readonly consumed: boolean;
  59| |  readonly parsed: unknown;
  60| |}
  62| |const DEFAULT_LIMITS = {
  63| |  maxJsonBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  64| |  maxTextBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  65| |  maxFormBytes: 2 * 1024 * 1024,
  66| |  maxFileBytes: 20 * 1024 * 1024,
  67| |};
  69|▼|function formDataToRecord(fd: FormData): Record<string, string> {
  70| |  const out: Record<string, string> = {};
  72| |  for (const [key, value] of fd) {
  73| |    if (typeof value === "string") {
  74| |      out[key] = value;
  75| |    } else {
  76| |      // For files, expose filename in form record.
  77| |      out[key] = value.name;
  78| |    }
  79| |  }
  81| |  return out;
  82| |}
  84|▼|function formDataToObject(fd: FormData): Record<string, unknown> {
  85| |  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  87| |  for (const [key, value] of fd) {
  88| |    const existing = out[key];
  90| |    if (existing === undefined) {
  91| |      out[key] = value;
  92| |    } else if (Array.isArray(existing)) {
  93| |      existing.push(value);
  94| |    } else {
  95| |      out[key] = [existing, value];
  96| |    }
  97| |  }
  99| |  return out;
 100| |}
 102|▼|export function createLazyBody(
 103| |  req: Request,
 104| |  opts: LazyBodyOptions = {}
 105| |): LazyBody {
 106| |  const limits = {
 107| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxJsonBytes,
 108| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxTextBytes,
 109| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFormBytes,
 110| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? DEFAULT_LIMITS.maxFileBytes,
 111| |  };
 113| |  let kind: BodyKind = "none";
 114| |  let value: unknown;
 116| |  let pending: Promise<unknown> | null = null;
 117| |  let pendingKind: BodyKind | null = null;
 119|▼|  function assertSize(max?: number): void {
 120| |    if (!max) return;
 122| |    const len = Number(req.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
 123| |    if (Number.isFinite(len) && len > max) {
 124|!|      throw new BodyParseError("Payload too large", 413);
 125| |    }
 126| |  }
 128|▼|  function convert<T>(target: BodyKind): T {
 129| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 131| |    if (kind === "json") {
 132| |      const text = JSON.stringify(value);
 134| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 135| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 136| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 137| |      }
 138| |      if (target === "blob") {
 139| |        return new Blob([text], { type: "application/json" }) as T;
 140| |      }
 141| |    }
 143| |    if (kind === "text") {
 144| |      const text = value as string;
 146| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 147| |      if (target === "arrayBuffer") {
 148| |        return new TextEncoder().encode(text).buffer as T;
 149| |      }
 150| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([text]) as T;
 152| |      if (target === "formData") {
 153| |        const fd = new FormData();
 154| |        new URLSearchParams(text).forEach((v, k) => fd.append(k, v));
 155| |        return fd as T;
 156| |      }
 157| |    }
 159| |    if (kind === "arrayBuffer") {
 160| |      const buf = value as ArrayBuffer;
 161| |      const text = new TextDecoder().decode(buf);
 163| |      if (target === "text") return text as T;
 164| |      if (target === "json") return JSON.parse(text) as T;
 165| |      if (target === "blob") return new Blob([buf]) as T;
 166| |    }
 168| |    if (kind === "formData") {
 169| |      const fd = value as FormData;
 171| |      if (target === "text") {
 172| |        const params = new URLSearchParams();
 173| |        for (const [k, v] of fd) {
 174| |          if (typeof v === "string") params.append(k, v);
 175| |        }
 176| |        return params.toString() as T;
 177| |      }
 178| |    }
 180|!|    throw new BodyParseError(
 181| |      `Body already consumed as "${kind}"; cannot parse as "${target}".`,
 182| |      409
 183| |    );
 184| |  }
 186|▼|  async function use<T>(
 187| |    target: BodyKind,
 188| |    parser: () => Promise<T>,
 189| |    max?: number
 190| |  ): Promise<T> {
 191| |    if (kind === target) return value as T;
 192| |    if (kind !== "none") return convert<T>(target);
 194| |    if (pending) {
 195| |      if (pendingKind === target) return pending as Promise<T>;
 197|!|      throw new BodyParseError(
 198| |        `Body parse already in progress as "${pendingKind}".`,
 199| |        409
 200| |      );
 201| |    }
 203| |    assertSize(max);
 205| |    pendingKind = target;
 207| |    pending = parser()
 208| |      .then((v) => {
 209| |        kind = target;
 210| |        value = v;
 211| |        pending = null;
 212| |        pendingKind = null;
 213| |        return v;
 214| |      })
 215| |      .catch((err) => {
 216| |        pending = null;
 217| |        pendingKind = null;
 218|!|        throw err;
 219| |      });
 221| |    return pending as Promise<T>;
 222| |  }
 224|▼|  function assertFileSize(file: File): void {
 225| |    if (limits.maxFileBytes && file.size > limits.maxFileBytes) {
 226|!|      throw new BodyParseError("File too large", 413);
 227| |    }
 228| |  }
 230|▼|  const fn = async (): Promise<unknown> => {
 231| |    if (req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD" || req.method === "OPTIONS") {
 232| |      return undefined;
 233| |    }
 235| |    const ct = (req.headers.get("content-type") || "")
 236| |      .split(";")[0]
 237| |      ?.trim()
 238| |      .toLowerCase();
 240| |    if (!ct) return undefined;
 242| |    if (ct.includes("json")) return fn.json();
 243| |    if (ct.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) return fn.form();
 244| |    if (ct.includes("multipart/form-data")) return fn.multipart();
 245| |    if (ct.startsWith("text/")) return fn.text();
 247| |    return fn.arrayBuffer();
 248| |  };
 250| |  const body = fn as unknown as LazyBody;
 252| |  body.json = <T = unknown>() =>
 253| |    use<T>(
 254| |      "json",
 255| |      async () => {
 256| |        try {
 257| |          return await req.json();
 258| |        } catch {
 259|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid JSON body", 400);
 260| |        }
 261| |      },
 262| |      limits.maxJsonBytes
 263| |    );
 265| |  body.text = () =>
 266| |    use<string>(
 267| |      "text",
 268| |      async () => {
 269| |        try {
 270| |          return await req.text();
 271| |        } catch {
 272|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid text body", 400);
 273| |        }
 274| |      },
 275| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 276| |    );
 278| |  body.arrayBuffer = () =>
 279| |    use<ArrayBuffer>(
 280| |      "arrayBuffer",
 281| |      async () => {
 282| |        try {
 283| |          return await req.arrayBuffer();
 284| |        } catch {
 285|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid binary body", 400);
 286| |        }
 287| |      },
 288| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 289| |    );
 291| |  body.blob = () =>
 292| |    use<Blob>(
 293| |      "blob",
 294| |      async () => {
 295| |        try {
 296| |          return await req.blob();
 297| |        } catch {
 298|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid blob body", 400);
 299| |        }
 300| |      },
 301| |      limits.maxTextBytes
 302| |    );
 304| |  body.formData = () =>
 305| |    use<FormData>(
 306| |      "formData",
 307| |      async () => {
 308| |        try {
 309| |          return await req.formData();
 310| |        } catch {
 311|!|          throw new BodyParseError("Invalid form/multipart body", 400);
 312| |        }
 313| |      },
 314| |      limits.maxFormBytes
 315| |    );
 317| |  body.form = async () => {
 318| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 319| |    return formDataToRecord(fd);
 320| |  };
 322| |  body.multipart = async () => {
 323| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 324| |    return formDataToObject(fd);
 325| |  };
 327| |  body.file = async (name?: string) => {
 328| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 330| |    if (name) {
 331| |      const value = fd.get(name);
 332| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 333| |        assertFileSize(value);
 334| |        return value;
 335| |      }
 336| |      return null;
 337| |    }
 339| |    for (const value of fd.values()) {
 340| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 341| |        assertFileSize(value);
 342| |        return value;
 343| |      }
 344| |    }
 346| |    return null;
 347| |  };
 349| |  body.files = async (name?: string) => {
 350| |    const fd = await body.formData();
 351| |    const files: File[] = [];
 353| |    if (name) {
 354| |      for (const value of fd.getAll(name)) {
 355| |        if (value instanceof File) {
 356| |          assertFileSize(value);
 357| |          files.push(value);
 358| |        }
 359| |      }
 360| |      return files;
 361| |    }
 363| |    for (const value of fd.values()) {
 364| |      if (value instanceof File) {
 365| |        assertFileSize(value);
 366| |        files.push(value);
 367| |      }
 368| |    }
 370| |    return files;
 371| |  };
 373| |  body.stream = () => {
 374| |    if (kind !== "none") return null;
 375| |    return req.body;
 376| |  };
 378| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "consumed", {
 379| |    get: () => kind !== "none",
 380| |  });
 382| |  Object.defineProperty(body, "parsed", {
 383| |    get: () => value,
 384| |  });
 386| |  return body;
 387| |}
 389| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 390| |// Backward compatibility helpers
 391| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 393|▼|export interface BodyParser {
 394| |  readonly contentTypes: readonly string[];
 395| |  parse(req: Request): Promise<unknown>;
 396| |}
 398| |export const jsonParser: BodyParser = {
 399| |  contentTypes: ["application/json"],
 400| |  async parse(req) {
 401| |    return createLazyBody(req).json();
 402| |  },
 403| |};
 405| |export const formUrlEncodedParser: BodyParser = {
 406| |  contentTypes: ["application/x-www-form-urlencoded"],
 407| |  async parse(req) {
 408| |    return createLazyBody(req).form();
 409| |  },
 410| |};
 412| |export const multipartParser: BodyParser = {
 413| |  contentTypes: ["multipart/form-data"],
 414| |  async parse(req) {
 415| |    return createLazyBody(req).multipart();
 416| |  },
 417| |};
 419| |export const defaultParsers: readonly BodyParser[] = [
 420| |  jsonParser,
 421| |  formUrlEncodedParser,
 422| |  multipartParser,
 423| |];
 425|▼|export async function parseBody(
 426| |  req: Request,
 427| |  _parsers: readonly BodyParser[] = defaultParsers
 428| |): Promise<unknown> {
 429| |  return createLazyBody(req)();
 430| |}
 432|▼|export function needsBodyParse(method: string): boolean {
 433| |  return method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD" && method !== "OPTIONS";
 434| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Multi-core server helper.
   3| | *
   4| | * Bun is single-threaded per JS context, but Bun.serve can use reusePort
   5| | * to run multiple accept loops across CPU cores.
   6| | */
   8|▼|export type ServeOptions = Parameters<typeof Bun.serve>[0];
  10| |export interface ClusterServeOptions extends ServeOptions {
  11| |  /**
  12| |   * Number of server instances.
  13| |   * Use "auto" to match CPU count.
  14| |   */
  15| |  workers?: number | "auto";
  16| |}
  18|▼|export function serveCluster(options: ClusterServeOptions) {
  19| |  const requested = options.workers ?? 1;
  21| |  const count =
  22| |    requested === "auto"
  23| |      ? Math.max(1, navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 1)
  24| |      : Math.max(1, Number(requested));
  26| |  const serveOptions: ServeOptions = { ...options };
  27| |  delete (serveOptions as any).workers;
  29| |  const servers = Array.from({ length: count }, () =>
  30| |    Bun.serve({
  31| |      ...serveOptions,
  32| |      reusePort: count > 1 ? true : serveOptions.reusePort,
  33| |    })
  34| |  );
  36| |  return {
  37| |    servers,
  38| |    port: servers[0]?.port,
  39| |    stop() {
  40| |      for (const server of servers) {
  41| |        server.stop();
  42| |      }
  43| |    },
  44| |  };
  45| |}

  20| |      status: this.status,
  21| |      code: this.code,
  22| |      ...(this.details ? { details: this.details } : {}),
  23| |    };
  24| |  }

>src/core/lru.ts
i:lru-cache
e:LRUCacheOptions|LRUCache
c:LRUCache
t:LRUCacheOptions
t:Entry
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Production LRU cache backed by lru-cache.
   3| | * Preserves your existing API.
   4| | */
   6| |import { LRUCache as LRU } from "lru-cache";
   8|▼|export interface LRUCacheOptions<K, V> {
   9| |  max?: number;
  10| |  ttlMs?: number;
  11| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
  12| |  maxBytes?: number;
  13| |  sizeOf?: (value: V, key: K) => number;
  14| |  onEvict?: (key: K, value: V) => void;
  15| |}
  17|▼|interface Entry<V> {
  18| |  value: V;
  19| |  bytes: number;
  20| |  expiresAt: number;
  21| |  staleAt: number;
  22| |}
  24|▼|export class LRUCache<K, V> {
  25| |  private lru: LRU<K, Entry<V>>;
  26| |  private inflight = new Map<K, Promise<V>>();
  28| |  constructor(private readonly opts: LRUCacheOptions<K, V> = {}) {
  29| |    this.lru = new LRU<K, Entry<V>>({
  30| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
  31| |      maxSize: opts.maxBytes,
  32| |      sizeCalculation: (entry) => Math.max(1, entry.bytes),
  33| |      dispose: (entry, key) => {
  34| |        opts.onEvict?.(key, entry.value);
  35| |      },
  36| |    });
  37| |  }
  39| |  get size(): number {
  40| |    return this.lru.size;
  41| |  }
  43| |  get byteSize(): number {
  44| |    return this.lru.calculatedSize;
  45| |  }
  47| |  private now(): number {
  48| |    return Date.now();
  49| |  }
  51| |  private alive(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  52| |    return entry.expiresAt === 0 || entry.expiresAt > now;
  53| |  }
  55| |  private fresh(entry: Entry<V>, now: number): boolean {
  56| |    return entry.staleAt === 0 || entry.staleAt > now;
  57| |  }
  59| |  get(key: K, _options: { allowStale?: boolean } = {}): V | undefined {
  60| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
  61| |    if (!entry) return undefined;
  63| |    const now = this.now();
  65| |    if (!this.alive(entry, now)) {
  66| |      this.lru.delete(key);
  67| |      return undefined;
  68| |    }
  70| |    return entry.value;
  71| |  }
  73| |  set(
  74| |    key: K,
  75| |    value: V,
  76| |    options: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; bytes?: number } = {}
  77| |  ): this {
  78| |    const ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? this.opts.ttlMs ?? 0;
  79| |    const staleTtlMs = options.staleTtlMs ?? this.opts.staleTtlMs ?? 0;
  80| |    const bytes = options.bytes ?? this.opts.sizeOf?.(value, key) ?? 0;
  81| |    const maxBytes = this.opts.maxBytes ?? 0;
  83| |    if (maxBytes > 0 && bytes > maxBytes) return this;
  85| |    const now = this.now();
  86| |    const expiresAt = ttlMs > 0 ? now + ttlMs : 0;
  87| |    const staleAt = staleTtlMs > 0 ? now + staleTtlMs : expiresAt;
  88| |    const lruTtl = Math.max(ttlMs, staleTtlMs);
  90| |    this.lru.set(
  91| |      key,
  92| |      { value, bytes, expiresAt, staleAt },
  93| |      lruTtl > 0 ? { ttl: lruTtl } : undefined
  94| |    );
  96| |    return this;
  97| |  }
  99| |  delete(key: K): boolean {
 100| |    return this.lru.delete(key);
 101| |  }
 103| |  clear(): void {
 104| |    this.lru.clear();
 105| |    this.inflight.clear();
 106| |  }
 108| |  async getOrSet(
 109| |    key: K,
 110| |    factory: () => Promise<V> | V,
 111| |    options: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; bytes?: number } = {}
 112| |  ): Promise<V> {
 113| |    const now = this.now();
 114| |    const entry = this.lru.get(key);
 116| |    if (entry && this.alive(entry, now)) {
 117| |      if (!this.fresh(entry, now) && !this.inflight.has(key)) {
 118| |        const revalidate = Promise.resolve()
 119| |          .then(factory)
 120| |          .then((value) => this.set(key, value, options))
 121| |          .catch(() => {
 122| |            // keep stale value on failure
 123| |          })
 124| |          .finally(() => {
 125| |            this.inflight.delete(key);
 126| |          });
 128| |        this.inflight.set(key, revalidate as Promise<V>);
 129| |      }
 131| |      return entry.value;
 132| |    }
 134| |    const pending = this.inflight.get(key);
 135| |    if (pending) return pending;
 137| |    const promise = Promise.resolve()
 138| |      .then(factory)
 139| |      .then((value) => {
 140| |        this.set(key, value, options);
 141| |        return value;
 142| |      })
 143| |      .finally(() => {
 144| |        this.inflight.delete(key);
 145| |      });
 147| |    this.inflight.set(key, promise);
 148| |    return promise;
 149| |  }
 150| |}

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Proxy / forwarding helpers.
   3| | * Streams upstream responses directly to the client.
   4| | */
   6| |const HOP_BY_HOP = [
   7| |  "connection",
   8| |  "keep-alive",
   9| |  "proxy-authenticate",
  10| |  "proxy-authorization",
  11| |  "te",
  12| |  "trailer",
  13| |  "transfer-encoding",
  14| |  "upgrade",
  15| |];
  17| |export interface ProxyOptions extends Omit<RequestInit, "body"> {
  18| |  timeoutMs?: number;
  19| |  body?: BodyInit | ReadableStream | null;
  20| |}
  22|▼|function sanitizeRequestHeaders(headers: Headers): Headers {
  23| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  25| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  27| |  out.delete("host");
  28| |  out.delete("content-length");
  30| |  return out;
  31| |}
  33|▼|function sanitizeResponseHeaders(headers: Headers): Headers {
  34| |  const out = new Headers(headers);
  36| |  for (const h of HOP_BY_HOP) out.delete(h);
  38| |  return out;
  39| |}
  41|▼|export async function proxyRequest(
  42| |  target: string | URL,
  43| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {}
  44| |): Promise<Response> {
  45| |  const controller = new AbortController();
  46| |  const timeout = setTimeout(
  47| |    () => controller.abort(),
  48| |    opts.timeoutMs ?? 10_000
  49| |  );
  51| |  try {
  52| |    const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(
  53| |      opts.headers instanceof Headers
  54| |        ? opts.headers
  55| |        : new Headers(opts.headers)
  56| |    );
  58| |    const init: any = {
  59| |      method: opts.method ?? "GET",
  60| |      headers,
  61| |      redirect: opts.redirect ?? "manual",
  62| |      signal: opts.signal ?? controller.signal,
  63| |    };
  65| |    if (opts.body != null) {
  66| |      init.body = opts.body;
  68| |      // Required by fetch implementations when streaming a request body.
  69| |      if (typeof (opts.body as any).pipeTo === "function") {
  70| |        init.duplex = "half";
  71| |      }
  72| |    }
  74| |    const upstream = await fetch(target.toString(), init as RequestInit);
  76| |    const responseHeaders = sanitizeResponseHeaders(upstream.headers);
  77| |    responseHeaders.set("x-proxy", "flux");
  79| |    return new Response(upstream.body, {
  80| |      status: upstream.status,
  81| |      statusText: upstream.statusText,
  82| |      headers: responseHeaders,
  83| |    });
  84|!|  } catch (err) {
  85| |    if (err instanceof Error && err.name === "AbortError") {
  86| |      return Response.json(
  87| |        { error: "Upstream timeout", status: 504 },
  88| |        { status: 504 }
  89| |      );
  90| |    }
  92| |    return Response.json(
  93| |      { error: "Bad Gateway", status: 502 },
  94| |      { status: 502 }
  95| |    );
  96| |  } finally {
  97| |    clearTimeout(timeout);
  98| |  }
  99| |}
 101| |/**
 102| | * Forward the incoming request to another target.
 103| | * Preserves method, query, headers, and streams request body.
 104| | */
 105|▼|export async function forwardRequest(
 106| |  req: Request,
 107| |  target: string | URL,
 108| |  opts: ProxyOptions = {}
 109| |): Promise<Response> {
 110| |  const incoming = new URL(req.url);
 111| |  const targetUrl = new URL(target.toString());
 113| |  // Preserve query string unless target already has one.
 114| |  if (!targetUrl.search) {
 115| |    targetUrl.search = incoming.search;
 116| |  }
 118| |  const headers = sanitizeRequestHeaders(req.headers);
 120| |  const hasBody =
 121| |    req.method !== "GET" &&
 122| |    req.method !== "HEAD" &&
 123| |    req.body != null;
 125| |  return proxyRequest(targetUrl, {
 126| |    ...opts,
 127| |    method: req.method,
 128| |    headers,
 129| |    body: hasBody ? (req.body as ReadableStream) : undefined,
 130| |  });
 131| |}

>src/core/sse.ts

f:sseFromStream(stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit):Response
t:SSEOptions
t:SSEMessage
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Server-Sent Events (SSE) support.
   3| | * Streaming responses with proper formatting.
   4| | */
   6|▼|export interface SSEOptions {
   7| |  event?: string;
   8| |  id?: string;
   9| |  retry?: number;
  10| |}
  12|▼|export interface SSEMessage {
  13| |  data: string;
  14| |  event?: string;
  15| |  id?: string;
  16| |  retry?: number;
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const formatSSE = (msg: SSEMessage): string => {
  20| |  let out = "";
  21| |  if (msg.id) out += `id: ${msg.id}\n`;
  22| |  if (msg.event) out += `event: ${msg.event}\n`;
  23| |  if (msg.retry) out += `retry: ${msg.retry}\n`;
  24| |  out += `data: ${msg.data}\n\n`;
  25| |  return out;
  26| |};
  28|▼|export const sse = (
  29| |  generator: AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage> | Generator<string | SSEMessage>,
  30| |  init?: ResponseInit
  31| |): Response => {
  32| |  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  34| |  const stream = new ReadableStream({
  35| |    async start(controller) {
  36| |      try {
  37| |        for await (const chunk of generator as AsyncGenerator<string | SSEMessage>) {
  38| |          const msg = typeof chunk === "string" ? { data: chunk } : chunk;
  39| |          controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(formatSSE(msg)));
  40| |        }
  41| |      } catch { /* stream closed */ }
  42| |      finally { controller.close(); }
  43| |    }
  44| |  });
  46| |  return new Response(stream, {
  47| |    ...init,
  48| |    headers: {
  49| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  50| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  51| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  52| |      ...init?.headers,
  53| |    },
  54| |  });
  55| |};
  57|▼|export const sseFromStream = (stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response =>
  58| |  new Response(stream, {
  59| |    ...init,
  60| |    headers: {
  61| |      "content-type": "text/event-stream",
  62| |      "cache-control": "no-cache",
  63| |      "connection": "keep-alive",
  64| |      ...init?.headers,
  65| |    },

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Flux Core v3.0 — Unified Type System
   3| | * Zero-runtime-cost types. All contracts are compile-time only.
   4| | * Supports TypeBox, Standard Schema v1, and custom validators.

   7| |// ============================================================================

  14|▼|export type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
  15|▼|export type MaybeArray<T> = T | T[];
  16|▼|export type MaybeReadonlyArray<T> = T | readonly T[];
  17|▼|export type Prettify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] } & {};
  18|▼|export type IsAny<T> = 0 extends 1 & T ? true : false;
  19|▼|export type IsNever<T> = [T] extends [never] ? true : false;

  30| |      value: unknown
  31| |    ) => MaybePromise<{ value: Output } | { issues: readonly SchemaIssue[] }>;

  33| |  };

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Compiler Options Validation
   3| | * TypeBox + Ajv based validation.
   4| | */
   6| |import { Type, type Static } from "@sinclair/typebox";
   7| |import Ajv from "ajv";
   8| |import type { CompilerOptions } from "./types";
   9| |import { DEFAULT_OPTS } from "./types";
  10| |import type { Result } from "./fp";
  11| |import { ok, err } from "./fp";
  13| |const CompilerOptionsSchema = Type.Object(
  14| |  {
  15| |    routesDir: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  16| |    outDir: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  17| |    outFile: Type.String({ minLength: 1 }),
  19| |    target: Type.Union([
  20| |      Type.Literal("bun"),
  21| |      Type.Literal("node"),
  22| |      Type.Literal("deno"),
  23| |    ]),
  25| |    optimizationLevel: Type.Union([
  26| |      Type.Literal(0),
  27| |      Type.Literal(1),
  28| |      Type.Literal(2),
  29| |      Type.Literal(3),
  30| |    ]),
  32| |    inlineThreshold: Type.Number({ minimum: 0, maximum: 1000 }),
  34| |    enableSchemaInlining: Type.Boolean(),
  35| |    enableResponsePreserialization: Type.Boolean(),
  36| |    enableWorkerThreads: Type.Boolean(),
  37| |    sourceMap: Type.Boolean(),
  38| |    minify: Type.Boolean(),
  40| |    enableSIMDPaths: Type.Boolean(),
  41| |    enableBranchPrediction: Type.Boolean(),
  42| |    enableDeadCodeElimination: Type.Boolean(),
  43| |    enableConstantFolding: Type.Boolean(),
  44| |    enableHandlerDeduplication: Type.Boolean(),
  46| |    hooksDir: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  48| |    enableTracing: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  49| |    enableAccessLog: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  50| |    enableTraceHeaders: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  51| |    enableLifecycle: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  52| |    enableStrictMethods: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  53| |    enableFastBodyParsing: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  55| |    serviceName: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  56| |    requestIdHeader: Type.Optional(Type.String({ minLength: 1 })),
  57| |    exposeErrorDetails: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  59| |    maxJsonBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  60| |    maxTextBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  61| |    maxFormBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  62| |    maxFileBytes: Type.Optional(Type.Integer({ minimum: 0 })),
  64| |    cluster: Type.Optional(
  65| |      Type.Union([Type.Integer({ minimum: 1 }), Type.Literal("auto")])
  66| |    ),
  68| |    reusePort: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  70| |    browserCache: Type.Optional(
  71| |      Type.Object({
  72| |        maxAge: Type.Optional(Type.Number()),
  73| |        swr: Type.Optional(Type.Number()),
  74| |        immutable: Type.Optional(Type.Boolean()),
  75| |        vary: Type.Optional(Type.Array(Type.String())),
  76| |      })
  77| |    ),
  79| |    cacheBust: Type.Optional(
  80| |      Type.Union([
  81| |        Type.Literal("mtime"),
  82| |        Type.Literal("hash"),
  83| |        Type.Literal("none"),
  84| |      ])
  85| |    ),
  86| |  },
  87| |  { additionalProperties: false }
  88| |);
  90|▼|export type ValidatedCompilerOptions = Static<typeof CompilerOptionsSchema>;
  92| |const ajv = new Ajv({
  93| |  allErrors: true,
  94| |  strict: false,
  95| |  useDefaults: true,
  96| |  coerceTypes: false,
  97| |});
  99| |const validate = ajv.compile(CompilerOptionsSchema);
 101|▼|export const validateOptions = (
 102| |  input: Partial<CompilerOptions>
 103| |): Result<CompilerOptions, string[]> => {
 104| |  const data = { ...DEFAULT_OPTS, ...input };
 106| |  if (validate(data)) {
 107| |    return ok(data as CompilerOptions);
 108| |  }
 110| |  const errors = (validate.errors ?? []).map((e) => {
 111| |    const path =
 112| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||
 113| |      (e.params as any)?.missingProperty ||
 114| |      "options";
 116| |    return `${path}: ${e.message}`;
 117| |  });
 119| |  return err(errors);
 120| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Bun.Transpiler-based AST Parser
   3| | * Replaces regex hacks with a proper ESTree walker.
   4| | * Handles edge cases: nested functions, template literals, comments, re-exports, etc.
   5| | */
   7| |import type {
   8| |  ContextUsage,
   9| |  ImportInfo,
  10| |  ExportInfo,
  11| |  SymbolInfo,
  12| |  Position,
  13| |} from "../types";
  14| |import * as oxcParser from "oxc-parser";
  16| |import { createRequire } from "node:module";
  17| |const optionalRequire = createRequire(import.meta.url);
  18| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  19| |// ESTree Walker — tiny, zero-dependency
  20| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  22|▼|function walk(node: any, cb: (node: any) => void): void {
  23| |  if (!node || typeof node !== "object") return;
  24| |  cb(node);
  25| |  for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
  26| |    if (key === "parent" || key === "loc" || key === "range") continue;
  27| |    const child = node[key];
  28| |    if (Array.isArray(child)) {
  29| |      for (const c of child) walk(c, cb);
  30| |    } else if (child && typeof child === "object" && child.type) {
  31| |      walk(child, cb);
  32| |    }
  33| |  }
  34| |}
  36|▼|function walkUntil<T>(node: any, predicate: (node: any) => T | undefined): T | undefined {
  37| |  let result: T | undefined;
  38| |  walk(node, (n) => {
  39| |    if (result !== undefined) return;
  40| |    const r = predicate(n);
  41| |    if (r !== undefined) result = r;
  42| |  });
  43| |  return result;
  44| |}
  46| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  47| |// Context-Usage Detection
  48| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50| |const CONTEXT_METHODS = new Set([
  51| |  "json", "text", "html", "redirect", "stream", "empty", "get", "set",
  52| |]);
  54| |const CONTEXT_PROPS = new Set([
  55| |  "body", "params", "query", "file", "files", "headers", "state", "req", "url",
  56| |]);
  58| |/** Build a map: localVariableName → contextProperty (or "__root__") */
  59|▼|function buildContextMapping(params: any[]): Map<string, string> {
  60| |  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  61| |  for (const param of params) {
  62| |    if (!param) continue;
  63| |    if (param.type === "Identifier") {
  64| |      map.set(param.name, "__root__");
  65| |    } else if (param.type === "ObjectPattern") {
  66| |      for (const prop of param.properties || []) {
  67| |        if (prop.type !== "Property") continue;
  68| |        const key = prop.key?.name ?? prop.key?.value;
  69| |        const local = prop.value?.name ?? prop.value?.value;
  70| |        if (key && local) map.set(local, key);
  71| |        // Nested destructuring not supported for DX simplicity
  72| |      }
  73| |    }
  74| |  }
  75| |  return map;
  76| |}
  78|▼|function detectUsage(bodyNode: any, mapping: Map<string, string>): ContextUsage {
  79| |  const usage: ContextUsage = {
  80| |    body: false, params: false, query: false, file: false,
  81| |    headers: false, state: false, json: false, text: false,
  82| |    redirect: false, req: false, url: false,
  83| |  };
  85| |  walk(bodyNode, (n) => {
  86| |    // MemberExpression: ctx.body, ctx.params, etc.
  87| |    if (n.type === "MemberExpression" && !n.computed && n.object?.type === "Identifier") {
  88| |      const root = mapping.get(n.object.name);
  89| |      if (root === "__root__") {
  90| |        const prop = n.property.name;
  91| |        if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
  92| |        if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
  93| |        if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
  94| |        if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
  95| |        if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
  96| |        if (prop === "state") usage.state = true;
  97| |        if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
  98| |        if (prop === "url") usage.url = true;
  99| |        if (CONTEXT_METHODS.has(prop)) {
 100| |          if (prop === "json") usage.json = true;
 101| |          if (prop === "text") usage.text = true;
 102| |          if (prop === "redirect") usage.redirect = true;
 103| |        }
 104| |      }
 105| |    }
 107| |    // Identifier read: destructured `body` from ({ body })
 108| |    if (n.type === "Identifier" && mapping.has(n.name)) {
 109| |      const prop = mapping.get(n.name)!;
 110| |      if (prop === "body" || prop === "files") usage.body = true;
 111| |      if (prop === "file") usage.file = true;
 112| |      if (prop === "params") usage.params = true;
 113| |      if (prop === "query") usage.query = true;
 114| |      if (prop === "headers") usage.headers = true;
 115| |      if (prop === "state") usage.state = true;
 116| |      if (prop === "req") usage.req = true;
 117| |      if (prop === "url") usage.url = true;
 118| |    }
 119| |  });
 121| |  return usage;
 122| |}
 124| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 125| |// Handler Extraction
 126| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 128| |const HTTP_WRAPPERS = new Set(["get", "post", "put", "patch", "del", "all"]);
 129|▼|const nodeStart = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 130| |  node?.range?.[0] ?? node?.start ?? node?.span?.[0];
 132|▼|const nodeEnd = (node: any): number | undefined =>
 133| |  node?.range?.[1] ?? node?.end ?? node?.span?.[1];
 135|▼|function extractHandlerFunction(node: any): { fn: any; isAsync: boolean } | null {
 136| |  // export default get(async (ctx) => ...)
 137| |  if (node.type === "CallExpression" && node.callee?.type === "Identifier" && HTTP_WRAPPERS.has(node.callee.name)) {
 138| |    const arg = node.arguments?.[0];
 139| |    if (!arg) return null;
 140| |    if (arg.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || arg.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 141| |      return { fn: arg, isAsync: arg.async ?? false };
 142| |    }
 143| |    // export default get(myHandler)
 144| |    if (arg.type === "Identifier") {
 145| |      // We can't inline a referenced handler — return null to signal "imported"
 146| |      return null;
 147| |    }
 148| |  }
 149| |  // export default (ctx) => ...
 150| |  if (node.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression" || node.type === "FunctionExpression") {
 151| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 152| |  }
 153| |  // export default async function(ctx) { ... }
 154| |  if (node.type === "FunctionDeclaration") {
 155| |    return { fn: node, isAsync: node.async ?? false };
 156| |  }
 157| |  return null;
 158| |}
 160|▼|export interface ExtractedHandler {
 161| |  readonly body: string;        // source slice of function body
 162| |  readonly isAsync: boolean;
 163| |  readonly paramName: string;  // first param identifier name (or "ctx" fallback)
 164| |  readonly usage: ContextUsage;
 165| |}
 167|▼|export function extractHandler(source: string, ast: any): ExtractedHandler | null {
 168| |  const defaultExport = walkUntil<any>(ast, (n) =>
 169| |    n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? n : undefined
 170| |  );
 172| |  if (!defaultExport) return null;
 174| |  const extracted = extractHandlerFunction(defaultExport.declaration);
 175| |  if (!extracted) return null;
 177| |  const { fn, isAsync } = extracted;
 178| |  const params = fn.params || [];
 179| |  const mapping = buildContextMapping(params);
 180| |  const rootParam = params[0]?.type === "Identifier" ? params[0].name : "ctx";
 182| |  let bodyText = "";
 183| |  const body = fn.body;
 185| |  if (body) {
 186| |    const start = nodeStart(body);
 187| |    const end = nodeEnd(body);
 189| |    if (start != null && end != null) {
 190| |      if (body.type === "BlockStatement") {
 191| |        bodyText = source.slice(start + 1, end - 1).trim();
 192| |      } else {
 193| |        bodyText = `return ${source.slice(start, end).trim()};`;
 194| |      }
 195| |    }
 196| |  }
 198| |  const usage = detectUsage(body || fn, mapping);
 200| |  return {
 201| |    body: bodyText,
 202| |    isAsync,
 203| |    paramName: rootParam,
 204| |    usage,
 205| |  };
 206| |}
 207| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 208| |// Import / Export / Symbol Extraction (AST-based, zero regex)
 209| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 211|▼|export function extractImportsAST(ast: any): ImportInfo[] {
 212| |  const imports: ImportInfo[] = [];
 213| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 214| |    if (n.type !== "ImportDeclaration") return;
 215| |    const source = n.source?.value as string;
 216| |    if (!source) return;
 218| |    const names: string[] = [];
 219| |    let defaultName: string | undefined;
 220| |    let namespaceName: string | undefined;
 222| |    for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 223| |      if (spec.type === "ImportDefaultSpecifier") defaultName = spec.local.name;
 224| |      if (spec.type === "ImportNamespaceSpecifier") namespaceName = spec.local.name;
 225| |      if (spec.type === "ImportSpecifier") names.push(spec.local.name);
 226| |    }
 228| |    imports.push({ source, names, defaultName, namespaceName });
 229| |  });
 230| |  return imports;
 231| |}
 233|▼|export function extractExportsAST(ast: any): ExportInfo[] {
 234| |  const exports: ExportInfo[] = [];
 235| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 236| |    if (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration") {
 237| |      const name = n.declaration?.name || "default";
 238| |      exports.push({ name, kind: "default" });
 239| |    }
 240| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration") {
 241| |      for (const spec of n.specifiers || []) {
 242| |        if (spec.type === "ExportSpecifier") {
 243| |          exports.push({ name: spec.local.name, kind: "named" });
 244| |        }
 245| |      }
 246| |      for (const decl of n.declaration ? [n.declaration] : []) {
 247| |        if (decl.type === "FunctionDeclaration" || decl.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 248| |          const id = decl.id || decl.declarations?.[0]?.id;
 249| |          if (id?.name) exports.push({ name: id.name, kind: "named" });
 250| |        }
 251| |      }
 252| |    }
 253| |  });
 254| |  return exports;
 255| |}
 257|▼|function posFromNode(source: string, node: any): Position {
 258| |  if (node.loc) return { line: node.loc.start.line, column: node.loc.start.column };
 259| |  return { line: 0, column: 0 };
 260| |}
 262|▼|export function extractSymbolsAST(source: string, ast: any): SymbolInfo[] {
 263| |  const symbols: SymbolInfo[] = [];
 264| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 265| |    if (n.type === "FunctionDeclaration" && n.id?.name) {
 266| |      symbols.push({
 267| |        name: n.id.name,
 268| |        kind: "function",
 269| |        pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 270| |        isAsync: n.async ?? false,
 271| |        isDefaultExport: false,
 272| |        params: (n.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 273| |        decorators: [],
 274| |        calls: [],
 275| |        calledBy: [],
 276| |        size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 277| |        hotness: 0,
 278| |      });
 279| |    }
 280| |    if (n.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 281| |      for (const decl of n.declarations || []) {
 282| |        if (decl.id?.name && decl.init?.type === "ArrowFunctionExpression") {
 283| |          symbols.push({
 284| |            name: decl.id.name,
 285| |            kind: "const",
 286| |            pos: posFromNode(source, n),
 287| |            isAsync: decl.init.async ?? false,
 288| |            isDefaultExport: false,
 289| |            params: (decl.init.params || []).map((p: any) => p.name || "..."),
 290| |            decorators: [],
 291| |            calls: [],
 292| |            calledBy: [],
 293| |            size: n.range ? n.range[1] - n.range[0] : 9999,
 294| |            hotness: 0,
 295| |          });
 296| |        }
 297| |      }
 298| |    }
 299| |  });
 300| |  return symbols;
 301| |}
 303|▼|export function hasDefaultExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 304| |  return walkUntil(ast, (n) => (n.type === "ExportDefaultDeclaration" ? true : undefined)) ?? false;
 305| |}
 307|▼|export function hasSchemaExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 308| |  let found = false;
 309| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 310| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 311| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 312| |        if (d.id?.name === "schema") found = true;
 313| |      }
 314| |    }
 315| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "schema") found = true;
 316| |  });
 317| |  return found;
 318| |}
 320|▼|export function hasConfigExportAST(ast: any): boolean {
 321| |  let found = false;
 322| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 323| |    if (n.type === "ExportNamedDeclaration" && n.declaration?.type === "VariableDeclaration") {
 324| |      for (const d of n.declaration.declarations || []) {
 325| |        if (d.id?.name === "config") found = true;
 326| |      }
 327| |    }
 328| |    if (n.type === "ExportSpecifier" && n.local?.name === "config") found = true;
 329| |  });
 330| |  return found;
 331| |}
 333| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 334| |// Purity Analysis (AST-based)
 335| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 337| |const IMPURE_GLOBALS = new Set([
 338| |  "fetch", "Date", "Math", "console", "process", "crypto",
 339| |  "setTimeout", "setInterval", "clearTimeout", "clearInterval",
 340| |  "Promise", "Map", "Set", "WeakMap", "WeakSet",
 341| |]);
 343| |const IMPURE_CALLS = new Set([
 344| |  "Math.random", "Date.now", "crypto.randomUUID", "crypto.getRandomValues",
 345| |  "console.log", "console.warn", "console.error", "fetch",
 346| |]);
 348|▼|export function isPureBodyAST(ast: any): boolean {
 349| |  let impure = false;
 350| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 351| |    if (impure) return;
 352| |    // new Date(), new Map(), etc.
 353| |    if (n.type === "NewExpression" && n.callee?.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(n.callee.name)) {
 354| |      impure = true;
 355| |    }
 356| |    // fetch(), Math.random(), etc.
 357| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression") {
 358| |      const callee = n.callee;
 359| |      if (callee.type === "Identifier" && IMPURE_GLOBALS.has(callee.name)) {
 360| |        impure = true;
 361| |      }
 362| |      if (callee.type === "MemberExpression") {
 363| |        const chain = flattenMember(callee);
 364| |        if (chain && IMPURE_CALLS.has(chain)) impure = true;
 365| |      }
 366| |    }
 367| |    // await
 368| |    if (n.type === "AwaitExpression") {
 369| |      // Conservative: any await is impure (could be DB, fetch, etc.)
 370| |      impure = true;
 371| |    }
 372| |  });
 373| |  return !impure;
 374| |}
 376|▼|function flattenMember(node: any): string | null {
 377| |  if (node.type === "Identifier") return node.name;
 378| |  if (node.type === "MemberExpression" && !node.computed) {
 379| |    const obj = flattenMember(node.object);
 380| |    const prop = node.property?.name;
 381| |    if (obj && prop) return `${obj}.${prop}`;
 382| |  }
 383| |  return null;
 384| |}
 386| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 387| |// Response-Type Inference (AST-based)
 388| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 390|▼|export function inferResponseTypeAST(ast: any): "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" {
 391| |  let type: "json" | "text" | "html" | "stream" | "unknown" = "unknown";
 392| |  walk(ast, (n) => {
 393| |    if (n.type === "CallExpression" && n.callee?.type === "MemberExpression") {
 394| |      const chain = flattenMember(n.callee);
 395| |      if (chain === "ctx.json") type = "json";
 396| |      if (chain === "ctx.text") type = "text";
 397| |      if (chain === "ctx.html") type = "html";
 398| |      if (chain === "ctx.stream") type = "stream";
 399| |    }
 400| |    // Heuristic: return "string" or template literal → text
 401| |    if (n.type === "ReturnStatement" && n.argument?.type === "Literal" && typeof n.argument.value === "string") {
 402| |      if (type === "unknown") type = "text";
 403| |    }
 404| |  });
 405| |  return type;
 406| |}

 412|▼|export interface ParseResult {
 413| |  readonly ast: any;
 414| |  readonly imports: ImportInfo[];
 415| |  readonly exports: ExportInfo[];
 416| |  readonly symbols: SymbolInfo[];
 417| |  readonly hasDefaultExport: boolean;
 418| |  readonly schemaExport: boolean;
 419| |  readonly configExport: boolean;
 420| |  readonly handler: ExtractedHandler | null;
 421| |  readonly config?: any;
 422| |}

 428|▼|function normalizeAst(result: any): any {
 429| |  if (!result) {
 430| |    return { type: "Program", body: [] };
 431| |  }
 433| |  if (result.errors && result.errors.length > 0) {
 434|!|    throw new Error(result.errors[0]?.message ?? "AST parse error");
 435| |  }
 437| |  const ast = result.program ?? result.ast ?? result.root ?? result;
 439| |  if (!ast.type) ast.type = "Program";
 440| |  if (!Array.isArray(ast.body)) ast.body = [];
 442| |  return ast;
 443| |}
 445|▼|function tryOxcParser(source: string): any | undefined {
 446| |  const mod = oxcParser as any;
 447| |  const parseSync = mod.parseSync ?? mod.default?.parseSync;
 449| |  if (typeof parseSync !== "function") return undefined;
 451| |  const attempts = [
 452| |    () =>
 453| |      parseSync("flux.ts", source, {
 454| |        sourceType: "module",
 455| |        target: "esnext",
 456| |      }),
 457| |    () =>
 458| |      parseSync(source, {
 459| |        sourceType: "module",
 460| |        target: "esnext",
 461| |      }),
 462| |  ];
 464| |  for (const attempt of attempts) {
 465| |    try {
 466| |      const result = attempt();
 468| |      if (result && typeof result.then === "function") continue;
 469| |      if (result?.errors?.length) continue;
 471| |      const program = result?.program ?? result?.ast ?? result;
 473| |      if (program?.type || Array.isArray(program?.body)) {
 474| |        return program;
 475| |      }
 476| |    } catch {
 477| |      // try next shape
 478| |    }
 479| |  }
 481| |  return undefined;
 482| |}
 484|▼|function parseToAst(source: string): any {
 485| |  const oxc = tryOxcParser(source);
 486| |  if (oxc) return normalizeAst(oxc);
 488| |  const B: any = Bun;
 490| |  const parsers: Array<() => any> = [
 491| |    () =>
 492| |      typeof B.parse === "function"
 493| |        ? B.parse(source, {
 494| |            loader: "ts",
 495| |            target: "bun",
 496| |            ranges: true,
 497| |            loc: true,
 498| |          })
 499| |        : undefined,
 501| |    () =>
 502| |      typeof B.parseSync === "function"
 503| |        ? B.parseSync(source, {
 504| |            loader: "ts",
 505| |            target: "bun",
 506| |            ranges: true,
 507| |            loc: true,
 508| |          })
 509| |        : undefined,
 511| |    () => {
 512| |      const transpiler = B.Transpiler
 513| |        ? new B.Transpiler({ loader: "ts", target: "bun" })
 514| |        : undefined;
 516| |      return transpiler && typeof transpiler.parse === "function"
 517| |        ? transpiler.parse(source, { ranges: true, loc: true })
 518| |        : undefined;
 519| |    },
 521| |    () => {
 522| |      const transpiler = B.Transpiler
 523| |        ? new B.Transpiler({ loader: "ts", target: "bun" })
 524| |        : undefined;
 526| |      return transpiler && typeof transpiler.parseSync === "function"
 527| |        ? transpiler.parseSync(source, { ranges: true, loc: true })
 528| |        : undefined;
 529| |    },
 530| |  ];
 532| |  for (const parser of parsers) {
 533| |    try {
 534| |      const result = parser();
 536| |      if (result && typeof result.then === "function") continue;
 538| |      if (result) {
 539| |        return normalizeAst(result);
 540| |      }
 541| |    } catch {
 542| |      // try next parser
 543| |    }
 544| |  }
 546|!|  throw new Error(
 547| |    "No synchronous JS/TS AST parser available. Install oxc-parser or use a Bun version with Bun.parse/Bun.parseSync."
 548| |  );
 549| |}
 551|▼|export function estimateNodeCount(source: string): number {
 552| |  try {
 553| |    const ast = parseToAst(source);
 554| |    let count = 0;
 556| |    walk(ast, () => {
 557| |      count++;
 558| |    });
 560| |    return count;
 561| |  } catch {
 562| |    // Heuristic fallback.
 563| |    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(source.length / 20));
 564| |  }
 565| |}
 567|▼|export function parseModule(source: string): ParseResult {
 568| |  let ast: any;
 570| |  try {
 571| |    ast = parseToAst(source);
 572| |  } catch {
 573| |    ast = { type: "Program", body: [] };
 574| |  }
 576| |return {
 577| |  ast,
   ... (44 more lines)

  30|▼|export const runLinker = (
  31| |  code: string,
  32| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
  33| |  logger: Logger
  34| |): string =>
  35| |  logger.time("linker", () => {
  36| |    mkdirSync(opts.outDir, { recursive: true });
  38| |    let finalCode = code;
  39| |    let map: string | undefined;
  41| |    if (opts.minify || opts.sourceMap) {
  42| |      const result = transformSync(code, {
  43| |        minify: opts.minify,
  44| |        loader: "js",
  45| |        target: "esnext",
  46| |        format: "esm",
  47| |        sourcefile: opts.outFile,
  48| |        sourcemap: opts.sourceMap ? "external" : undefined,
  49| |      });
  51| |      finalCode = result.code;
  52| |      map = result.map;
  53| |    }
  55| |    const outPath = join(opts.outDir, opts.outFile);
  57| |    if (opts.sourceMap && map) {
  58| |      finalCode += `\n//# sourceMappingURL=${opts.outFile}.map`;
  59| |      writeFileSync(outPath, finalCode);
  60| |      writeFileSync(outPath + ".map", map);
  61| |    } else {
  62| |      writeFileSync(outPath, finalCode);
  63| |    }
  65| |    logger.info(
  66| |      `Linked → ${outPath} (${(Buffer.byteLength(finalCode) / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`
  67| |    );
  69| |    return outPath;
  70| |  });
