---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Segment Trie — Refactored into small, pure, composable functions.
   3| | * All operations are pure: they return new nodes rather than mutating.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { RouteDef, SegNode, Terminal, HttpMethod } from "../types";
   7| |import { segmentHash } from "./hash";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Node Factory — Pure
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13| |/**
  14| | * Create a fresh trie node with default empty children.
  15| | * @param {number} depth - Node depth in the trie (0 = root)
  16| | * @returns {SegNode} New immutable trie node
  17| | */
  18|▼|export const createSegNode = (depth = 0): SegNode => ({
  19| |  terminals: new Map(),
  20| |  staticChildren: new Map(),
  21| |  paramChild: null,
  22| |  catchAll: new Map(),
  23| |  depth,
  24| |});
  26| |// ============================================================================
  27| |// Terminal Creation — Pure
  28| |// ============================================================================
  30| |/**
  31| | * Build a Terminal record from a RouteDef.
  32| | * @param {RouteDef} route - Route definition
  33| | * @param {number} routeIdx - Route index for reference
  34| | * @returns {Terminal} Terminal node data
  35| | */
  36|▼|export const createTerminal = (route: RouteDef, routeIdx: number): Terminal => ({
  37| |  method: route.method,
  38| |  handlerRef: route.handlerRef,
  39| |  schemaRef: route.schemaRef,
  40| |  paramNames: route.paramNames,
  41| |  routeIdx,
  42| |});
  44| |// ============================================================================
  45| |// Segment Classification — Pure
  46| |// ============================================================================
  48| |/**
  49| | * Check if a segment is a catch-all parameter ([...name]).
  50| | * @param {string} seg - Path segment
  51| | * @returns {boolean} True if catch-all
  52| | */
  53|▼|export const isCatchAllSegment = (seg: string): boolean => seg.startsWith("*");
  55| |/**
  56| | * Check if a segment is a named parameter (:name).
  57| | * @param {string} seg - Path segment
  58| | * @returns {boolean} True if parameter
  59| | */
  60|▼|export const isParamSegment = (seg: string): boolean => seg.startsWith(":");
  62| |/**
  63| | * Extract parameter name from a segment.
  64| | * @param {string} seg - Parameter segment
  65| | * @returns {string} Parameter name without prefix
  66| | */
  67|▼|export const extractParamName = (seg: string): string =>
  68| |  isCatchAllSegment(seg) ? seg.slice(1) : seg.slice(1);
  70| |// ============================================================================
  71| |// Node Updates — Pure, Immutable
  72| |// ============================================================================
  74| |/**
  75| | * Attach a terminal to a node, returning a new node.
  76| | * @param {SegNode} node - Target node
  77| | * @param {HttpMethod} method - HTTP method
  78| | * @param {Terminal} terminal - Terminal data
  79| | * @returns {SegNode} New node with terminal attached
  80| | */
  81|▼|export const attachTerminal = (
  82| |  node: SegNode,
  83| |  method: HttpMethod,
  84| |  terminal: Terminal
  85| |): SegNode => {
  86| |  const newTerminals = new Map(node.terminals);
  87| |  newTerminals.set(method, terminal);
  88| |  return { ...node, terminals: newTerminals };
  89| |};
  91| |/**
  92| | * Attach a catch-all handler to a node, returning a new node.
  93| | * @param {SegNode} node - Target node
  94| | * @param {HttpMethod} method - HTTP method
  95| | * @param {string} name - Catch-all parameter name
  96| | * @param {string} handlerRef - Handler reference
  97| | * @param {string | null} schemaRef - Schema reference
  98| | * @returns {SegNode} New node with catch-all attached
  99| | */
 100|▼|export const attachCatchAll = (
 101| |  node: SegNode,
 102| |  method: HttpMethod,
 103| |  name: string,
 104| |  handlerRef: string,
 105| |  schemaRef: string | null
 106| |): SegNode => {
 107| |  const newCatchAll = new Map(node.catchAll);
 108| |  newCatchAll.set(method, { name, handlerRef, schemaRef });
 109| |  return { ...node, catchAll: newCatchAll };
 110| |};
 112| |/**
 113| | * Attach or update a param child, returning a new node.
 114| | * @param {SegNode} node - Target node
 115| | * @param {string} name - Parameter name
 116| | * @param {SegNode} child - Child node
 117| | * @returns {SegNode} New node with param child updated
 118| | */
 119|▼|export const attachParamChild = (
 120| |  node: SegNode,
 121| |  name: string,
 122| |  child: SegNode
 123| |): SegNode => ({
 124| |  ...node,
 125| |  paramChild: { name, child },
 126| |});
 128| |/**
 129| | * Attach or update a static child, returning a new node.
 130| | * @param {SegNode} node - Target node
 131| | * @param {string} seg - Static segment
 132| | * @param {SegNode} child - Child node
 133| | * @returns {SegNode} New node with static child updated
 134| | */
 135|▼|export const attachStaticChild = (
 136| |  node: SegNode,
 137| |  seg: string,
 138| |  child: SegNode
 139| |): SegNode => {
 140| |  const newStaticChildren = new Map(node.staticChildren);
 141| |  newStaticChildren.set(seg, child);
 142| |  return { ...node, staticChildren: newStaticChildren };
 143| |};
 145| |// ============================================================================
 146| |// Route Insertion — Pure, Recursive
 147| |// ============================================================================
 149| |/**
 150| | * Split a path into segments.
 151| | * @param {string} path - Route path
 152| | * @returns {string[]} Non-empty segments
 153| | */
 154|▼|export const splitPath = (path: string): string[] =>
 155| |  path.split("/").filter(Boolean);
 157| |/**
 158| | * Insert a route into a trie at a specific segment index.
 159| | * Recursive helper that rebuilds the path from root to leaf.
 160| | * @param {SegNode} node - Current trie node
 161| | * @param {RouteDef} route - Route to insert
 162| | * @param {readonly string[]} segs - Path segments
 163| | * @param {number} segIdx - Current segment index
 164| | * @returns {SegNode} New trie with route inserted
 165| | */
 166|▼|export const insertAt = (
 167| |  node: SegNode,
 168| |  route: RouteDef,
 169| |  segs: readonly string[],
 170| |  segIdx: number
 171| |): SegNode => {
 172| |  // Leaf: attach terminal
 173| |  if (segIdx >= segs.length) {
 174| |    const routeIdx = parseInt(route.handlerRef.slice(2)) || 0;
 175| |    return attachTerminal(node, route.method, createTerminal(route, routeIdx));
 176| |  }
 178| |  const seg = segs[segIdx]!;
 180| |  // Catch-all segment
 181| |  if (isCatchAllSegment(seg)) {
 182| |    return attachCatchAll(
 183| |      node,
 184| |      route.method,
 185| |      extractParamName(seg),
 186| |      route.handlerRef,
 187| |      route.schemaRef
 188| |    );
 189| |  }
 191| |  // Param segment
 192| |  if (isParamSegment(seg)) {
 193| |    const existing = node.paramChild;
 194| |    if (!existing) {
 195| |      return attachParamChild(
 196| |        node,
 197| |        extractParamName(seg),
 198| |        insertAt(createSegNode(node.depth + 1), route, segs, segIdx + 1)
 199| |      );
 200| |    }
 201| |    return attachParamChild(
 202| |      node,
 203| |      existing.name,
 204| |      insertAt(existing.child, route, segs, segIdx + 1)
 205| |    );
 206| |  }
 208| |  // Static segment
 209| |  const child = node.staticChildren.get(seg);
 210| |  if (!child) {
 211| |    return attachStaticChild(
 212| |      node,
 213| |      seg,
 214| |      insertAt(createSegNode(node.depth + 1), route, segs, segIdx + 1)
 215| |    );
 216| |  }
 217| |  return attachStaticChild(node, seg, insertAt(child, route, segs, segIdx + 1));
 218| |};
 220| |/**
 221| | * Insert a route into a trie. Returns a NEW trie (immutable update).
 222| | * @param {SegNode} root - Root trie node
 223| | * @param {RouteDef} route - Route to insert
 224| | * @returns {SegNode} New trie with route inserted
 225| | */
 226|▼|export const insertRoute = (root: SegNode, route: RouteDef): SegNode =>
 227| |  insertAt(root, route, splitPath(route.path), 0);
 229| |// ============================================================================
 230| |// Trie Construction — Pure
 231| |// ============================================================================
 233| |/**
 234| | * Filter routes to only dynamic ones.
 235| | * @param {readonly RouteDef[]} routes - All routes
 236| | * @returns {RouteDef[]} Dynamic routes only
 237| | */
 238|▼|export const filterDynamicRoutes = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] =>
 239| |  routes.filter((r) => r.isDynamic);
 241| |/**
 242| | * Build a trie from dynamic routes only.
 243| | * Static routes are handled by the jump table.
 244| | * @param {readonly RouteDef[]} routes - All routes
 245| | * @returns {SegNode} Root trie node
 246| | */
 247|▼|export const buildTrie = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): SegNode => {
 248| |  const dynamicRoutes = filterDynamicRoutes(routes);
 249| |  let root = createSegNode(0);
 250| |  for (const route of dynamicRoutes) {
 251| |    root = insertRoute(root, route);
 252| |  }
 253| |  return root;
 254| |};
 256| |// ============================================================================
 257| |// Unreachable Route Detection — Pure
 258| |// ============================================================================
 260| |/**
 261| | * Check if a route is shadowed by a catch-all at the current trie level.
 262| | * @param {SegNode} node - Current trie node
 263| | * @param {HttpMethod} method - HTTP method
 264| | * @returns {boolean} True if catch-all exists for method
 265| | */
 266|▼|export const hasCatchAllForMethod = (node: SegNode, method: HttpMethod): boolean =>
 267| |  node.catchAll.has(method);
 269| |/**
 270| | * Navigate to the next trie node based on segment type.
 271| | * @param {SegNode} node - Current node
 272| | * @param {string} seg - Path segment
 273| | * @returns {SegNode | null} Next node, or null if path breaks
 274| | */
 275|▼|export const navigateSegment = (node: SegNode, seg: string): SegNode | null => {
 276| |  if (isParamSegment(seg)) {
 277| |    return node.paramChild?.child ?? null;
 278| |  }
 279| |  if (isCatchAllSegment(seg)) {
 280| |    return null; // catch-all terminates navigation
 281| |  }
 282| |  return node.staticChildren.get(seg) ?? null;
 283| |};
 285| |/**
 286| | * Check if a dynamic route is unreachable due to shadowing.
 287| | * @param {SegNode} root - Trie root
 288| | * @param {RouteDef} route - Route to check
 289| | * @returns {boolean} True if unreachable
 290| | */
 291|▼|export const isUnreachableDynamic = (root: SegNode, route: RouteDef): boolean => {
 292| |  const segs = splitPath(route.path);
 293| |  let node = root;
 295| |  for (let i = 0; i < segs.length; i++) {
 296| |    if (hasCatchAllForMethod(node, route.method)) {
 297| |      return true;
 298| |    }
 300| |    const seg = segs[i]!;
 301| |    if (isCatchAllSegment(seg)) return false; // route IS the catch-all
 303| |    const next = navigateSegment(node, seg);
 304| |    if (!next) return false;
 305| |    node = next;
 306| |  }
 307| |  return false;
 308| |};
 310| |/**
 311| | * Create a unique key for route deduplication.
 312| | * @param {RouteDef} route - Route
 313| | * @returns {string} Key like "GET:/users"
 314| | */
 315|▼|export const routeKey = (route: RouteDef): string => `${route.method}:${route.path}`;
 317| |/**
 318| | * Find duplicate static routes.
 319| | * @param {readonly RouteDef[]} staticRoutes - Static routes
 320| | * @returns {RouteDef[]} Duplicate routes
 321| | */
 322|▼|export const findDuplicateStatics = (staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] => {
 323| |  const seen = new Map<string, RouteDef>();
 324| |  const duplicates: RouteDef[] = [];
 326| |  for (const route of staticRoutes) {
 327| |    const key = routeKey(route);
 328| |    if (seen.has(key)) {
 329| |      duplicates.push(route);
 330| |    } else {
 331| |      seen.set(key, route);
 332| |    }
 333| |  }
 334| |  return duplicates;
 335| |};
 337| |/**
 338| | * Detect unreachable routes shadowed by catch-all or param conflicts.
 339| | * @param {SegNode} root - Trie root
 340| | * @param {readonly RouteDef[]} staticRoutes - Static routes
 341| | * @returns {RouteDef[]} Unreachable routes
 342| | */
 343|▼|export const detectUnreachable = (
 344| |  root: SegNode,
 345| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[]
 346| |): RouteDef[] => findDuplicateStatics(staticRoutes);
 348| |// ============================================================================
 349| |// Statistics — Pure
 350| |// ============================================================================
 352| |/**
 353| | * Calculate branching factor for a single node.
 354| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie node
 355| | * @returns {number} Number of child edges
 356| | */
 357|▼|export const nodeBranchCount = (node: SegNode): number =>
 358| |  node.staticChildren.size + (node.paramChild ? 1 : 0);
 360| |/**
 361| | * Recursively collect trie statistics.
 362| | * @param {SegNode} node - Current node
 363| | * @param {number} depth - Current depth
 364| | * @returns {{ maxDepth: number; totalNodes: number; totalBranches: number }} Accumulated stats
 365| | */
 366| |export const collectTrieStats = (
 367| |  node: SegNode,
 368| |  depth: number
 369| |): { maxDepth: number; totalNodes: number; totalBranches: number } => {
 370| |  let maxDepth = depth;
 371| |  let totalNodes = 1;
 372| |  let totalBranches = nodeBranchCount(node);
 374| |  for (const child of node.staticChildren.values()) {
 375| |    const childStats = collectTrieStats(child, depth + 1);
 376| |    maxDepth = Math.max(maxDepth, childStats.maxDepth);
 377| |    totalNodes += childStats.totalNodes;
 378| |    totalBranches += childStats.totalBranches;
 379| |  }
 381| |  if (node.paramChild) {
 382| |    const childStats = collectTrieStats(node.paramChild.child, depth + 1);
 383| |    maxDepth = Math.max(maxDepth, childStats.maxDepth);
 384| |    totalNodes += childStats.totalNodes;
 385| |    totalBranches += childStats.totalBranches;
 386| |  }
 388| |  return { maxDepth, totalNodes, totalBranches };
 389| |};
 391| |/**
 392| | * Compute trie statistics for optimization decisions.
 393| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie root
 394| | * @returns {{ maxDepth: number; totalNodes: number; avgBranching: number }} Trie stats
 395| | */
 396| |export const trieStats = (node: SegNode): { maxDepth: number; totalNodes: number; avgBranching: number } => {
 397| |  const stats = collectTrieStats(node, 0);
 398| |  return {
 399| |    maxDepth: stats.maxDepth,
 400| |    totalNodes: stats.totalNodes,
 401| |    avgBranching: stats.totalNodes > 1 ? stats.totalBranches / (stats.totalNodes - 1) : 0,
 402| |  };
 403| |};
 405| |// ============================================================================
 406| |// Pretty Printing — Pure
 407| |// ============================================================================
 409| |/**
 410| | * Generate indentation string.
 411| | * @param {number} level - Indentation level
 412| | * @returns {string} Spaces for indentation
 413| | */
 414|▼|export const indent = (level: number): string => "  ".repeat(level);
 416| |/**
 417| | * Pretty-print terminal entries at a node.
 418| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie node
 419| | * @param {number} level - Indentation level
 420| | * @returns {string} Formatted terminal lines
 421| | */
 422|▼|export const printTerminals = (node: SegNode, level: number): string => {
 423| |  let out = "";
 424| |  for (const [method, term] of node.terminals) {
 425| |    out += `${indent(level)}[${method}] → ${term.handlerRef}\n`;
 426| |  }
 427| |  return out;
 428| |};
 430| |/**
 431| | * Pretty-print static children.
 432| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie node
 433| | * @param {number} level - Indentation level
 434| | * @returns {string} Formatted child lines
 435| | */
 436|▼|export const printStaticChildren = (node: SegNode, level: number): string => {
 437| |  let out = "";
 438| |  for (const [seg, child] of node.staticChildren) {
 439| |    out += `${indent(level)}"${seg}"\n`;
 440| |    out += printTrie(child, level + 1);
 441| |  }
 442| |  return out;
 443| |};
 445| |/**
 446| | * Pretty-print param child.
 447| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie node
 448| | * @param {number} level - Indentation level
 449| | * @returns {string} Formatted param line
 450| | */
 451|▼|export const printParamChild = (node: SegNode, level: number): string => {
 452| |  if (!node.paramChild) return "";
 453| |  return (
 454| |    `${indent(level)}:${node.paramChild.name}\n` +
 455| |    printTrie(node.paramChild.child, level + 1)
 456| |  );
 457| |};
 459| |/**
 460| | * Pretty-print catch-all entries.
 461| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie node
 462| | * @param {number} level - Indentation level
 463| | * @returns {string} Formatted catch-all lines
 464| | */
 465|▼|export const printCatchAlls = (node: SegNode, level: number): string => {
 466| |  let out = "";
 467| |  for (const [method, ca] of node.catchAll) {
 468| |    out += `${indent(level)}*${ca.name} [${method}]\n`;
 469| |  }
 470| |  return out;
 471| |};
 473| |/**
 474| | * Pretty-print a trie for debugging. Pure (returns string).
 475| | * @param {SegNode} node - Trie root
 476| | * @param {number} level - Current indentation level
 477| | * @returns {string} Human-readable trie representation
 478| | */
 479|▼|export const printTrie = (node: SegNode, level = 0): string =>
 480| |  printTerminals(node, level) +
 481| |  printStaticChildren(node, level) +
 482| |  printParamChild(node, level) +
 483| |  printCatchAlls(node, level);

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 4: CODE GENERATION — BUN NATIVE PERFORMANCE MODE
   3| | *
   4| | * Output strategy:
   5| | * - Use Bun.serve({ routes }) native router.
   6| | * - Use method-specific route objects where possible.
   7| | * - Use static Response objects for constant routes where possible.
   8| | * - Avoid context allocation unless required.
   9| | * - Avoid URL/query/body parsing unless required.
  10| | * - Add tracing/lifecycle only when enabled.
  11| | */
  12| |import { fnv1a } from "../utils/hash";
  13| |import type {
  14| |  RouteDef,
  15| |  ModuleInfo,
  16| |  SegNode,
  17| |  JumpTable,
  18| |  CompilerOptions,
  19| |  HookDef,
  20| |} from "../types";
  22| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  23| |import { join, dirname, relative } from "path";
  25| |// ============================================================================
  26| |// Config
  27| |// ============================================================================
  32|▼|interface CodegenConfig {
  33| |  tracing: boolean;
  34| |  accessLog: boolean;
  35| |  traceHeaders: boolean;
  36| |  lifecycle: boolean;
  37| |  strictMethods: boolean;
  38| |  fastBody: boolean;

  40| |  requestIdHeader: string;
  41| |  exposeErrorDetails: boolean;
  42| |}
  44|▼|const getConfig = (opts: CompilerOptions): CodegenConfig => {
  45| |  const tracing = opts.enableTracing ?? true;
  47| |  return {
  48| |    tracing,
  49| |    accessLog: opts.enableAccessLog ?? tracing,
  50| |    traceHeaders: opts.enableTraceHeaders ?? tracing,
  51| |    lifecycle: opts.enableLifecycle ?? true,
  52| |    strictMethods: opts.enableStrictMethods ?? true,
  53| |    fastBody: opts.enableFastBodyParsing ?? false,
  54| |    serviceName: opts.serviceName ?? "flux",
  55| |    requestIdHeader: (opts.requestIdHeader ?? "x-request-id").toLowerCase(),
  56| |    exposeErrorDetails: opts.exposeErrorDetails ?? false,
  57| |  };
  58| |};
  60| |// ============================================================================
  61| |// Naming Helpers
  62| |// ============================================================================
  64|▼|const normalizeImportPath = (p: string): string => {
  65| |  let s = p
  66| |    .replace(/\\/g, "/")
  67| |    .replace(/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs|jsx)$/, "");
  69| |  if (!s.startsWith(".")) {
  70| |    s = "./" + s;
  71| |  }
  73| |  return s;
  74| |};
  76|▼|const hookIdent = (name: string): string =>
  77| |  `hook_${name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_$]/g, "_")}`;
  79|▼|const handlerImportName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  80| |  `handler_${route.handlerRef}`;
  82|▼|const methodHandlerName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  83| |  `${route.method}_${route.handlerRef}`;
  85|▼|const finalizeName = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  86| |  `finalize_${route.handlerRef}`;
  88|▼|const pathHandlerName = (path: string): string =>
  89| |  `route_path_${path
  90| |    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]+/g, "_")
  91| |    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "") || "root"
  92| |  }`;
  94|▼|const constantBodyVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  95| |  `BODY_${route.handlerRef}`;
  97|▼|const constantInitVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
  98| |  `INIT_${route.handlerRef}`;
 100|▼|const staticResponseVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 101| |  `STATIC_${route.handlerRef}`;
 103|▼|const hooksArrayVar = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 104| |  `HOOKS_${route.handlerRef}`;
 108| |// ============================================================================
 109| |// Route Analysis Helpers
 110| |// ============================================================================
 112|▼|const tryNormalizeConstant = (route: RouteDef): string | null => {
 113| |  if (!route.isConstantResponse || !route.constantResponse) return null;
 114| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return null;
 116| |  try {
 117| |    JSON.parse(route.constantResponse);
 118| |    return route.constantResponse;
 119| |  } catch {
 120| |    // Continue.
 121| |  }
 123| |  try {
 124| |    const expr = route.constantResponse
 125| |      .replace(/^return\s+/, "")
 126| |      .replace(/;\s*$/, "")
 127| |      .trim();
 129| |    const value = new Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`)();
 130| |    return JSON.stringify(value);
 131| |  } catch {
 132| |    return null;
 133| |  }
 134| |};
 136|▼|const needsRequestBody = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
 137| |  route.usage.body &&
 138| |  route.method !== "GET" &&
 139| |  route.method !== "HEAD" &&
 140| |  route.method !== "OPTIONS";
 142|▼|const needsFileBody = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
 143| |  route.usage.file && needsRequestBody(route);
 145|▼|const routeReplyFn = (route: RouteDef): string => {
 146| |  if (route.responseType === "text") return "textReply";
 147| |  if (route.responseType === "html") return "htmlReply";
 148| |  if (route.responseType === "stream") return "streamReply";
 149| |  return "jsonReply";
 150| |};
 152|▼|const validHookNames = (
 153| |  route: RouteDef,
 154| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>
 155| |): string[] => route.hooks.filter((name) => hooks.has(name));
 157| |// ============================================================================
 158| |// Finalizer Generation
 159| |// ============================================================================
 161|▼|const generateFinalizer = (route: RouteDef): string => {
 162| |  const reply = routeReplyFn(route);
 164| |  return `function ${finalizeName(route)}(result) {
 165| |  if (result instanceof Response) return result;
 166| |  return ${reply}(result);
 167| |}`;
 168| |};
 170| |// ============================================================================
 171| |// Method Handler Generation
 172| |// ============================================================================
 174|▼|const generateMethodHandler = (
 175| |  route: RouteDef,
 176| |  constantJson: string | null,
 177| |  cfg: CodegenConfig,
 178| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>
 179| |): string => {
 180| |  const name = methodHandlerName(route);
 182|▼|  const finish = (expr: string): string =>
 183| |    cfg.tracing ? `finishTrace(req, trace, ${expr})` : expr;
 185|▼|  const finishErr = (expr: string): string =>
 186| |    cfg.tracing
 187| |      ? `finishTraceError(req, trace, ${expr})`
 188| |      : `errorResponse(${expr})`;
 190| |  // Constant response handler.
 191| |  if (constantJson !== null) {
 192| |    const traceLine = cfg.tracing ? "const trace = startTrace(req);" : "";
 193| |    const responseExpr = `new Response(${constantBodyVar(route)}, ${constantInitVar(route)})`;
 195| |    return `function ${name}(req) {
 196| |  ${traceLine}
 197| |  return ${cfg.tracing ? finish(responseExpr) : responseExpr};
 198| |}`;
 199| |  }
 201| |  const hookNames = validHookNames(route, hooks);
 202| |  const hasHooks = cfg.lifecycle && hookNames.length > 0;
 204| |  const body = needsRequestBody(route);
 205| |  const file = needsFileBody(route);
 207| |  const isAsync = route.isAsync || body || file || hasHooks;
 209| |  const pre: string[] = [];
 211| |  if (cfg.tracing) {
 212| |    pre.push("const trace = startTrace(req);");
 213| |  }
 215| |  if (route.usage.url || route.usage.query) {
 216| |    pre.push("const url = new URL(req.url);");
 217| |  }
 219| |  if (route.usage.query) {
 220| |    pre.push("const query = url.searchParams;");
 221| |  }
 223| |  const usesBody = needsRequestBody(route) || route.usage.file;
 225| |  if (usesBody) {
 226| |    pre.push("const body = createLazyBody(req, BODY_LIMITS);");
 227| |  }
 229| |  if (route.usage.state) {
 230| |    pre.push("const state = new Map();");
 231| |  }
 233| |  if (hasHooks) {
 234| |    pre.push(
 235| |      `const ctx = createFluxContext(req, req.params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS, ${route.usage.query ? "query" : "undefined"
 236| |      });`
 237| |    );
 239| |    if (body) {
 240| |      pre.push("ctx.body = body;");
 241| |    }
 243| |    pre.push(`const halted = await runHooks(${hooksArrayVar(route)}, ctx);`);
 244| |    pre.push(`if (halted) return ${finish("halted")};`);
 245| |  }
 247|▼|  const minimalCallExpr = (): string => {
 248| |    const props: string[] = [];
 250| |    if (route.usage.params) {
 251| |      props.push("params: req.params ?? EMPTY_PARAMS");
 252| |    }
 254| |    if (route.usage.body && body) {
 255| |      props.push("body");
 256| |    }
 258| |    if (route.usage.query) {
 259| |      props.push("query");
 260| |    }
 262| |    if (route.usage.body || route.usage.file) {
 263| |      props.push("body");
 264| |    }
 266| |    if (route.usage.headers) {
 267| |      props.push("headers: req.headers");
 268| |    }
 270| |    if (route.usage.req) {
 271| |      props.push("req");
 272| |    }
 274| |    if (route.usage.url) {
 275| |      props.push("url");
 276| |    }
 278| |    if (route.usage.state) {
 279| |      props.push("state");
 280| |      props.push("getState: (key) => state.get(key)");
 281| |      props.push("setState: (key, value) => { state.set(key, value); }");
 282| |    }
 284| |    if (route.usage.json) {
 285| |      props.push("json: jsonReply");
 286| |    }
 288| |    if (route.usage.text) {
 289| |      props.push("text: textReply");
 290| |    }
 292| |    if (route.usage.redirect) {
 293| |      props.push("redirect: redirectReply");
 294| |    }
 296| |    if (route.responseType === "html") {
 297| |      props.push("html: htmlReply");
 298| |    }
 300| |    if (route.responseType === "stream") {
 301| |      props.push("stream: streamReply");
 302| |    }
 304| |    if (props.length === 0) {
 305| |      return `${handlerImportName(route)}()`;
 306| |    }
 308| |    return `${handlerImportName(route)}({ ${props.join(", ")} })`;
 309| |  };
 311| |  const callExpr = hasHooks
 312| |    ? `${handlerImportName(route)}(ctx)`
 313| |    : minimalCallExpr();
 315| |  if (isAsync) {
 316| |    pre.push(`const result = await ${callExpr};`);
 317| |    pre.push(`return ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(result)`)};`);
 319| |    return `async function ${name}(req) {
 320| |  try {
 321| |    ${pre.join("\n    ")}
 322| |  } catch (err) {
 323| |    return ${finishErr("err")};
 324| |  }
 325| |}`;
 326| |  }
 328| |  // Sync fast path with promise escape hatch.
 329| |  const lines = [...pre];
 331| |  lines.push(`const result = ${callExpr};`);
 332| |  lines.push(`if (result instanceof Response) return ${finish("result")};`);
 333| |  lines.push(
 334| |    `if (result && typeof result.then === "function") {
 335| |      return result
 336| |        .then((v) => ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(v)`)})
 337| |        .catch((err) => ${finishErr("err")});
 338| |    }`
 339| |  );
 340| |  lines.push(`return ${finish(`${finalizeName(route)}(result)`)};`);
 342| |  return `function ${name}(req) {
 343| |  try {
 344| |    ${lines.join("\n    ")}
 345| |  } catch (err) {
 346| |    return ${finishErr("err")};
 347| |  }
 348| |}`;
 349| |};
 351| |// ============================================================================
 352| |// Main Server Generation
 353| |// ============================================================================
 355|▼|export const generateServer = (
 356| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 357| |  _trie: SegNode,
 358| |  _jumpTable: JumpTable,
 359| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 360| |  hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>,
 361| |  _buffers: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
 362| |  opts: CompilerOptions
 363| |): string => {
 364| |  const cfg = getConfig(opts);
 365| |  const BODY_LIMITS = JSON.stringify({
 366| |    maxJsonBytes: opts.maxJsonBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 367| |    maxTextBytes: opts.maxTextBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 368| |    maxFormBytes: opts.maxFormBytes ?? 2 * 1024 * 1024,
 369| |    maxFileBytes: opts.maxFileBytes ?? 20 * 1024 * 1024,
 370| |  });
 372| |  const fromDir = dirname(join(process.cwd(), opts.outDir, opts.outFile));
 374|▼|  const toImportPath = (absPath: string): string =>
 375| |    normalizeImportPath(relative(fromDir, absPath));
 377|▼|  const runtimeImport = (projectPath: string): string =>
 378| |    toImportPath(join(process.cwd(), projectPath));
 380| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 381| |  // Constants / route grouping
 382| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 384| |  const constantMap = new Map<string, string | null>();
 386| |  for (const route of routes) {
 387| |    constantMap.set(route.handlerRef, tryNormalizeConstant(route));
 388| |  }
 390| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
 392| |  for (const route of routes) {
 393| |    const arr = groups.get(route.path) ?? [];
 394| |    arr.push(route);
 395| |    groups.set(route.path, arr);
 396| |  }
 398| |  const staticRouteRefs = new Set<string>();
 400| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
 401| |    if (!cfg.strictMethods && !cfg.tracing && group.length === 1) {
 402| |      const route = group[0]!;
 404| |      if (
 405| |        (route.method === "GET" || route.method === "ALL") &&
 406| |        constantMap.get(route.handlerRef) !== null
 407| |      ) {
 408| |        staticRouteRefs.add(route.handlerRef);
 409| |      }
 410| |    }
 411| |  }
 413| |  const nonConstantRoutes = routes.filter(
 414| |    (r) => constantMap.get(r.handlerRef) === null
 415| |  );
 417| |  const anyNonConstant = nonConstantRoutes.length > 0;
 419| |  const anyBody = nonConstantRoutes.some(
 420| |    (r) => needsRequestBody(r) && !needsFileBody(r)
 421| |  );
 423| |  const anyFile = nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => needsFileBody(r));
 425| |  const anyHooks =
 426| |    cfg.lifecycle &&
 427| |    routes.some((r) => validHookNames(r, hooks).length > 0);
 429| |  const anyJson =
 430| |    anyNonConstant ||
 431| |    anyHooks ||
 432| |    nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "json" || r.usage.json);
 434| |  const anyText =
 435| |    anyHooks ||
 436| |    nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "text" || r.usage.text);
 438| |  const anyHtml =
 439| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "html");
 441| |  const anyStream =
 442| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.responseType === "stream");
 444| |  const anyRedirect =
 445| |    anyHooks || nonConstantRoutes.some((r) => r.usage.redirect);
 447| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 448| |  // Imports
 449| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 451| |  const handlerImports = nonConstantRoutes
 452| |    .map((route) => {
 453| |      const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
 455| |      if (!mod) return "";
 457| |      return `import { default as ${handlerImportName(
 458| |        route
 459| |      )} } from "${toImportPath(mod.path)}";`;
 460| |    })
 461| |    .filter((s) => s.length > 0)
 462| |    .join("\n");
 464| |  const missingStubs = nonConstantRoutes
 465| |    .filter((route) => !modules[route.moduleIdx])
 466| |    .map((route) => {
 467| |      return `function ${handlerImportName(route)}() {
 468| |  throw new Error(${JSON.stringify(`Missing module for ${route.file}`)});
 469| |}`;
 470| |    })
 471| |    .join("\n");
 473| |  const hookImports = anyHooks
 474| |    ? Array.from(hooks.values())
 475| |      .map((h) => {
 476| |        const abs = join(process.cwd(), h.source);
 478| |        return `import { default as ${hookIdent(
 479| |          h.name
 480| |        )} } from "${toImportPath(abs)}";`;
 481| |      })
 482| |      .join("\n")
 483| |    : "";
 485| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 486| |  // Runtime constants
 487| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 489| |  const baseConstants = `const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 490| |const JSON_INIT = { headers: HDR_JSON };
 491| |const BODY_LIMITS = ${BODY_LIMITS};
 492| |const NOT_FOUND_BODY = '{"error":"Not Found"}';
 493| |const NOT_FOUND_INIT = { status: 404, headers: HDR_JSON };
 495| |const METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_BODY = '{"error":"Method Not Allowed"}';
 496| |const METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_INIT = { status: 405, headers: HDR_JSON };
 498| |const INTERNAL_ERROR_BODY = '{"error":"Internal Server Error"}';
 499| |const INTERNAL_ERROR_INIT = { status: 500, headers: HDR_JSON };
 501| |const EMPTY_PARAMS = Object.freeze({});
 503| |const SERVICE = ${JSON.stringify(cfg.serviceName)};
 504| |const REQUEST_ID_HEADER = ${JSON.stringify(cfg.requestIdHeader)};
 505| |const ACCESS_LOG = ${cfg.accessLog};
 506| |const TRACE_HEADERS = ${cfg.traceHeaders};
 507| |const EXPOSE_ERRORS = ${cfg.exposeErrorDetails};
 509| |const STATUS_TEXT = {
 510| |  400: "Bad Request",
 511| |  401: "Unauthorized",
 512| |  403: "Forbidden",
 513| |  404: "Not Found",
 514| |  405: "Method Not Allowed",
 515| |  409: "Conflict",
 516| |  422: "Unprocessable Entity",
 517| |  429: "Too Many Requests",
 518| |  500: "Internal Server Error",
 519| |};`;
 521| |  const constantLines: string[] = [];
 523| |  for (const route of routes) {
 524| |    const json = constantMap.get(route.handlerRef);
 526| |    if (json == null) continue;
 528| |    constantLines.push(
 529| |      `const ${constantBodyVar(route)} = ${JSON.stringify(json)};`
 530| |    );
 532| |    constantLines.push(
 533| |      `const ${constantInitVar(route)} = { status: 200, headers: HDR_JSON };`
 534| |    );
 536| |    if (staticRouteRefs.has(route.handlerRef)) {
 537| |      constantLines.push(
 538| |        `const ${staticResponseVar(route)} = new Response(${constantBodyVar(
 539| |          route
 540| |        )}, ${constantInitVar(route)});`
 541| |      );
 542| |    }
 543| |  }
 545| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 546| |  // Runtime helpers
 547| |  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 549| |  const helpers: string[] = [];
 551| |  helpers.push(`function notFound() {
 552| |  return new Response(NOT_FOUND_BODY, NOT_FOUND_INIT);
 553| |}`);
 555| |  helpers.push(`function methodNotAllowed() {
 556| |  return new Response(METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_BODY, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED_INIT);
 557| |}`);
 559| |  helpers.push(`function errorResponse(err, traceId) {
 560| |  const status = err && typeof err.status === "number" ? err.status : 500;
 562| |  const message =
 563| |    EXPOSE_ERRORS && err instanceof Error
 564| |      ? err.message
 565| |      : STATUS_TEXT[status] || "Error";
 567| |  const payload = { error: message, status };
 569| |  if (traceId) payload.traceId = traceId;
 571| |  return Response.json(payload, { status });
 572| |}`);
 574| |  if (anyJson || anyHooks) {
 575| |    helpers.push(`function jsonReply(data, init) {
 576| |  if (!init) return Response.json(data, JSON_INIT);
 578| |  const headers = new Headers(HDR_JSON);
 580| |  if (init.headers) {
 581| |    new Headers(init.headers).forEach((value, key) => headers.set(key, value));
 582| |  }
 584| |  return Response.json(data, {
 585| |    status: init.status ?? 200,
 586| |    headers,
 587| |  });
 588| |}`);
 589| |  }
 591| |  if (anyText || anyHooks) {
 592| |    helpers.push(`const HDR_TEXT = { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" };
 593| |const TEXT_INIT = { headers: HDR_TEXT };
 595| |function textReply(data, init) {
 596| |  const body = typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
 598| |  if (!init) return new Response(body, TEXT_INIT);
 600| |  const headers = new Headers(HDR_TEXT);
 602| |  if (init.headers) {
 603| |    new Headers(init.headers).forEach((value, key) => headers.set(key, value));
 604| |  }
 606| |  return new Response(body, {
 607| |    status: init.status ?? 200,
 608| |    headers,
 609| |  });
 610| |}`);
 611| |  }
 613| |  if (anyHtml || anyHooks) {
 614| |    helpers.push(`const HDR_HTML = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
 615| |const HTML_INIT = { headers: HDR_HTML };
 617| |function htmlReply(data, init) {
 618| |  const body = typeof data === "string" ? data : JSON.stringify(data);
 620| |  if (!init) return new Response(body, HTML_INIT);
 622| |  const headers = new Headers(HDR_HTML);
 624| |  if (init.headers) {
 625| |    new Headers(init.headers).forEach((value, key) => headers.set(key, value));
 626| |  }
 628| |  return new Response(body, {
 629| |    status: init.status ?? 200,
 630| |    headers,
 631| |  });
 632| |}`);
 633| |  }
 635| |  if (anyStream || anyHooks) {
 636| |    helpers.push(`function streamReply(stream, init) {
 637| |  return new Response(stream, init);
 638| |}`);
 639| |  }
 641| |  if (anyRedirect || anyHooks) {
 642| |    helpers.push(`function redirectReply(location, status = 302) {
 643| |  return Response.redirect(location, status);
 644| |}`);
 645| |  }
 647| |  if (anyHooks) {
   ... (436 more lines)

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview HTTP caching primitives:
   3| | * - Cache-Control builder
   4| | * - ETag generation
   5| | * - mtime-based cache bursting
   6| | * - browser conditional requests
   7| | * - LRU-backed HTTP response cache
   8| | */
  10| |import { LRUCache } from "./lru";
  12|▼|export interface CacheControlOptions {
  13| |  maxAge?: number;
  14| |  sMaxAge?: number;
  15| |  swr?: number; // stale-while-revalidate seconds
  16| |  immutable?: boolean;
  17| |  noStore?: boolean;
  18| |  noCache?: boolean;
  19| |  public?: boolean;
  20| |  private?: boolean;
  21| |}
  23| |export interface BrowserCacheOptions extends CacheControlOptions {
  24| |  req?: Request;
  25| |  etag?: string;
  26| |  lastModified?: Date | string;
  27| |  vary?: string[];
  28| |}
  30|▼|export function cacheControl(opts: CacheControlOptions = {}): string {
  31| |  if (opts.noStore) return "no-store";
  32| |  if (opts.noCache) return "no-cache";
  34| |  const parts: string[] = [];
  36| |  if (opts.public) parts.push("public");
  37| |  if (opts.private) parts.push("private");
  39| |  if (opts.maxAge != null) {
  40| |    parts.push(`max-age=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.maxAge))}`);
  41| |  }
  43| |  if (opts.swr != null) {
  44| |    parts.push(`stale-while-revalidate=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.swr))}`);
  45| |  }
  47| |  if (opts.sMaxAge != null) {
  48| |    parts.push(`s-maxage=${Math.max(0, Math.floor(opts.sMaxAge))}`);
  49| |  }
  51| |  if (opts.immutable) parts.push("immutable");
  53| |  return parts.length > 0 ? parts.join(", ") : "no-cache";
  54| |}
  56|▼|function toBytes(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  57| |  if (typeof input === "string") return new TextEncoder().encode(input);
  58| |  if (input instanceof Uint8Array) return input;
  59| |  return new Uint8Array(input);
  60| |}
  62|▼|function fallbackHash(bytes: Uint8Array): bigint {
  63| |  let h = 0xcbf29ce484222325n;
  65| |  for (const b of bytes) {
  66| |    h ^= BigInt(b);
  67| |    h = (h * 0x100000001b3n) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
  68| |  }
  70| |  return h;
  71| |}
  73| |/**
  74| | * Fast non-cryptographic hash for cache keys and weak ETags.
  75| | * Uses Bun.hash when available.
  76| | */
  77|▼|export function fastHash(input: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): string {
  78| |  const bytes = toBytes(input);
  80| |  const bunHash = (Bun as any).hash;
  81| |  if (typeof bunHash === "function") {
  82| |    const h = bunHash(bytes);
  83| |    return (typeof h === "bigint" ? h : BigInt(h)).toString(36);
  84| |  }
  86| |  return fallbackHash(bytes).toString(36);
  87| |}
  89|▼|export function entityTag(
  90| |  body: string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array,
  91| |  weak = true
  92| |): string {
  93| |  return `${weak ? "W/" : ""}"${fastHash(body)}"`;
  94| |}
  96| |/**
  97| | * mtime-based cache burst version.
  98| | *
  99| | * Example:
 100| | *   mtimeVersion(stats.mtimeMs, stats.size)
 101| | *   => "m4k2j1-1a2b"
 102| | */
 103|▼|export function mtimeVersion(mtimeMs: number, size?: number): string {
 104| |  const mtime = Math.floor(mtimeMs).toString(36);
 105| |  return size ? `${mtime}-${size.toString(36)}` : mtime;
 106| |}
 108| |/**
 109| | * Append a cache-busting version to a URL.
 110| | */
 111|▼|export function withCacheBurst(url: string, version: string): string {
 112| |  const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
 113| |  return `${url}${sep}v=${encodeURIComponent(version)}`;
 114| |}
 116| |/**
 117| | * Apply browser cache headers and handle conditional requests.
 118| | */
 119|▼|export function withBrowserCache(
 120| |  response: Response,
 121| |  opts: BrowserCacheOptions = {}
 122| |): Response {
 123| |  const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
 125| |  if (opts.etag) headers.set("etag", opts.etag);
 127| |  const lastModified =
 128| |    opts.lastModified instanceof Date
 129| |      ? opts.lastModified.toUTCString()
 130| |      : opts.lastModified;
 132| |  if (lastModified) headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 134| |  if (!headers.has("cache-control")) {
 135| |    headers.set("cache-control", cacheControl(opts));
 136| |  }
 138| |  if (opts.vary?.length) {
 139| |    headers.set("vary", opts.vary.join(", "));
 140| |  }
 142| |  if (opts.req && response.status !== 304) {
 143| |    const inm = opts.req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 144| |    const ims = opts.req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
 146| |    const etagMatch =
 147| |      opts.etag && inm
 148| |        ? inm
 149| |            .split(",")
 150| |            .map((s) => s.trim())
 151| |            .includes(opts.etag)
 152| |        : false;
 154| |    const lastModifiedMatch =
 155| |      lastModified && ims
 156| |        ? new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()
 157| |        : false;
 159| |    if (etagMatch || lastModifiedMatch) {
 160| |      return new Response(null, { status: 304, headers });
 161| |    }
 162| |  }
 164| |  return new Response(response.body, {
 165| |    status: response.status,
 166| |    statusText: response.statusText,
 167| |    headers,
 168| |  });
 169| |}
 171| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172| |// HTTP response cache
 173| |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175|▼|export interface HttpResponseCacheOptions {
 176| |  max?: number;
 177| |  ttlMs?: number;
 178| |  staleTtlMs?: number;
 179| |  maxBytes?: number;
 180| |  maxBodyBytes?: number;
 181| |}
 183|▼|export interface CachedHttpResponse {
 184| |  status: number;
 185| |  statusText: string;
 186| |  headers: [string, string][];
 187| |  body: ArrayBuffer | null;
 188| |  etag?: string;
 189| |}
 191| |const HOP_HEADERS = new Set([
 192| |  "connection",
 193| |  "keep-alive",
 194| |  "proxy-authenticate",
 195| |  "proxy-authorization",
 196| |  "te",
 197| |  "trailer",
 198| |  "transfer-encoding",
 199| |  "upgrade",
 200| |  "content-length",
 201| |]);
 203|▼|function sanitizeHeaders(headers: Headers): [string, string][] {
 204| |  const out: [string, string][] = [];
 206| |  headers.forEach((value, key) => {
 207| |    const lower = key.toLowerCase();
 208| |    if (!HOP_HEADERS.has(lower)) {
 209| |      out.push([key, value]);
 210| |    }
 211| |  });
 213| |  return out;
 214| |}
 216|▼|function isCacheableResponse(response: Response): boolean {
 217| |  if (response.headers.has("set-cookie")) return false;
 219| |  const cc = response.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 220| |  if (cc.includes("no-store")) return false;
 221| |  if (cc.includes("private")) return false;
 223| |  return [200, 203, 204, 300, 301, 404, 410].includes(response.status);
 224| |}
 226|▼|export class HttpResponseCache {
 227| |  private lru: LRUCache<string, CachedHttpResponse>;
 228| |  private maxBodyBytes: number;
 230| |  constructor(opts: HttpResponseCacheOptions = {}) {
 231| |    this.maxBodyBytes = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_048_576;
 233| |    this.lru = new LRUCache({
 234| |      max: opts.max ?? 1000,
 235| |      ttlMs: opts.ttlMs ?? 60_000,
 236| |      staleTtlMs: opts.staleTtlMs ?? 300_000,
 237| |      maxBytes: opts.maxBytes ?? 64 * 1024 * 1024,
 238| |      sizeOf: (v) => (v.body?.byteLength ?? 0) + 512,
 239| |    });
 240| |  }
 242| |  key(req: Request, vary: string[] = []): string {
 243| |    const url = new URL(req.url);
 245| |    const varyKey = vary
 246| |      .map((h) => `${h.toLowerCase()}=${req.headers.get(h) ?? ""}`)
 247| |      .join("|");
 249| |    return `${req.method}:${url.pathname}${url.search}:${varyKey}`;
 250| |  }
 252| |  async get(req: Request, key: string): Promise<Response | null> {
 253| |    const stored = this.lru.get(key, { allowStale: true });
 254| |    if (!stored) return null;
 256| |    const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
 258| |    if (
 259| |      stored.etag &&
 260| |      inm &&
 261| |      inm
 262| |        .split(",")
 263| |        .map((s) => s.trim())
 264| |        .includes(stored.etag)
 265| |    ) {
 266| |      return new Response(null, {
 267| |        status: 304,
 268| |        headers: stored.headers,
 269| |      });
 270| |    }
 272| |    const headers = new Headers(stored.headers);
 273| |    headers.set("x-cache", "hit");
 275| |    return new Response(stored.body ? stored.body.slice(0) : null, {
 276| |      status: stored.status,
 277| |      statusText: stored.statusText,
 278| |      headers,
 279| |    });
 280| |  }
 282| |  async set(
 283| |    key: string,
 284| |    response: Response,
 285| |    opts: { ttlMs?: number; staleTtlMs?: number; etag?: boolean } = {}
 286| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 287| |    if (!isCacheableResponse(response)) return response;
 289| |    const clone = response.clone();
 290| |    const body = await clone.arrayBuffer();
 292| |    if (body.byteLength > this.maxBodyBytes) {
 293| |      return response;
 294| |    }
 296| |    const headers = sanitizeHeaders(response.headers);
 297| |    const etag = opts.etag === false ? undefined : entityTag(body);
 299| |    if (etag) {
 300| |      headers.push(["etag", etag]);
 301| |    }
 303| |    this.lru.set(
 304| |      key,
 305| |      {
 306| |        status: response.status,
 307| |        statusText: response.statusText,
 308| |        headers,
 309| |        body,
 310| |        etag,
 311| |      },
 312| |      opts
 313| |    );
 315| |    return response;
 316| |  }
 318| |  async getOrSet(
 319| |    req: Request,
 320| |    factory: () => Promise<Response>,
 321| |    opts: {
 322| |      ttlMs?: number;
 323| |      staleTtlMs?: number;
 324| |      vary?: string[];
 325| |      etag?: boolean;
 326| |    } = {}
 327| |  ): Promise<Response> {
 328| |    if (req.method !== "GET" && req.method !== "HEAD") {
 329| |      return factory();
 330| |    }
 332| |    const reqCc = req.headers.get("cache-control") || "";
 333| |    if (reqCc.includes("no-store")) {
 334| |      return factory();
 335| |    }
 337| |    const key = this.key(req, opts.vary);
 338| |    const hit = await this.get(req, key);
 340| |    if (hit) return hit;
 342| |    const response = await factory();
 343| |    return this.set(key, response, opts);
 344| |  }
 345| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview OpenAPI 3.1 Specification Generator.
   3| | * Auto-generates docs from route definitions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { RouteSchema, DocumentDecoration, HttpMethod } from "./types";
   8|▼|export interface OpenAPIInfo {
   9| |    title: string;
  10| |    version: string;
  11| |    description?: string;
  12| |}
  14|▼|export interface RouteDefinition {
  15| |    method: HttpMethod;
  16| |    path: string;
  17| |    schema?: RouteSchema;
  18| |    detail?: DocumentDecoration;
  19| |}
  21|▼|export const generateOpenAPI = (
  22| |    info: OpenAPIInfo,
  23| |    routes: RouteDefinition[]
  24| |): Record<string, unknown> => {
  25| |    const paths: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  27| |    for (const route of routes) {
  28| |        if (route.method === "ALL" || route.method === "WS") continue;
  30| |        const openApiPath = route.path
  31| |            .replace(/:(\w+)/g, "{$1}")
  32| |            .replace(/\*(\w+)/g, "{$1}");
  34| |        if (!paths[openApiPath]) paths[openApiPath] = {};
  36| |        const operation: Record<string, unknown> = {
  37| |            operationId: `${route.method.toLowerCase()}_${openApiPath.replace(/[{}\/]/g, "_")}`,
  38| |            ...route.detail,
  39| |            responses: { "200": { description: "Successful response" } },
  40| |        };
  42| |        if (route.schema?.params) {
  43| |            const schema = route.schema.params as any;
  44| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  46| |            operation.parameters = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  47| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  48| |                    name,
  49| |                    in: "path",
  50| |                    required: required.has(name),
  51| |                    schema: {
  52| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  53| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  54| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  55| |                    },
  56| |                })
  57| |            );
  58| |        }
  60| |        if (route.schema?.query) {
  61| |            const schema = route.schema.query as any;
  62| |            const required = new Set(schema.required ?? []);
  64| |            const queryParams = Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}).map(
  65| |                ([name, propSchema]: [string, any]) => ({
  66| |                    name,
  67| |                    in: "query",
  68| |                    required: required.has(name),
  69| |                    schema: {
  70| |                        type: propSchema.type ?? "string",
  71| |                        ...(propSchema.format ? { format: propSchema.format } : {}),
  72| |                        ...(propSchema.enum ? { enum: propSchema.enum } : {}),
  73| |                        ...(propSchema.default !== undefined
  74| |                            ? { default: propSchema.default }
  75| |                            : {}),
  76| |                    },
  77| |                })
  78| |            );
  80| |            operation.parameters = [
  81| |                ...((operation.parameters as any[]) ?? []),
  82| |                ...queryParams,
  83| |            ];
  85| |        }
  87| |        if (route.schema?.body) {
  88| |            operation.requestBody = {
  89| |                content: { "application/json": { schema: route.schema.body } },
  90| |            };
  91| |        }
  93| |        paths[openApiPath][route.method.toLowerCase()] = operation;
  94| |    }
  96| |    return {
  97| |        openapi: "3.1.0",
  98| |        info,
  99| |        paths,
 100| |    };
 101| |};

  11| |  allErrors: true,

  13| |  coerceTypes: true,
  14| |  removeAdditional: true,

  20|▼|function toErrorRecord(
  21| |  errors: ErrorObject[] | null | undefined,
  22| |  on: string
  23| |): Record<string, string[]> {
  24| |  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  26| |  for (const e of errors ?? []) {
  27| |    const path =
  28| |      e.instancePath?.replace(/^\//, "").replace(/\//g, ".") ||

  34| |  }

  39|▼|export function compileValidator<T = unknown>(
  40| |  schema: AnySchema,
  41| |  on: string = "input"
  42| |) {
  43| |  const validate = ajv.compile(schema as object);
  45| |  return (input: unknown): T => {
  46| |    if (!validate(input)) {
  47|!|      throw new ValidationError(
  48| |        "Validation failed",
  49| |        toErrorRecord(validate.errors, on),
  50| |        on
  51| |      );
  52| |    }
  54| |    return input as T;
  55| |  };
  56| |}

  61| |  on: string = "input"
  62| |): T {

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 1: DISCOVERY
   3| | * Scans filesystem for route files and extracts module metadata via AST.
   4| | * IO isolated in entry function. Pure functions do parsing.
   5| | * Now with functional composition and error recovery.
   6| | */
   8| |import { readdirSync, statSync, readFileSync } from "fs";
   9| |import { join, dirname, basename, extname } from "path";
  11| |import type {
  12| |  ModuleInfo,
  13| |  RouteDef,
  14| |  HttpMethod,
  15| |  CompilerOptions,
  16| |  DiscoveryResult,
  17| |} from "../types";
  19| |import { HTTP_METHODS } from "../types";
  20| |import { parseModule as parseModuleAST } from "../utils/ast";
  21| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  22| |import { tryCatch } from "../fp";
  24| |// Pure Functions
  25|▼|export const isRouteFile = (entry: string): boolean =>
  26| |  /\.(ts|js|mjs|tsx|jsx)$/.test(entry) && !entry.endsWith(".d.ts");
  28|▼|export const isValidDir = (entry: string): boolean =>
  29| |  !entry.startsWith(".") && entry !== "node_modules";
  31| |/** Safely read directory, returning empty array on error. */
  32|▼|const safeReaddir = (dir: string): string[] => {
  33| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readdirSync(dir));
  34| |  return result.ok ? result.value : [];
  35| |};
  37| |/** Safely check if path is directory. */
  38|▼|const safeIsDir = (path: string): boolean => {
  39| |  const result = tryCatch(() => statSync(path).isDirectory());
  40| |  return result.ok ? result.value : false;
  41| |};
  43| |/** Safely read file, returning empty string on error. */
  44|▼|const safeReadFile = (path: string): string => {
  45| |  const result = tryCatch(() => readFileSync(path, "utf-8"));
  46| |  return result.ok ? result.value : "";
  47| |};
  48|▼|export const scanDirectory = (dir: string, base = ""): string[] => {
  49| |  const out: string[] = [];
  50| |  for (const entry of safeReaddir(dir)) {
  51| |    const abs = join(dir, entry);
  52| |    const rel = join(base, entry).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  53| |    if (safeIsDir(abs)) {
  54| |      if (isValidDir(entry)) {
  55| |        out.push(...scanDirectory(abs, rel));
  56| |      }
  57| |    } else if (isRouteFile(entry)) {
  58| |      out.push(rel);
  59| |    }
  60| |  }
  61| |  return out;
  62| |};
  64|▼|export const parseRouteFilename = (
  65| |  file: string
  66| |): Pick<RouteDef, "method" | "path" | "paramNames" | "isDynamic" | "isStatic" | "segmentCount"> | null => {
  67| |  const ext = extname(file);
  68| |  const name = basename(file, ext);
  69| |  const parts = name.split(".");
  71| |  let method: HttpMethod = "GET";
  72| |  let routeName = name;
  74| |  const lastPart = parts.at(-1);
  75| |  if (lastPart && HTTP_METHODS.includes(lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod)) {
  76| |    method = lastPart.toUpperCase() as HttpMethod;
  77| |    routeName = parts.slice(0, -1).join(".");
  78| |  }
  80| |  const dirPart = dirname(file);
  81| |  let routePath = "/" + join(dirPart, routeName).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  82| |  if (routePath.endsWith("/index")) {
  83| |    routePath = routePath.slice(0, -5) || "/";
  84| |  }
  86| |  const paramNames: string[] = [];
  87| |  let isDynamic = false;
  89| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[(\.\.\.[^\]]+)\]/g, (_, raw: string) => {
  90| |    isDynamic = true;
  91| |    const pname = raw.slice(3);
  92| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  93| |    return "*" + pname;
  94| |  });
  96| |  routePath = routePath.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]/g, (_, pname: string) => {
  97| |    isDynamic = true;
  98| |    paramNames.push(pname);
  99| |    return ":" + pname;
 100| |  });
 102| |  return {
 103| |    method,
 104| |    path: routePath,
 105| |    paramNames,
 106| |    isDynamic,
 107| |    isStatic: !isDynamic,
 108| |    segmentCount: routePath.split("/").filter(Boolean).length,
 109| |  };
 110| |};
 112|▼|export const parseModule = (filePath: string, relPath: string, content: string): ModuleInfo => {
 113| |  const parsed = parseModuleAST(content);
 114| |  return {
 115| |    path: filePath,
 116| |    relPath,
 117| |    content,
 118| |    imports: parsed.imports,
 119| |    exports: parsed.exports,
 120| |    symbols: parsed.symbols,
 121| |    hasDefaultExport: parsed.hasDefaultExport,
 122| |    schemaExport: parsed.schemaExport ? "schema" : undefined,
 123| |    configExport: parsed.configExport ? "config" : undefined,
 124| |    callGraph: new Map(),
 125| |    dataFlow: new Map(),
 126| |  };
 127| |};
 129| |// Phase Orchestrator — Functional composition
 130|▼|export const runDiscovery = (opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger): DiscoveryResult =>
 131| |  logger.time("discovery", () => {
 132| |    const files = scanDirectory(opts.routesDir);
 133| |    const modules = files.map(f => {
 134| |      const abs = join(opts.routesDir, f);
 135| |      const content = safeReadFile(abs);
 136| |      return parseModule(abs, f, content);
 137| |    }).filter(m => m.content.length > 0); // Skip unreadable files
 139| |    logger.info(`Discovered ${files.length} files, ${modules.length} modules`, {
 140| |      routesDir: opts.routesDir,
 141| |    });
 142| |    return { files, modules };
 143| |  });

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 3: OPTIMIZATION
   3| | * Composable pure transforms: inline → dedup → trie → jump table → buffers.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  RouteDef,
   8| |  ModuleInfo,
   9| |  SegNode,
  10| |  CompilerOptions,
  11| |  JumpTable,
  12| |  OptimizationResult,
  13| |} from "../types";
  15| |import { buildTrie, trieStats } from "../utils/trie";
  16| |import { canUseDenseArray, generatePerfectHash } from "../utils/hash";
  17| |import { estimateNodeCount } from "../utils/ast";
  18| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  20| |// ============================================================================
  21| |// Inline Detection — Pure
  22| |// ============================================================================
  24|▼|export const isInlineEligible = (
  25| |  route: RouteDef,
  26| |  mod: ModuleInfo | undefined,
  27| |  threshold: number
  28| |): boolean => {
  29| |  if (!mod) return false;
  30| |  if (route.hasValidation) return false;
  31| |  if (route.hooks.length > 0) return false;
  32| |  const nodeCount = estimateNodeCount(mod.content);
  33| |  return nodeCount <= threshold;
  34| |};
  36|▼|export const markInline = (
  37| |  route: RouteDef,
  38| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  39| |  threshold: number
  40| |): RouteDef => {
  41| |  const mod = modules[route.moduleIdx];
  42| |  const shouldInline = isInlineEligible(route, mod, threshold);
  43| |  return shouldInline === route.shouldInline ? route : { ...route, shouldInline };
  44| |};
  46|▼|export const detectInlineCandidates = (
  47| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
  48| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
  49| |  threshold: number
  50| |): RouteDef[] => routes.map((r) => markInline(r, modules, threshold));
  52| |// ============================================================================
  53| |// Route Deduplication — Pure
  54| |// ============================================================================
  56|▼|export const hasConstantResponse = (route: RouteDef): boolean =>
  57| |  route.isConstantResponse && !!route.constantResponse;
  59|▼|export const groupByConstantResponse = (
  60| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[]
  61| |): Map<string, RouteDef[]> => {
  62| |  const groups = new Map<string, RouteDef[]>();
  63| |  for (const route of routes) {
  64| |    if (!hasConstantResponse(route)) continue;
  65| |    const key = route.constantResponse!;
  66| |    const existing = groups.get(key);
  67| |    if (existing) existing.push(route);
  68| |    else groups.set(key, [route]);
  69| |  }
  70| |  return groups;
  71| |};
  73|▼|export const buildDedupMap = (
  74| |  groups: Map<string, RouteDef[]>
  75| |): Map<string, string> => {
  76| |  const replacements = new Map<string, string>();
  77| |  for (const group of groups.values()) {
  78| |    if (group.length < 2) continue;
  79| |    const leader = group[0]!;
  80| |    for (let i = 1; i < group.length; i++) {
  81| |      replacements.set(group[i]!.handlerRef, leader.handlerRef);
  82| |    }
  83| |  }
  84| |  return replacements;
  85| |};
  87|▼|export const applyDedup = (
  88| |  route: RouteDef,
  89| |  dedupMap: Map<string, string>
  90| |): RouteDef => {
  91| |  const dedupGroup = dedupMap.get(route.handlerRef);
  92| |  return dedupGroup ? { ...route, dedupGroup } : route;
  93| |};
  95|▼|export const deduplicateRoutes = (routes: RouteDef[]): RouteDef[] => {
  96| |  const groups = groupByConstantResponse(routes);
  97| |  const dedupMap = buildDedupMap(groups);
  98| |  if (dedupMap.size === 0) return routes;
  99| |  return routes.map((r) => applyDedup(r, dedupMap));
 100| |};
 102| |// ============================================================================
 103| |// Jump Table — Pure
 104| |// ============================================================================
 106|▼|export const selectJumpStrategy = (
 107| |  hashes: readonly number[]
 108| |): JumpTable["strategy"] => {
 109| |  if (hashes.length === 0) return "sparse";
 110| |  if (canUseDenseArray(hashes)) return "dense";
 111| |  if (generatePerfectHash(hashes)) return "perfect-hash";
 112| |  return "sparse";
 113| |};
 117|▼|export const detectCollisions = (
 118| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[]
 119| |): Map<number, readonly number[]> => {
 120| |  const collisions = new Map<number, number[]>();
 121| |  const seen = new Map<number, number>();
 122| |  for (let i = 0; i < staticRoutes.length; i++) {
 123| |    const route = staticRoutes[i];
 124| |    if (!route) continue;
 125| |    const h = route.signatureHash;
 126| |    const prev = seen.get(h);
 127| |    if (prev !== undefined) {
 128| |      const existing = collisions.get(h);
 129| |      if (existing) existing.push(i);
 130| |      else collisions.set(h, [prev, i]);
 131| |    } else {
 132| |      seen.set(h, i);
 133| |    }
 134| |  }
 135| |  return collisions;
 136| |};
 138| |// ============================================================================
 139| |// Response Preserialization — Pure
 140| |// ============================================================================
 142|▼|export const makeErrorBuf = (msg: string): string =>
 143| |  `new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify({error:"${msg}"}))`;
 145|▼|export const buildErrorBuffers = (): Map<string, string> => {
 146| |  const buffers = new Map<string, string>();
 147| |  buffers.set("404", makeErrorBuf("Not Found"));
 148| |  buffers.set("400", makeErrorBuf("Bad Request"));
 149| |  buffers.set("500", makeErrorBuf("Internal Server Error"));
 150| |  buffers.set("401", makeErrorBuf("Unauthorized"));
 151| |  buffers.set("403", makeErrorBuf("Forbidden"));
 152| |  return buffers;
 153| |};
 155|▼|export const makeRouteBuf = (route: RouteDef): [string, string] | null => {
 156| |  if (!route.isConstantResponse || !route.constantResponse) return null;
 157| |  const key = `route_${route.handlerRef}`;
 158| |  const value = `new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(${route.constantResponse}))`;
 159| |  return [key, value];
 160| |};
 162|▼|export const preserializeResponses = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): Map<string, string> => {
 163| |  const buffers = buildErrorBuffers();
 164| |  for (const route of routes) {
 165| |    const pair = makeRouteBuf(route);
 166| |    if (pair) buffers.set(pair[0], pair[1]);
 167| |  }
 168| |  return buffers;
 169| |};
 171| |// ============================================================================
 172| |// Schema Compilation — Pure
 173| |// ============================================================================
 175|▼|export const compileStringSchema = (): string => `typeof ctx.body === "string"`;
 176|▼|export const compileNumberSchema = (): string => `typeof ctx.body === "number"`;
 177|▼|export const compileBooleanSchema = (): string => `typeof ctx.body === "boolean"`;
 178|▼|export const compileArraySchema = (): string => `Array.isArray(ctx.body)`;
 180|▼|export const extractObjectProps = (schemaCode: string): string[] | null => {
 181| |  const props = schemaCode.match(/([\w$]+):\s*z\.\w+\(\)/g);
 182| |  if (!props) return null;
 183| |  return props.map((p) => p.split(":")[0]!.trim());
 184| |};
 186|▼|export const compileObjectSchema = (schemaCode: string): string | null => {
 187| |  const props = extractObjectProps(schemaCode);
 188| |  if (!props) return null;
 189| |  const checks = props.map((name) => `typeof ctx.body.${name} !== "undefined"`);
 190| |  return `typeof ctx.body === "object" && ctx.body !== null && ${checks.join(" && ")}`;
 191| |};
 193|▼|export const compileSchema = (schemaCode: string): string | null => {
 194| |  if (schemaCode.includes("z.string()")) return compileStringSchema();
 195| |  if (schemaCode.includes("z.number()")) return compileNumberSchema();
 196| |  if (schemaCode.includes("z.boolean()")) return compileBooleanSchema();
 197| |  if (schemaCode.includes("z.array(")) return compileArraySchema();
 198| |  if (schemaCode.includes("z.object")) return compileObjectSchema(schemaCode);
 199| |  return null;
 200| |};
 202| |// ============================================================================
 203| |// Route Partitioning — Pure
 204| |// ============================================================================
 206|▼|export const partitionRoutes = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): [RouteDef[], RouteDef[]] =>
 207| |  routes.reduce(
 208| |    ([s, d], r) => (r.isStatic ? [[...s, r], d] : [s, [...d, r]]),
 209| |    [[], []] as [RouteDef[], RouteDef[]]
 210| |  );
 212| |// ============================================================================
 213| |// Statistics — Pure
 214| |// ============================================================================
 216|▼|export const countInlined = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 217| |  routes.filter((r) => r.shouldInline).length;
 219|▼|export const countDeduped = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 220| |  routes.filter((r) => r.dedupGroup).length;
 222| |// ============================================================================
 223| |// Phase Orchestrator — Composed pipeline
 224| |// ============================================================================
 226|▼|export const runOptimization = (
 227| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 228| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[],
 229| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 230| |  logger: Logger
 231| |): OptimizationResult =>
 232| |  logger.time("optimization", () => {
 233| |    // Pipeline: inline → dedup → partition → build structures
 234| |    const inlined = detectInlineCandidates(routes, modules, opts.inlineThreshold);
 235| |    const deduped = opts.enableHandlerDeduplication
 236| |      ? deduplicateRoutes(inlined)
 237| |      : inlined;
 239| |    const [statics, dynamics] = partitionRoutes(deduped);
 240| |    const trie = buildTrie(dynamics);
 241| |    const jumpTable = buildJumpTable(statics);
 242| |    const buffers = preserializeResponses(deduped);
 244| |    const stats = trieStats(trie);
 245| |    const inlinedCount = countInlined(deduped);
 246| |    const dedupedCount = countDeduped(deduped);
 248| |    logger.info(
 249| |      `Optimized: ${inlinedCount} inlined | ${dedupedCount} deduplicated | jumpTable=${jumpTable.strategy}`
 250| |    );
 251| |    logger.info(
 252| |      `Trie: ${stats.totalNodes} nodes, depth ${stats.maxDepth}, avg branching ${stats.avgBranching.toFixed(2)}`
 253| |    );
 255| |    return {
 256| |      routes: deduped,
 257| |      trie,
 258| |      jumpTable,
 259| |      preserializedBuffers: buffers,
 260| |      meta: {
 261| |        inlined: inlinedCount,
 262| |        deduplicated: dedupedCount,
 263| |        eliminated: routes.length - deduped.length,
 264| |      },
 265| |    };
 266| |  });
 272|▼|  const globalRouteIndex = (route: RouteDef): number => {
 273| |  const match = /^_h(\d+)$/.exec(route.handlerRef);
 274| |  return match ? Number.parseInt(match[1]!, 10) : 0;
 275| |};
 277| |export const buildDenseTable = (
 278| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[],
 279| |  min: number,
 280| |  max: number
 281| |): Array<{ hash: number; routeIdx: number } | null> => {
 282| |  const size = max - min + 1;
 283| |  const entries = new Array(size).fill(null) as Array<{
 284| |    hash: number;
 285| |    routeIdx: number;
 286| |  } | null>;
 288| |  for (const route of staticRoutes) {
 289| |    const idx = route.signatureHash - min;
 291| |    if (idx >= 0 && idx < entries.length) {
 292| |      entries[idx] = {
 293| |        hash: route.signatureHash,
 294| |        routeIdx: globalRouteIndex(route),
 295| |      };
 296| |    }
 297| |  }
 299| |  return entries;
 300| |};
 302| |export const buildSparseTable = (
 303| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[]
 304| |): Array<{ hash: number; routeIdx: number }> => {
 305| |  return staticRoutes
 306| |    .map((r) => ({
 307| |      hash: r.signatureHash,
 308| |      routeIdx: globalRouteIndex(r),
 309| |    }))
 310| |    .sort((a, b) => a.hash - b.hash);
 311| |};
 313| |export const buildPerfectHashTable = (
 314| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[],
 315| |  seed: number
 316| |): Array<{ hash: number; routeIdx: number } | null> => {
 317| |  const n = staticRoutes.length;
 318| |  if (n === 0) return [];
 320| |  const entries = new Array(n).fill(null) as Array<{
 321| |    hash: number;
 322| |    routeIdx: number;
 323| |  } | null>;
 325| |  for (const route of staticRoutes) {
 326| |    const idx = ((route.signatureHash + seed) % n + n) % n;
 328| |    entries[idx] = {
 329| |      hash: route.signatureHash,
 330| |      routeIdx: globalRouteIndex(route),
 331| |    };
 332| |  }
 334| |  return entries;
 335| |};
 337| |export const buildJumpTableEntries = (
 338| |  staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[],
 339| |  strategy: JumpTable["strategy"],
 340| |  min: number,
 341| |  max: number,
 342| |  seed = 0
 343| |): Array<{ hash: number; routeIdx: number } | null> => {
 344| |  switch (strategy) {
 345| |    case "dense":
 346| |      return buildDenseTable(staticRoutes, min, max);
 348| |    case "perfect-hash":
 349| |      return buildPerfectHashTable(staticRoutes, seed);
 351| |    case "sparse":
 352| |      return buildSparseTable(staticRoutes);
 353| |  }
 354| |};
 356|▼|export const emitDenseLookup = (min: number, max: number): string =>
 357| |  `const idx = hash - ${min}; return idx >= 0 && idx < ${
 358| |    max - min + 1
 359| |  } ? table[idx] : null;`;
 361|▼|export const emitPerfectHashLookup = (len: number, seed = 0): string =>
 362| |  `const entry = table[(hash + ${seed}) % ${len}]; return entry && entry.hash === hash ? entry : null;`;
 364|▼|export const emitSparseLookup = (): string =>
 365| |  `// binary search implementation`;
 367|▼|export const generateLookupCode = (
 368| |  strategy: JumpTable["strategy"],
 369| |  min: number,
 370| |  max: number,
 371| |  len: number,
 372| |  seed = 0
 373| |): string => {
 374| |  if (len === 0) return `return null;`;
 376| |  switch (strategy) {
 377| |    case "dense":
 378| |      return emitDenseLookup(min, max);
 380| |    case "perfect-hash":
 381| |      return emitPerfectHashLookup(len, seed);
 383| |    case "sparse":
 384| |      return emitSparseLookup();
 385| |  }
 386| |};
 388|▼|export const buildJumpTable = (staticRoutes: readonly RouteDef[]): JumpTable => {
 389| |  const hashes = staticRoutes.map((r) => r.signatureHash);
 391| |  const perfect =
 392| |    hashes.length > 0 && hashes.length <= 100
 393| |      ? generatePerfectHash(hashes)
 394| |      : null;
 396| |  const strategy: JumpTable["strategy"] =
 397| |    hashes.length === 0
 398| |      ? "sparse"
 399| |      : canUseDenseArray(hashes)
 400| |        ? "dense"
 401| |        : perfect
 402| |          ? "perfect-hash"
 403| |          : "sparse";
 405| |  const min = hashes.length > 0 ? Math.min(...hashes) : 0;
 406| |  const max = hashes.length > 0 ? Math.max(...hashes) : 0;
 408| |  const seed =
 409| |    strategy === "perfect-hash" ? perfect?.g[0] ?? 0 : undefined;
 411| |  const entries = buildJumpTableEntries(
 412| |    staticRoutes,
 413| |    strategy,
 414| |    min,
 415| |    max,
 416| |    seed ?? 0
 417| |  );
 419| |  const collisions = detectCollisions(staticRoutes);
 421| |  return {
 422| |    strategy,
 423| |    entries,
 424| |    minHash: min,
 425| |    maxHash: max,
 426| |    collisions,
 427| |    lookupCode: generateLookupCode(
 428| |      strategy,
 429| |      min,
 430| |      max,
 431| |      entries.length,
 432| |      seed ?? 0
 433| |    ),
 434| |    seed,
 435| |  };
 436| |};
