   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview File response helpers:
   3| | * - static file serving
   4| | * - downloads
   5| | * - HTTP range requests
   6| | * - conditional requests
   7| | * - mtime/ETag browser caching
   8| | */
  10| |import { stat } from "fs/promises";
  11| |import { basename, resolve, normalize, sep } from "path";
  12| |import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from "./errors";
  13| |import { cacheControl } from "./cache";
  15|▼|export interface SendFileOptions {
  16| |  req?: Request;
  17| |  download?: boolean | string;
  18| |  contentType?: string;
  19| |  maxAge?: number;
  20| |  swr?: number;
  21| |  immutable?: boolean;
  22| |  isPrivate?: boolean;
  23| |}
  25|▼|export interface StreamDownloadOptions {
  26| |  filename?: string;
  27| |  contentType?: string;
  28| |  cacheControl?: string;
  29| |  size?: number;
  30| |}
  32| |/**
  33| | * Prevent path traversal.
  34| | *
  35| | * Example:
  36| | *   safeJoin("public", ctx.params.path)
  37| | */
  38|▼|export function safeJoin(root: string, target: string): string {
  39| |  const resolvedRoot = resolve(root);
  40| |  const resolved = resolve(resolvedRoot, normalize(target));
  42| |  if (!resolved.startsWith(resolvedRoot + sep)) {
  43|!|    throw new ForbiddenError("Invalid file path");
  44| |  }
  46| |  return resolved;
  47| |}
  49|▼|function isNotModified(
  50| |  req: Request,
  51| |  etag: string,
  52| |  lastModified: string
  53| |): boolean {
  54| |  const inm = req.headers.get("if-none-match");
  56| |  if (
  57| |    inm &&
  58| |    inm
  59| |      .split(",")
  60| |      .map((s) => s.trim())
  61| |      .includes(etag)
  62| |  ) {
  63| |    return true;
  64| |  }
  66| |  const ims = req.headers.get("if-modified-since");
  68| |  if (ims && new Date(ims).getTime() >= new Date(lastModified).getTime()) {
  69| |    return true;
  70| |  }
  72| |  return false;
  73| |}
  75|▼|export async function sendFile(
  76| |  path: string,
  77| |  opts: SendFileOptions = {}
  78| |): Promise<Response> {
  79| |  const stats = await stat(path).catch(() => null);
  81| |  if (!stats || !stats.isFile()) {
  82|!|    throw new NotFoundError("File");
  83| |  }
  85| |  const file = Bun.file(path);
  87| |  const etag = `W/"${stats.size.toString(16)}-${Math.floor(
  88| |    stats.mtimeMs
  89| |  ).toString(16)}"`;
  91| |  const lastModified = stats.mtime.toUTCString();
  93| |  const headers = new Headers();
  95| |  headers.set(
  96| |    "content-type",
  97| |    opts.contentType || file.type || "application/octet-stream"
  98| |  );
 100| |  headers.set(
 101| |    "cache-control",
 102| |    cacheControl({
 103| |      public: !opts.isPrivate,
 104| |      private: opts.isPrivate,
 105| |      maxAge: opts.maxAge ?? 3600,
 106| |      swr: opts.swr,
 107| |      immutable: opts.immutable,
 108| |    })
 109| |  );
 111| |  headers.set("etag", etag);
 112| |  headers.set("last-modified", lastModified);
 113| |  headers.set("accept-ranges", "bytes");
 115| |  if (opts.download) {
 116| |    const filename =
 117| |      typeof opts.download === "string"
 118| |        ? opts.download
 119| |        : basename(path);
 121| |    headers.set(
 122| |      "content-disposition",
 123| |      `attachment; filename="${filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 124| |    );
 125| |  }
 127| |  if (opts.req && isNotModified(opts.req, etag, lastModified)) {
 128| |    return new Response(null, {
 129| |      status: 304,
 130| |      headers,
 131| |    });
 132| |  }
 134| |  const range = opts.req?.headers.get("range");
 136| |  if (range) {
 137| |    const match = /bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)/.exec(range);
 139| |    if (!match) {
 140| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 141| |        status: 416,
 142| |        headers: {
 143| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 144| |        },
 145| |      });
 146| |    }
 148| |    let start: number;
 149| |    let end: number;
 151| |    if (match[1] === "" && match[2] !== "") {
 152| |      // Suffix range: bytes=-500
 153| |      const suffix = parseInt(match[2]!, 10);
 154| |      start = Math.max(0, stats.size - suffix);
 155| |      end = stats.size - 1;
 156| |    } else {
 157| |      start = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 0;
 158| |      end = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : stats.size - 1;
 159| |    }
 161| |    if (
 162| |      Number.isNaN(start) ||
 163| |      Number.isNaN(end) ||
 164| |      start > end ||
 165| |      start >= stats.size
 166| |    ) {
 167| |      return new Response("Range Not Satisfiable", {
 168| |        status: 416,
 169| |        headers: {
 170| |          "content-range": `bytes */${stats.size}`,
 171| |        },
 172| |      });
 173| |    }
 175| |    end = Math.min(end, stats.size - 1);
 177| |    headers.set("content-range", `bytes ${start}-${end}/${stats.size}`);
 178| |    headers.set("content-length", String(end - start + 1));
 180| |    return new Response(file.slice(start, end + 1), {
 181| |      status: 206,
 182| |      headers,
 183| |    });
 184| |  }
 186| |  headers.set("content-length", String(stats.size));
 188| |  return new Response(file, {
 189| |    status: 200,
 190| |    headers,
 191| |  });
 192| |}
 194|▼|export function streamDownload(
 195| |  stream: ReadableStream,
 196| |  opts: StreamDownloadOptions = {}
 197| |): Response {
 198| |  const headers = new Headers({
 199| |    "content-type": opts.contentType || "application/octet-stream",
 200| |    "cache-control": opts.cacheControl || "no-store",
 201| |  });
 203| |  if (opts.filename) {
 204| |    headers.set(
 205| |      "content-disposition",
 206| |      `attachment; filename="${opts.filename.replace(/"/g, "")}"`
 207| |    );
 208| |  }
 210| |  if (opts.size != null) {
 211| |    headers.set("content-length", String(opts.size));
 212| |  }
 214| |  return new Response(stream, {
 215| |    status: 200,
 216| |    headers,
 217| |  });
 218| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Phase 2: ANALYSIS — AST-based, zero regex.
   3| | * Detects ctx usage at build time. Produces RouteDefs from discovered modules.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  RouteDef,
   8| |  ModuleInfo,
   9| |  CompilerOptions,
  10| |  HttpMethod,
  11| |  DiscoveryResult,
  12| |  AnalysisResult,
  13| |  HookDef,
  14| |  ContextUsage,
  15| |  RouteCacheConfig,
  16| |} from "../types";
  18| |import { HTTP_METHODS, FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE } from "../types";
  19| |import { parseRouteFilename } from "./discovery";
  20| |import { computeSignatureHash } from "../utils/hash";
  21| |import {
  22| |  parseModule,
  23| |  isPureBodyAST,
  24| |  inferResponseTypeAST,
  25| |} from "../utils/ast";
  26| |import type { Logger } from "../logger";
  28| |// ============================================================================
  29| |// Pure Route Analysis Functions
  30| |// ============================================================================
  32|▼|export const parseRouteFile = (file: string) => parseRouteFilename(file);
  34|▼|export const findModuleByPath = (
  35| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  36| |): ModuleInfo | undefined => modules.find((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  38|▼|export const findModuleIndex = (
  39| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[], relPath: string
  40| |): number => modules.findIndex((m) => m.relPath === relPath);
  42| |// ============================================================================
  43| |// Constant Response Detection
  44| |// ============================================================================
  46|▼|const evaluateConstantBody = (body: string): string | null => {
  47| |  const expr = body
  48| |    .replace(/^return\s+/, "")
  49| |    .replace(/;\s*$/, "")
  50| |    .trim();
  52| |  if (!expr) return null;
  54| |  try {
  55| |    // Only called after isPureBodyAST() has approved the body.
  56| |    const fn = new Function(`"use strict"; return (${expr});`);
  57| |    const value = fn();
  58| |    return JSON.stringify(value);
  59| |  } catch {
  60| |    return null;
  61| |  }
  62| |};
  64| |export const detectConstantResponse = (
  65| |  mod: ModuleInfo
  66| |): { isConstant: boolean; constantResponse?: string } => {
  67| |  const parsed = parseModule(mod.content);
  69| |  if (!parsed.handler) {
  70| |    return { isConstant: false };
  71| |  }
  73| |  if (!isPureBodyAST(parsed.ast)) {
  74| |    return { isConstant: false };
  75| |  }
  77| |  const json = evaluateConstantBody(parsed.handler.body);
  79| |  if (!json) {
  80| |    return { isConstant: false };
  81| |  }
  83| |  return {
  84| |    isConstant: true,
  85| |    constantResponse: json,
  86| |  };
  87| |};
  89| |// ============================================================================
  90| |// RouteDef Factory — Pure
  91| |// ============================================================================
  93|▼|export const buildHandlerRef = (routeIndex: number): string => `_h${routeIndex}`;
  94|▼|export const buildSchemaRef = (routeIndex: number, hasSchema: boolean): string | null =>
  95| |  hasSchema ? `_s${routeIndex}` : null;
  96|▼|export const computeMethodIndex = (method: HttpMethod): number =>
  97| |  HTTP_METHODS.indexOf(method);
  99|▼|export const findHandlerSymbol = (mod: ModuleInfo) =>
 100| |  mod.symbols.find((s) => s.name === "default") || mod.symbols[0];
 102|▼|export const createRouteDef = (
 103| |  file: string,
 104| |  parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>>,
 105| |  mod: ModuleInfo,
 106| |  routeIndex: number,
 107| |  moduleIdx: number
 108| |): RouteDef => {
 109| |  const handlerSym = findHandlerSymbol(mod);
 110| |  const methodIdx = computeMethodIndex(parsed.method);
 112| |  const astParsed = parseModule(mod.content);
 115| |  const rawCache =
 116| |    astParsed.config?.cache ??
 117| |    (typeof astParsed.config?.cache === "number"
 118| |      ? astParsed.config.cache
 119| |      : undefined);
 121| |  const cache = normalizeRouteCache(rawCache);
 123| |  const usage = astParsed.handler?.usage ?? FULL_CONTEXT_USAGE;
 125| |  const isAsync =
 126| |    astParsed.handler?.isAsync ?? handlerSym?.isAsync ?? false;
 128| |  const hooks: string[] = [];
 130| |  const { isConstant, constantResponse } = detectConstantResponse(mod);
 132| |  const inferredResponseType = inferResponseTypeAST(astParsed.ast);
 134| |  const responseType = usage.json
 135| |    ? "json"
 136| |    : usage.text
 137| |      ? "text"
 138| |      : inferredResponseType;
 140| |  return {
 141| |    ...parsed,
 142| |    file,
 143| |    moduleIdx,
 144| |    handlerRef: buildHandlerRef(routeIndex),
 145| |    schemaRef: buildSchemaRef(routeIndex, !!mod.schemaExport),
 146| |    signatureHash: computeSignatureHash(methodIdx, parsed.path),
 147| |    handlerSize: handlerSym?.size || 9999,
 148| |    isAsync,
 149| |    shouldInline: false,
 150| |    responseType,
 151| |    hasValidation: !!mod.schemaExport,
 152| |    hotnessScore: 0,
 153| |    hooks,
 154| |    isConstantResponse: isConstant,
 155| |    constantResponse,
 156| |    usage,
 157| |    cache,
 158| |  };
 159| |};
 161| |export const resolveRouteModule = (
 162| |  file: string,
 163| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 164| |): { mod: ModuleInfo; parsed: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof parseRouteFilename>> } | null => {
 165| |  const parsed = parseRouteFile(file);
 166| |  if (!parsed) return null;
 167| |  const mod = findModuleByPath(modules, file);
 168| |  if (!mod) return null;
 169| |  if (!mod.hasDefaultExport) return null;
 170| |  return { mod, parsed };
 171| |};
 173| |// ============================================================================
 174| |// Route Graph Builder — Pure
 175| |// ============================================================================
 177|▼|export const buildRouteGraph = (
 178| |  files: readonly string[],
 179| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 180| |): RouteDef[] => {
 181| |  const routes: RouteDef[] = [];
 183| |  for (const file of files) {
 184| |    const resolved = resolveRouteModule(file, modules);
 185| |    if (!resolved) continue;
 187| |    const moduleIdx = findModuleIndex(modules, file);
 188| |    if (moduleIdx < 0) continue;
 190| |    routes.push(
 191| |      createRouteDef(
 192| |        file,
 193| |        resolved.parsed,
 194| |        resolved.mod,
 195| |        routes.length,
 196| |        moduleIdx
 197| |      )
 198| |    );
 199| |  }
 201| |  return routes;
 202| |};
 203| |// ============================================================================
 204| |// Dead Route Detection — Pure
 205| |// ============================================================================
 207|▼|export const staticRouteKey = (route: RouteDef): string =>
 208| |  `${route.method}:${route.path}`;
 210| |export const detectDeadRoutes = (
 211| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 212| |  modules: readonly ModuleInfo[]
 213| |): { alive: RouteDef[]; dead: RouteDef[] } => {
 214| |  const seen = new Map<string, number>();
 215| |  const alive: RouteDef[] = [];
 216| |  const dead: RouteDef[] = [];
 218| |  for (const route of routes) {
 219| |    const hasValidModule = route.moduleIdx >= 0 && route.moduleIdx < modules.length;
 220| |    if (!hasValidModule) {
 221| |      dead.push(route);
 222| |      continue;
 223| |    }
 224| |    if (route.isStatic && seen.has(staticRouteKey(route))) {
 225| |      dead.push(route);
 226| |      continue;
 227| |    }
 228| |    if (route.isStatic) {
 229| |      seen.set(staticRouteKey(route), alive.length);
 230| |    }
 231| |    alive.push(route);
 232| |  }
 233| |  return { alive, dead };
 234| |};
 236| |// ============================================================================
 237| |// Hook Resolution — Pure
 238| |// ============================================================================
 240|▼|export const collectHookNames = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): Set<string> => {
 241| |  const referenced = new Set<string>();
 242| |  for (const route of routes) {
 243| |    for (const hook of route.hooks) referenced.add(hook);
 244| |  }
 245| |  return referenced;
 246| |};
 248|▼|export const createHookDef = (name: string, hooksDir: string): HookDef => ({
 249| |  name,
 250| |  source: `${hooksDir}/${name}.ts`,
 251| |  moduleIdx: -1,
 252| |  isAsync: true,
 253| |});
 255|▼|export const resolveHooks = (
 256| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 257| |  hooksDir: string | undefined
 258| |): ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef> => {
 259| |  const names = collectHookNames(routes);
 260| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookDef>();
 261| |  if (!hooksDir || names.size === 0) return hooks;
 262| |  for (const name of names) {
 263| |    hooks.set(name, createHookDef(name, hooksDir));
 264| |  }
 265| |  return hooks;
 266| |};
 268| |// ============================================================================
 269| |// Statistics — Pure
 270| |// ============================================================================
 272|▼|export const countRoutes = (
 273| |  routes: readonly RouteDef[],
 274| |  predicate: (r: RouteDef) => boolean
 275| |): number => routes.filter(predicate).length;
 277|▼|export const countStatic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 278| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isStatic);
 279|▼|export const countDynamic = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 280| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isDynamic);
 281|▼|export const countConstant = (routes: readonly RouteDef[]): number =>
 282| |  countRoutes(routes, (r) => r.isConstantResponse);
 284| |// ============================================================================
 285| |// Phase Orchestrator — Composed from pure functions
 286| |// ============================================================================
 288|▼|export const runAnalysis = (
 289| |  discovery: DiscoveryResult,
 290| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 291| |  logger: Logger
 292| |): AnalysisResult =>
 293| |  logger.time("analysis", () => {
 294| |    const routes = buildRouteGraph(discovery.files, discovery.modules);
 295| |    const { alive, dead } = detectDeadRoutes(routes, discovery.modules);
 297| |    if (dead.length > 0) {
 298| |      logger.warn(`Eliminated ${dead.length} dead route(s)`, {
 299| |        dead: dead.map((r) => `${r.method} ${r.path}`),
 300| |      });
 301| |    }
 303| |    const hooks = resolveHooks(alive, opts.hooksDir);
 305| |    const needsBody = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.body).length;
 306| |    const needsFile = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.file).length;
 307| |    const needsQuery = alive.filter((r) => r.usage.query).length;
 309| |    logger.info(
 310| |      `Routes: ${alive.length} total (${countStatic(alive)} static, ${countDynamic(alive)} dynamic, ${countConstant(alive)} constant)`
 311| |    );
 312| |    logger.info(
 313| |      `Usage analysis: ${needsBody} need body | ${needsFile} need files | ${needsQuery} need query`
 314| |    );
 316| |    if (hooks.size > 0) {
 317| |      logger.info(`Hooks resolved: ${[...hooks.keys()].join(", ")}`);
 318| |    }
 320| |    return { routes: alive, modules: discovery.modules, hooks };
 321| |  });
 323|▼|const normalizeRouteCache = (input: unknown): RouteCacheConfig | undefined => {
 324| |  if (typeof input === "number") {
 325| |    return { maxAge: input };
 326| |  }
 328| |  if (input && typeof input === "object") {
 329| |    const cfg = input as Record<string, unknown>;
 331| |    return {
 332| |      maxAge: typeof cfg.maxAge === "number" ? cfg.maxAge : undefined,
 333| |      swr: typeof cfg.swr === "number" ? cfg.swr : undefined,
 334| |      immutable: typeof cfg.immutable === "boolean" ? cfg.immutable : undefined,
 335| |      vary: Array.isArray(cfg.vary) ? (cfg.vary as string[]) : undefined,
 336| |    };
 337| |  }
 339| |  return undefined;
 340| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Flux Context v3.0 — Production-grade request context.

   4| | */
   5| |import * as cookie from "cookie";
   6| |import * as setCookie from "set-cookie-parser";

  78| |// ============================================================================
  79| |// Cookie Class
  80| |// ============================================================================
  82|▼|export class Cookie<T = string | undefined> {
  83| |  constructor(
  84| |    private name: string,
  85| |    private jar: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
  86| |    private initial: Partial<ElysiaCookie> = {}
  87| |  ) {}
  89| |  get value(): T { return (this.jar[this.name]?.value ?? this.initial.value) as T; }
  90| |  set value(v: T) {
  91| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
  92| |    entry.value = v;
  93| |  }
  95| |  get expires() { return this.jar[this.name]?.expires ?? this.initial.expires; }
  96| |  set expires(v: Date | undefined) { this._set("expires", v); }
  98| |  get maxAge() { return this.jar[this.name]?.maxAge ?? this.initial.maxAge; }
  99| |  set maxAge(v: number | undefined) { this._set("maxAge", v); }
 101| |  get domain() { return this.jar[this.name]?.domain ?? this.initial.domain; }
 102| |  set domain(v: string | undefined) { this._set("domain", v); }
 104| |  get path() { return this.jar[this.name]?.path ?? this.initial.path; }
 105| |  set path(v: string | undefined) { this._set("path", v); }
 107| |  get secure() { return this.jar[this.name]?.secure ?? this.initial.secure; }
 108| |  set secure(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("secure", v); }
 110| |  get httpOnly() { return this.jar[this.name]?.httpOnly ?? this.initial.httpOnly; }
 111| |  set httpOnly(v: boolean | undefined) { this._set("httpOnly", v); }
 113| |  get sameSite() { return this.jar[this.name]?.sameSite ?? this.initial.sameSite; }
 114| |  set sameSite(v: true | false | "lax" | "strict" | "none" | undefined) { this._set("sameSite", v); }
 116| |  update(config: Partial<ElysiaCookie>): this {
 117| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 118| |    Object.assign(entry, config);
 119| |    return this;
 120| |  }
 122| |  remove(): this {
 123| |    this.update({ expires: new Date(0), maxAge: 0, value: "" });
 124| |    return this;
 125| |  }
 127| |  toString(): string {
 128| |    const v = this.value;
 129| |    return typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v ?? "");
 130| |  }
 132| |  private _set(key: string, value: unknown) {
 133| |    const entry = (this.jar[this.name] ??= { ...this.initial });
 134| |    (entry as Record<string, unknown>)[key] = value;
 135| |  }
 136| |}
 138| |// ============================================================================
 139| |// Cookie Jar Factory
 140| |// ============================================================================
 142|▼|export const createCookieJar = (
 143| |  set: SetHeaders,
 144| |  store: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>,
 145| |  initial?: Partial<ElysiaCookie>
 146| |): Record<string, Cookie> => {
 147| |  if (!set.cookie) set.cookie = Object.create(null);
 148| |  return new Proxy(store, {
 149| |    get(_, key: string) {
 150| |      return new Cookie(key, set.cookie!, { ...initial, ...store[key] });
 151| |    }
 152| |  }) as Record<string, Cookie>;
 153| |};
 155| |// ============================================================================
 156| |// Cookie Serialization
 157| |// ============================================================================
 159|▼|export const serializeCookie = (
 160| |  cookies: Record<string, ElysiaCookie>
 161| |): string | string[] | undefined => {
 162| |  const entries = Object.entries(cookies).filter(([, v]) => v?.value != null);
 163| |  if (entries.length === 0) return undefined;
 165| |  const result = entries.map(([name, opts]) => {
 166| |    const value =
 167| |      typeof opts.value === "object"
 168| |        ? JSON.stringify(opts.value)
 169| |        : String(opts.value ?? "");
 171| |    const options: Record<string, unknown> = {
 172| |      domain: opts.domain,
 173| |      path: opts.path,
 174| |      expires: opts.expires,
 175| |      maxAge: opts.maxAge,
 176| |      httpOnly: opts.httpOnly,
 177| |      secure: opts.secure,
 178| |      sameSite:
 179| |        opts.sameSite === true
 180| |          ? "strict"
 181| |          : opts.sameSite === false
 182| |            ? undefined
 183| |            : opts.sameSite,
 184| |    };
 186| |    let str = cookie.serialize(name, value, options as any);
 188| |    if (opts.priority) str += `; Priority=${opts.priority}`;
 189| |    if (opts.partitioned) str += `; Partitioned`;
 191| |    return str;
 192| |  });
 194| |  return result.length === 1 ? result[0] : result;
 195| |};
 197| |// ============================================================================
 198| |// Cookie Parsing
 199| |// ============================================================================
 201|▼|export const parseCookieString = (
 202| |  cookieString: string | null
 203| |): Record<string, string> => {
 204| |  if (!cookieString) return {};
 205| |  return cookie.parse(cookieString);
 206| |};
 208|▼|export const parseSetCookieHeader = (
 209| |  header: string | string[] | null
 210| |) => {
 211| |  if (!header) return [];
 212| |  return setCookie.parse(header);
 213| |};
 215| |// ============================================================================
 216| |// Context Factory
 217| |// ============================================================================
 219| |const HDR_JSON = { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" };
 220| |const HDR_TEXT = { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" };
 221| |const HDR_HTML = { "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" };
 223| |let requestIdCounter = 0;
 224|▼|const generateRequestId = (): string => {
 225| |  const ts = performance.now().toString(36).replace(".", "");
 226| |  const seq = (++requestIdCounter).toString(36);
 227| |  return `${ts}-${seq}`;
 228| |};
 230|▼|type FluxHeadersInit =
 231| |  | Headers
 232| |  | Record<string, string>
 233| |  | [string, string][];
 235|▼|const mergeHeaders = (
 236| |  base: Record<string, string>,
 237| |  init?: FluxHeadersInit

 239| |  const headers = new Headers(base);
 240| |  if (init) new Headers(init).forEach((v, k) => headers.set(k, v));
 241| |  return headers;

 243| |const defaultCache = new HttpResponseCache({ max: 1000, ttlMs: 60_000, staleTtlMs: 300_000 });
 245| |export function createContext<P = Record<string, string>>(
 246| |  req: Request,
 247| |  params: P,
 248| |  opts: ContextOptions = {}
 249| |): FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> {
 250| |  let _url: URL | undefined;
 251| |  let _query: URLSearchParams | undefined = opts.query;
 253| |  const body = opts.bodyInstance ?? createLazyBody(req, opts.body);
 254| |  const state = new Map<string | symbol, unknown>();
 255| |  const set: SetHeaders = { headers: {}, status: 200, ...opts.set };
 257| |  const cookieStore = parseCookieString(req.headers.get("cookie"));
 258| |  const cookie = createCookieJar(set, cookieStore as any);
 260| |  const ctx: FluxContext<P, URLSearchParams> = {
 261| |    req,
 262| |    get url() { return (_url ??= new URL(req.url)); },
 263| |    method: req.method as HttpMethod,
 264| |    get path() { return this.url.pathname; },
 265| |    route: "",
 266| |    headers: req.headers,
 267| |    requestId: generateRequestId(),
 268| |    startTime: performance.now(),
 269| |    params,
 270| |    get query() { return (_query ??= this.url.searchParams) as URLSearchParams; },
 271| |    body,
 272| |    cookie,
 273| |    state,
 275| |    getState<T = unknown>(key: string | symbol): T | undefined {
 276| |      return state.get(key) as T | undefined;
 277| |    },
 279| |    setState<T>(key: string | symbol, value: T): void {
 280| |      state.set(key, value);
 281| |    },
 282| |    json<T>(data: T, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 283| |      return Response.json(data, { status: init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200, headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_JSON, init?.headers) });
 284| |    },
 285| |    text(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 286| |      return new Response(data, { status: init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200, headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_TEXT, init?.headers) });
 287| |    },
 288| |    html(data: string, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 289| |      return new Response(data, { status: init?.status ?? set.status ?? 200, headers: mergeHeaders(HDR_HTML, init?.headers) });
 290| |    },
 291| |    redirect(url: string, status: 301 | 302 | 303 | 307 | 308 = 302): Response {
 292| |      return Response.redirect(url, status);
 293| |    },
 294| |    stream(stream: ReadableStream, init?: ResponseInit): Response {
 295| |      return new Response(stream, { status: init?.status ?? 200, headers: init?.headers });
 296| |    },
 297| |    empty(status = 204): Response {
 298| |      return new Response(null, { status });
 299| |    },
 300| |    status(code: number): Response {
 301| |      return new Response(null, { status: code });
 302| |    },
 304| |    sendFile(path: string, sendOpts: SendFileOptions = {}) {
 305| |      return sendFile(path, { req, ...sendOpts });
 306| |    },
 307|→|    proxy(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 308| |      return proxyRequest(target, proxyOpts);
 309| |    },
 310| |    forward(target: string | URL, proxyOpts: ProxyOptions = {}) {
 311| |      return forwardRequest(req, target, proxyOpts);
 312| |    },
 313|→|    cache(factory: () => Promise<Response>, cacheOpts = {}) {
 314| |      return defaultCache.getOrSet(req, factory, cacheOpts);
 315| |    },
 316| |    server: null,
 317| |  };
 319| |  return ctx;
 320| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview FLUX ENTERPRISE COMPILER v2.0 — Refactored Orchestrator
   3| | * Main entry point with small, composable pure functions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type {
   7| |  CompilerOptions,
   8| |  CompiledRoute,
   9| |  DiscoveryResult,
  10| |  AnalysisResult,
  11| |  HookDef,
  12| |  OptimizationResult,
  13| |} from "./types";
  15| |import type { Logger } from "./logger";
  16| |import { DEFAULT_OPTS } from "./types";
  17| |import { runDiscovery } from "./phases/discovery";
  18| |import { runAnalysis } from "./phases/analysis";
  19| |import { runOptimization } from "./phases/optimization";
  20| |import { runCodeGen } from "./phases/codegen";
  21| |import { runLinker } from "./phases/linker";
  22| |import { consoleLogger } from "./logger";
  23| |import { trieStats } from "./utils/trie"; // FIXED: direct import instead of require()
  25| |export { DEFAULT_OPTS };
  26| |export type { CompilerOptions, CompiledRoute };
  28| |// ============================================================================
  29| |// Options — Pure
  30| |// ============================================================================
  32| |import { defu } from "defu";
  34|▼|export const mergeOptions = (
  35| |  opts: Partial<CompilerOptions>
  36|→|): CompilerOptions => defu(opts, DEFAULT_OPTS) as CompilerOptions;
  38| |// ============================================================================
  39| |// Logging — Pure Formatters
  40| |// ============================================================================
  42|▼|export const formatBanner = (opts: CompilerOptions): string =>
  43| |  `🔥 Flux Enterprise Compiler v2.0\n` +
  44| |  `   Target: ${opts.target} | OptLevel: ${opts.optimizationLevel}\n` +
  45| |  `   Features: SIMD=${opts.enableSIMDPaths} | BranchPred=${opts.enableBranchPrediction} | DCE=${opts.enableDeadCodeElimination}`;
  47|▼|export const formatDiscoveryStats = (discovery: DiscoveryResult): string =>
  48| |  `   ${discovery.files.length} files | ${discovery.modules.length} modules`;
  50|▼|export const formatAnalysisStats = (analysis: AnalysisResult): string => {
  51| |  const staticCount = analysis.routes.filter((r) => r.isStatic).length;
  52| |  const dynamicCount = analysis.routes.filter((r) => r.isDynamic).length;
  53| |  const constantCount = analysis.routes.filter((r) => r.isConstantResponse).length;
  54| |  return `   ${analysis.routes.length} routes (${staticCount} static, ${dynamicCount} dynamic, ${constantCount} constant)`;
  55| |};
  57|▼|export const formatHooks = (hooks: ReadonlyMap<string, HookDef>): string | null =>
  58| |  hooks.size > 0 ? `   Hooks: ${[...hooks.keys()].join(", ")}` : null;
  60|▼|export const formatOptimizationStats = (optimized: OptimizationResult): string =>
  61| |  `   ${optimized.meta.inlined} inlined | ${optimized.meta.deduplicated} deduplicated\n` +
  62| |  `   Jump table: ${optimized.jumpTable.strategy} | ${optimized.jumpTable.entries.length} entries`;
  64|▼|export const formatTrieStats = (stats: {
  65| |  totalNodes: number; maxDepth: number; avgBranching: number;
  66| |}): string =>
  67| |  `   Trie: ${stats.totalNodes} nodes | depth ${stats.maxDepth} | avg branching ${stats.avgBranching.toFixed(2)}`;
  69|▼|export const formatCodegenStats = (code: string): string =>
  70| |  `   ${code.split("\n").length} lines emitted`;
  72|▼|export const formatCompletion = (elapsedMs: number, outPath: string): string =>
  73| |  `\n✅ Build complete in ${elapsedMs.toFixed(2)}ms → ${outPath}`;
  75| |// ============================================================================
  76| |// Result Factory — Pure
  77| |// ============================================================================
  79|▼|export const createCompilationResult = (
  80| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
  81| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
  82| |  elapsedMs: number
  83| |): CompiledRoute => ({
  84| |  staticRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isStatic),
  85| |  dynamicRoutes: optimized.routes.filter((r) => r.isDynamic),
  86| |  trie: optimized.trie,
  87| |  modules: analysis.modules,
  88| |  jumpTable: optimized.jumpTable,
  89| |  meta: {
  90| |    inlinedHandlers: optimized.meta.inlined,
  91| |    deduplicatedHandlers: optimized.meta.deduplicated,
  92| |    eliminatedRoutes: optimized.meta.eliminated,
  93| |    preserializedResponses: optimized.preserializedBuffers.size,
  94| |    totalCompileTime: elapsedMs,
  95| |  },
  96| |});
  98| |// ============================================================================
  99| |// Phase Runners — Pure Orchestration with Functional Composition
 100| |// ============================================================================
 102|▼|export const runDiscoveryPhase = (opts: CompilerOptions, logger: Logger): DiscoveryResult => {
 103| |  console.log("\n📡 Phase 1: Discovery");
 104| |  const result = runDiscovery(opts, logger);
 105| |  console.log(formatDiscoveryStats(result));
 106| |  return result;
 107| |};
 109|▼|export const runAnalysisPhase = (
 110| |  discovery: DiscoveryResult,
 111| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 112| |  logger: Logger
 113| |): AnalysisResult => {
 114| |  console.log("\n🔬 Phase 2: Analysis");
 115| |  const result = runAnalysis(discovery, opts, logger);
 116| |  console.log(formatAnalysisStats(result));
 117| |  const hooksStr = formatHooks(result.hooks);
 118| |  if (hooksStr) console.log(hooksStr);
 119| |  return result;
 120| |};
 122|▼|export const runOptimizationPhase = (
 123| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
 124| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 125| |  logger: Logger
 126| |): OptimizationResult => {
 127| |  console.log("\n⚡ Phase 3: Optimization");
 128| |  const result = runOptimization(analysis.routes, analysis.modules, opts, logger);
 129| |  console.log(formatOptimizationStats(result));
 130| |  const stats = trieStats(result.trie); // FIXED: direct import
 131| |  console.log(formatTrieStats(stats));
 132| |  return result;
 133| |};
 135|▼|export const runCodegenPhase = (
 136| |  optimized: OptimizationResult,
 137| |  analysis: AnalysisResult,
 138| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 139| |  logger: Logger
 140| |): string => {
 141| |  console.log("\n📝 Phase 4: Code Generation");
 142| |  const code = runCodeGen(
 143| |    optimized.routes,
 144| |    optimized.trie,
 145| |    optimized.jumpTable,
 146| |    analysis.modules,
 147| |    analysis.hooks,
 148| |    optimized.preserializedBuffers,
 149| |    opts,
 150| |    logger
 151| |  );
 152| |  console.log(formatCodegenStats(code));
 153| |  return code;
 154| |};
 156|▼|export const runLinkingPhase = (
 157| |  code: string,
 158| |  opts: CompilerOptions,
 159| |  logger: Logger
 160| |): string => {
 161| |  console.log("\n🔗 Phase 5: Linking");
 162| |  return runLinker(code, opts, logger);
 163| |};
 165| |// ============================================================================
 166| |// Compiler Class
 167| |// ============================================================================
 169|▼|export class FluxCompiler {
 170| |  private opts: CompilerOptions;
 172| |  constructor(opts: Partial<CompilerOptions> = {}) {
 173| |    this.opts = mergeOptions(opts);
 174| |  }
 176| |  compile(): CompiledRoute {
 177| |    const t0 = performance.now();
 178| |    const logger = consoleLogger();
 180| |    console.log(formatBanner(this.opts));
 182| |    // Functional pipeline: discovery → analysis → optimization → codegen → link
 183| |    const discovery = runDiscoveryPhase(this.opts, logger);
 184| |    const analysis = runAnalysisPhase(discovery, this.opts, logger);
 185| |    const optimized = runOptimizationPhase(analysis, this.opts, logger);
 186| |    const code = runCodegenPhase(optimized, analysis, this.opts, logger);
 187| |    const outPath = runLinkingPhase(code, this.opts, logger);
 189| |    const elapsed = performance.now() - t0;
 190| |    console.log(formatCompletion(elapsed, outPath));
 192| |    return createCompilationResult(optimized, analysis, elapsed);
 193| |  }
 194| |}
 196|▼|export function build(opts?: Partial<CompilerOptions>): CompiledRoute {
 197| |  return new FluxCompiler(opts).compile();
 198| |}
 200| |if (import.meta.main) {
 201| |  build();
 202| |}

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Distributed Tracing — OpenTelemetry-compatible.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7|▼|export type TraceEvent =
   8| |  | "request" | "parse" | "transform" | "beforeHandle"
   9| |  | "handle" | "afterHandle" | "mapResponse" | "afterResponse" | "error";
  11|▼|export interface TraceSpan {
  12| |  id: string;
  13| |  name: string;
  14| |  event: TraceEvent;
  15| |  begin: number;
  16| |  end?: number;
  17| |  error?: Error | null;
  18| |  attributes?: Record<string, unknown>;
  19| |  children: TraceSpan[];
  20| |}
  22|▼|export interface TraceContext {
  23| |  traceId: string;
  24| |  spans: TraceSpan[];
  25| |  startSpan(name: string, event: TraceEvent): TraceSpan;
  26| |  endSpan(span: TraceSpan, error?: Error | null): void;
  27| |}
  29| |let traceCounter = 0;
  31|▼|export const createTraceContext = (requestId: string): TraceContext => {
  32| |  const spans: TraceSpan[] = [];
  34| |  return {
  35| |    traceId: requestId,
  36| |    spans,
  37| |    startSpan(name, event) {
  38| |      const span: TraceSpan = {
  39| |        id: `${requestId}-${++traceCounter}`,
  40| |        name,
  41| |        event,
  42| |        begin: performance.now(),
  43| |        children: [],
  44| |      };
  45| |      spans.push(span);
  46| |      return span;
  47| |    },
  48| |    endSpan(span, error = null) {
  49| |      span.end = performance.now();
  50| |      span.error = error;
  51| |    },
  52| |  };
  53| |};
  55| |export const startTrace = (req: Request): { traceId: string; start: number } => {
  56| |  const traceId = req.headers.get("x-trace-id") || req.headers.get("x-request-id") || Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  57| |  return { traceId, start: performance.now() };
  58| |};
  60|▼|export const finishTrace = (
  61| |  req: Request,
  62| |  trace: { traceId: string; start: number },
  63| |  response: Response
  64| |): Response => {
  65| |  const duration = performance.now() - trace.start;
  66| |  response.headers.set("x-trace-id", trace.traceId);
  67| |  response.headers.set("x-response-time", `${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`);
  68| |  return response;
  69| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Macro System — Custom lifecycle extensions.
   3| | * Allows plugins to define custom route-level configuration.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer } from "./types";
   9|▼|export interface MacroContext {
  10| |  onRequest?: (ctx: FluxContext) => void;
  11| |  beforeHandle?: (ctx: FluxContext) => void;
  12| |  afterHandle?: (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => void;
  13| |  afterResponse?: (ctx: FluxContext, response: Response) => void;
  14| |}
  16|▼|export type MacroFn = (value: unknown, ctx: MacroContext) => void;
  18|▼|export interface MacroDefinition {
  19| |  name: string;
  20| |  fn: MacroFn;
  21| |}
  23|▼|export const createMacroRegistry = () => {
  24| |  const macros = new Map<string, MacroFn>();
  26| |  return {
  27| |    register(name: string, fn: MacroFn) {
  28| |      macros.set(name, fn);
  29| |      return this;
  30| |    },
  32| |    apply(routeConfig: Record<string, unknown>, lifecycle: LifeCycleStore): LifeCycleStore {
  33| |      const macroCtx: MacroContext = {};
  35| |      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(routeConfig)) {
  36| |        const macro = macros.get(key);
  37| |        if (macro && value !== undefined) {
  38| |          macro(value, macroCtx);
  39| |        }
  40| |      }
  42| |      // Convert macro context hooks to lifecycle hooks
  43| |      const hooks: HookContainer[] = [];
  44| |      if (macroCtx.beforeHandle) hooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.beforeHandle, scope: "local" });
  45| |      if (macroCtx.afterHandle) hooks.push({ fn: macroCtx.afterHandle, scope: "local" });
  47| |      return {
  48| |        ...lifecycle,
  49| |        beforeHandle: [...lifecycle.beforeHandle, ...hooks],
  50| |      };
  51| |    },
  53| |    has(name: string): boolean { return macros.has(name); },
  54| |    get size(): number { return macros.size; },
  55| |  };
  56| |};
  58| |// ============================================================================
  59| |// Built-in Macros
  60| |// ============================================================================
  62| |export const authMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  63| |  name: "auth",
  64| |  fn(value, ctx) {
  65| |    if (value === true) {
  66| |      ctx.beforeHandle = (c: FluxContext) => {
  67| |        if (!c.headers.get("authorization")) {
  68| |          c.setState("__halt", Response.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 }));        }
  69| |      };
  70| |    }
  71| |  },
  72| |};
  74| |export const cacheMacro: MacroDefinition = {
  75| |  name: "cache",
  76| |  fn(value, ctx) {
  77| |    if (typeof value === "number") {
  78| |      ctx.afterHandle = (_c: FluxContext, response: Response) => {
  79| |        response.headers.set("cache-control", `public, max-age=${value}`);
  80| |      };
  81| |    }
  82| |  },
  83| |};

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview WebSocket support with typed messages and topics.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { ServerWebSocket, WebSocketHandler } from "./types";
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   8|▼|export class FluxWS<Context = unknown, Body = unknown, Response = unknown> {
   9| |  constructor(
  10| |    public raw: ServerWebSocket<any>,
  11| |    public data: Context,
  12| |    public body: Body
  13| |  ) {}
  15| |  send(data: Response | string | ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array, compress?: boolean): number {
  16| |    if (typeof data === "object" && !(data instanceof ArrayBuffer) && !(data instanceof Uint8Array)) {
  17| |      return this.raw.send(JSON.stringify(data), compress);
  18| |    }
  19| |    return this.raw.send(data as any, compress);
  20| |  }
  22| |  sendText(data: string, compress?: boolean): number { return this.raw.sendText(data, compress); }
  23| |  sendBinary(data: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array, compress?: boolean): number { return this.raw.sendBinary(data, compress); }
  24| |  close(code?: number, reason?: string): void { this.raw.close(code, reason); }
  25| |  terminate(): void { this.raw.terminate(); }
  26| |  ping(data?: string | ArrayBuffer): number { return this.raw.ping(data); }
  27| |  pong(data?: string | ArrayBuffer): number { return this.raw.pong(data); }
  29| |  publish(topic: string, data: Response | string | ArrayBuffer, compress?: boolean): number {
  30| |    if (typeof data === "object" && !(data instanceof ArrayBuffer)) {
  31| |      return this.raw.publish(topic, JSON.stringify(data), compress);
  32| |    }
  33| |    return this.raw.publish(topic, data as any, compress);
  34| |  }
  36| |  subscribe(topic: string): void { this.raw.subscribe(topic); }
  37| |  unsubscribe(topic: string): void { this.raw.unsubscribe(topic); }
  38| |  isSubscribed(topic: string): boolean { return this.raw.isSubscribed(topic); }
  39| |  cork<T>(cb: (ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>) => T): T { return this.raw.cork(() => cb(this)); }
  41| |  get remoteAddress(): string { return this.raw.remoteAddress; }
  42| |  get readyState(): number { return this.raw.readyState; }
  43| |  get subscriptions(): string[] { return this.raw.subscriptions; }
  44| |}
  46|▼|export interface WSLocalHook<Context = unknown, Body = unknown, Response = unknown> {
  47| |  open?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>): void | Promise<void>;
  48| |  message?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>, message: Body): void | Promise<void>;
  49| |  drain?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>): void | Promise<void>;
  50| |  close?(ws: FluxWS<Context, Body, Response>, code: number, reason: string): void | Promise<void>;
  51| |  upgrade?: Record<string, unknown> | ((ctx: FluxContext) => unknown);
  52| |  body?: any;
  53| |  response?: any;
  54| |}
  56|▼|export const createWSHandler = <Context, Body, Response>(
  57| |  hook: WSLocalHook<Context, Body, Response>
  58| |): WebSocketHandler<Context> => ({
  59| |  open(ws) {
  60| |    hook.open?.(new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body));
  61| |  },
  63| |  message(ws, message) {
  64| |    let parsed: unknown = message;
  66| |    if (typeof message === "string") {
  67| |      try {
  68| |        parsed = JSON.parse(message);
  69| |      } catch {
  70| |        // keep as string
  71| |      }
  72| |    }
  74| |    hook.message?.(
  75| |      new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, parsed as Body),
  76| |      parsed as Body
  77| |    );
  78| |  },
  80| |  drain(ws) {
  81| |    hook.drain?.(new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body));
  82| |  },
  84| |  close(ws, code, reason) {
  85| |    hook.close?.(
  86| |      new FluxWS(ws, ws.data, undefined as Body),
  87| |      code,
  88| |      reason
  89| |    );
  90| |  },
  91| |});

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Derive & Resolve — Context enrichment pipeline.
   3| | * Composable, type-safe context extensions.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { MaybePromise } from "./types";
   9|▼|export type DeriveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  10| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  12|▼|export type ResolveFn<In extends Record<string, unknown> = {}, Out extends Record<string, unknown> = {}> =
  13| |  (ctx: FluxContext & In) => MaybePromise<Out>;
  15| |// ============================================================================
  16| |// Derive Pipeline (runs before validation)
  17| |// ============================================================================
  19|▼|export const createDerivePipeline = () => {
  20| |  const fns: DeriveFn[] = [];
  22| |  return {
  23| |    add(fn: DeriveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  25| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  26| |      let current = ctx;
  27| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  28| |        const result = await fn(current);
  29| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  30| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  31| |        }
  32| |      }
  33| |      return current;
  34| |    },
  36| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  37| |  };
  38| |};
  40| |// ============================================================================
  41| |// Resolve Pipeline (runs after validation, before handler)
  42| |// ============================================================================
  44|▼|export const createResolvePipeline = () => {
  45| |  const fns: ResolveFn[] = [];
  47| |  return {
  48| |    add(fn: ResolveFn) { fns.push(fn); return this; },
  50| |    async execute(ctx: FluxContext): Promise<FluxContext> {
  51| |      let current = ctx;
  52| |      for (const fn of fns) {
  53| |        const result = await fn(current);
  54| |        if (result && typeof result === "object") {
  55| |          Object.assign(current, result);
  56| |        }
  57| |      }
  58| |      return current;
  59| |    },
  61| |    get length() { return fns.length; },
  62| |  };
  63| |};
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Common Derive Factories
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const deriveUser = <T>(extractor: (ctx: FluxContext) => MaybePromise<T | null>) =>
  70| |  async (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ user: await extractor(ctx) });
  72|▼|export const deriveDb = <T>(factory: () => T) =>
  73| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ db: factory() });
  75|▼|export const deriveRequestId = () =>
  76| |  (ctx: FluxContext) => ({ requestId: ctx.requestId });

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Hook Execution Engine v3.0
   3| | * Composable, async middleware with scoped lifecycle.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Types
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13|▼|export type HookResult =
  14| |  | { readonly ok: true; ctx: FluxContext }
  15| |  | { readonly ok: false; response: Response };
  17|▼|export type HookFn = (ctx: FluxContext) => Promise<HookResult> | HookResult;
  19| |// ============================================================================
  20| |// Hook Constructors
  21| |// ============================================================================
  23|▼|export const continueHook = (ctx: FluxContext): HookResult => ({ ok: true, ctx });
  24|▼|export const haltHook = (response: Response): HookResult => ({ ok: false, response });
  26| |// ============================================================================
  27| |// Hook Execution
  28| |// ============================================================================
  30| |export const executeHooks = async (
  31| |  ctx: FluxContext,
  32| |  hooks: readonly HookFn[]
  33| |): Promise<{ ctx: FluxContext; halted?: Response }> => {
  34| |  let current = ctx;
  35| |  for (const hook of hooks) {
  36| |    const result = await hook(current);
  37| |    if (!result.ok) return { ctx: current, halted: result.response };
  38| |    current = result.ctx;
  39| |  }
  40| |  return { ctx: current };
  41| |};
  43| |// ============================================================================
  44| |// Hook Composition
  45| |// ============================================================================
  47|▼|export const composeHooks = (...hooks: HookFn[]): HookFn =>
  48| |  async (ctx) => {
  49| |    const result = await executeHooks(ctx, hooks);
  50| |    if (result.halted) return haltHook(result.halted);
  51| |    return continueHook(result.ctx);
  52| |  };
  54| |// ============================================================================
  55| |// Hook Filtering by Scope
  56| |// ============================================================================
  58|▼|export const filterByScope = (scope: LifeCycleType) =>
  59| |  (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  60| |    hooks.filter(h => !h.scope || h.scope === scope || h.scope === "global");
  62|▼|export const filterGlobal = (hooks: HookContainer[]): HookContainer[] =>
  63| |  hooks.filter(h => h.scope === "global" || h.scope === "scoped");
  65| |// ============================================================================
  66| |// Hook Merging (Pure)
  67| |// ============================================================================
  69|▼|export const mergeHookArrays = (
  70| |  a: HookContainer[] | undefined,
  71| |  b: HookContainer[] | undefined
  72| |): HookContainer[] => {
  73| |  if (!a && !b) return [];
  74| |  if (!a) return b!;
  75| |  if (!b) return a;
  77| |  const checksums = new Set(a.map(h => h.checksum).filter(Boolean));
  78| |  const merged = [...a];
  79| |  for (const hook of b) {
  80| |    if (hook.checksum && checksums.has(hook.checksum)) continue;
  81| |    merged.push(hook);
  82| |  }
  83| |  return merged;
  84| |};
  86| |// ============================================================================
  87| |// Async Detection
  88| |// ============================================================================
  90| |const ASYNC_RE = /async|await|\.then\(|Promise/;
  92|▼|export const isAsyncFn = (fn: Function): boolean =>
  93| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncFunction" ||
  94| |  fn.constructor.name === "AsyncGeneratorFunction" ||
  95| |  ASYNC_RE.test(fn.toString().slice(0, 200));
  97| |// ============================================================================
  98| |// Higher-Order Hook Factories
  99| |// ============================================================================
 101|▼|export const withTiming = (name: string, hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 102| |  async (ctx) => {
 103| |    const start = performance.now();
 104| |    const result = await hook(ctx);
 105| |    ctx.setState(`__timing_${name}`, performance.now() - start);
 106| |    return result;
 107| |  };
 109|▼|export const withErrorBoundary = (fallback: (err: Error) => Response) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 110| |  async (ctx) => {
 111| |    try { return await hook(ctx); }
 112|!|    catch (err) { return haltHook(fallback(err as Error)); }
 113| |  };
 115|▼|export const conditional = (predicate: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean) => (hook: HookFn): HookFn =>
 116| |  (ctx) => predicate(ctx) ? hook(ctx) : continueHook(ctx);

>src/core/guard.ts

---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Guard — Scoped hook application.
   3| | * Apply hooks to a group of routes with proper scoping.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { LifeCycleStore, HookContainer, LifeCycleType } from "./types";
   7| |import { EMPTY_LIFECYCLE } from "./types";
   8| |import { mergeHookArrays } from "./hooks";
  10|▼|export interface GuardOptions {
  11| |  scope?: LifeCycleType;
  12| |  beforeHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  13| |  afterHandle?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  14| |  transform?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  15| |  error?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  16| |  onRequest?: HookContainer | HookContainer[];
  17| |}
  19|▼|export const createGuard = (options: GuardOptions = {}) => {
  20| |  const scope = options.scope ?? "scoped";
  22|▼|  const toContainers = (hooks: HookContainer | HookContainer[] | undefined): HookContainer[] => {
  23| |    if (!hooks) return [];
  24| |    const arr = Array.isArray(hooks) ? hooks : [hooks];
  25| |    return arr.map(h => ({ ...h, scope: h.scope ?? scope }));
  26| |  };
  28| |  const guardHooks: Partial<LifeCycleStore> = {
  29| |    beforeHandle: toContainers(options.beforeHandle),
  30| |    afterHandle: toContainers(options.afterHandle),
  31| |    transform: toContainers(options.transform),
  32| |    error: toContainers(options.error),
  33| |    request: toContainers(options.onRequest),
  34| |  };
  36| |  return {
  37| |    scope,
  38| |    hooks: guardHooks,
  40| |    applyTo(lifecycle: LifeCycleStore): LifeCycleStore {
  41| |      return {
  42| |        ...lifecycle,
  43| |        beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.beforeHandle, guardHooks.beforeHandle),
  44| |        afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.afterHandle, guardHooks.afterHandle),
  45| |        transform: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.transform, guardHooks.transform),
  46| |        error: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.error, guardHooks.error),
  47| |        request: mergeHookArrays(lifecycle.request, guardHooks.request),
  48| |      };
  49| |    },
  50| |  };
  51| |};
  53|▼|export const mergeLifeCycle = (a: LifeCycleStore, b: Partial<LifeCycleStore>): LifeCycleStore => ({
  54| |  start: mergeHookArrays(a.start, b.start),
  55| |  request: mergeHookArrays(a.request, b.request),
  56| |  parse: mergeHookArrays(a.parse, b.parse),
  57| |  transform: mergeHookArrays(a.transform, b.transform),
  58| |  beforeHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.beforeHandle, b.beforeHandle),
  59| |  afterHandle: mergeHookArrays(a.afterHandle, b.afterHandle),
  60| |  mapResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.mapResponse, b.mapResponse),
  61| |  afterResponse: mergeHookArrays(a.afterResponse, b.afterResponse),
  62| |  trace: mergeHookArrays(a.trace, b.trace),
  63| |  error: mergeHookArrays(a.error, b.error),
  64| |  stop: mergeHookArrays(a.stop, b.stop),
  65| |});

>src/core/plugin.ts
l:./context|./hooks

t:MaybePromise
t:PluginContext
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Plugin Architecture v3.0
   3| | * Lifecycle hooks, extensibility, composable plugins.
   4| | */
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "./context";
   7| |import type { HookFn } from "./hooks";
   9| |// ============================================================================
  10| |// Plugin Interface
  11| |// ============================================================================
  13|▼|export interface FluxPlugin {
  14| |  readonly name: string;
  15| |  readonly version?: string;
  17| |  // Lifecycle
  18| |  init?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  19| |  close?(): MaybePromise<void>;
  21| |  // Request lifecycle
  22| |  onRequest?(ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<FluxContext | Response>;
  23| |  onResponse?(ctx: FluxContext, response: Response): MaybePromise<Response>;
  24| |  onError?(error: Error, ctx: FluxContext): MaybePromise<Response | void>;
  25| |}
  27|▼|type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
  29| |// ============================================================================
  30| |// Plugin Registry
  31| |// ============================================================================
  33|▼|export interface PluginContext {
  34| |  plugins: FluxPlugin[];
  35| |  hooks: Map<string, HookFn[]>;
  36| |  addHook(name: string, hook: HookFn): void;
  37| |  getHooks(name: string): readonly HookFn[];
  38| |  register(plugin: FluxPlugin): void;
  39| |  initAll(): Promise<void>;
  40| |  closeAll(): Promise<void>;
  41| |}
  43|▼|export const createPluginContext = (): PluginContext => {
  44| |  const hooks = new Map<string, HookFn[]>();
  45| |  const plugins: FluxPlugin[] = [];
  47| |  return {
  48| |    plugins,
  49| |    hooks,
  50| |    addHook(name, hook) {
  51| |      const existing = hooks.get(name) ?? [];
  52| |      existing.push(hook);
  53| |      hooks.set(name, existing);
  54| |    },
  55| |    getHooks(name) { return hooks.get(name) ?? []; },
  56| |    register(plugin) { plugins.push(plugin); },
  57| |    async initAll() {
  58| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.();
  59| |    },
  60| |    async closeAll() {
  61| |      for (const p of plugins) await p.close?.();
  62| |    },
  63| |  };
  64| |};
  66| |// ============================================================================
  67| |// Plugin Composition
  68| |// ============================================================================
  70|▼|export const composePlugins = (...plugins: FluxPlugin[]): FluxPlugin => ({
  71| |  name: plugins.map(p => p.name).join("+"),
  72| |  async init() { for (const p of plugins) await p.init?.(); },
  73| |  async close() { for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) await p.close?.(); },
  74| |  async onRequest(ctx) {
  75| |    let current = ctx;
  76| |    for (const p of plugins) {
  77| |      const result = await p.onRequest?.(current);
  78| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
  79| |      if (result) current = result;
  80| |    }
  81| |    return current;
  82| |  },
  83| |  async onResponse(ctx, response) {
  84| |    let current = response;
  85| |    for (const p of [...plugins].reverse()) {
  86| |      current = await p.onResponse?.(ctx, current) ?? current;
  87| |    }
  88| |    return current;
  89| |  },
  90| |  async onError(error, ctx) {
  91| |    for (const p of plugins) {
  92| |      const result = await p.onError?.(error, ctx);
  93| |      if (result instanceof Response) return result;
  94| |    }
  95| |  },
  96| |});

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Logger Plugin — pino-based structured logging.
   3| | */
   5| |import pino, { type Logger as PinoLogger } from "pino";
   6| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   7| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
   9|▼|export interface LoggerOptions {
  10| |  level?: string;
  11| |  logger?: PinoLogger;
  12| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  13| |}
  15|▼|export const logger = (options: LoggerOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  16| |  const log =
  17| |    options.logger ??
  18|→|    pino({
  19| |      level: options.level ?? "info",
  20| |      base: undefined,
  21| |    });
  23| |  return {
  24| |    name: "logger",
  26| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  27| |      if (options.skip?.(ctx)) return response;
  29| |      const duration = performance.now() - ctx.startTime;
  31| |      const payload = {
  32| |        requestId: ctx.requestId,
  33| |        method: ctx.method,
  34| |        path: ctx.path,
  35| |        status: response.status,
  36| |        durationMs: Math.round(duration * 1000) / 1000,
  37| |        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  38| |      };
  40| |      if (response.status >= 500) {
  41| |        log.error(payload);
  42| |      } else if (response.status >= 400) {
  43| |        log.warn(payload);
  44| |      } else {
  45| |        log.info(payload);
  46| |      }
  48| |      return response;
  49| |    },
  50| |  };
  51| |};

>src/core/plugins/cors.ts
l:../plugin|../context
e:CorsOptions|cors
f:cors(options: CorsOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext):boolean
f:setCorsHeaders(ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers):void
t:CorsOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview CORS Plugin — Production-grade cross-origin handling.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
   8|▼|export interface CorsOptions {
   9| |  origin?: string | string[] | ((origin: string, ctx: FluxContext) => boolean);
  10| |  methods?: string[];
  11| |  allowedHeaders?: string[];
  12| |  exposedHeaders?: string[];
  13| |  credentials?: boolean;
  14| |  maxAge?: number;
  15| |  preflightContinue?: boolean;
  16| |}
  18| |const DEFAULT_METHODS = ["GET", "HEAD", "PUT", "PATCH", "POST", "DELETE"];
  20|▼|export const cors = (options: CorsOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  21| |  const {
  22| |    origin = "*",
  23| |    methods = DEFAULT_METHODS,
  24| |    allowedHeaders,
  25| |    exposedHeaders,
  26| |    credentials = false,
  27| |    maxAge = 86400,
  28| |    preflightContinue = false,
  29| |  } = options;
  31|▼|  const isOriginAllowed = (requestOrigin: string, ctx: FluxContext): boolean => {
  32| |    if (origin === "*") return true;
  33| |    if (typeof origin === "string") return origin === requestOrigin;
  34| |    if (Array.isArray(origin)) return origin.includes(requestOrigin);
  35| |    return origin(requestOrigin, ctx);
  36| |  };
  38|▼|  const setCorsHeaders = (ctx: FluxContext, headers: Headers): void => {
  39| |    const requestOrigin = ctx.headers.get("origin") || "";
  40| |    if (!requestOrigin) return;
  42| |    if (isOriginAllowed(requestOrigin, ctx)) {
  43| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", requestOrigin);
  44| |    } else if (origin === "*") {
  45| |      headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  46| |    }
  47| |    if (credentials) headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true");
  48| |    if (exposedHeaders?.length) headers.set("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", exposedHeaders.join(", "));
  49| |  };
  51| |  return {
  52| |    name: "cors",
  53| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  54| |      if (!ctx.headers.get("origin")) return ctx;
  56| |      if (ctx.method === "OPTIONS") {
  57| |        const headers = new Headers();
  58| |        setCorsHeaders(ctx, headers);
  59| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", methods.join(", "));
  60| |        if (allowedHeaders?.length) headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", allowedHeaders.join(", "));
  61| |        else {
  62| |          const reqHeaders = ctx.headers.get("access-control-request-headers");
  63| |          if (reqHeaders) headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", reqHeaders);
  64| |        }
  65| |        headers.set("Access-Control-Max-Age", String(maxAge));
  66| |        if (preflightContinue) return ctx;
  67| |        return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
  68| |      }
  69| |      return ctx;
  70| |    },
  71| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  72| |      setCorsHeaders(ctx, response.headers);
  73| |      return response;
  74| |    },
  75| |  };
  76| |};
---

   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Security Headers Plugin — Defense in depth.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   7|▼|export interface SecurityOptions {
   8| |  contentSecurityPolicy?: string | false;
   9| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy?: string | false;
  10| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy?: string | false;
  11| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy?: string | false;
  12| |  frameguard?: { action: "deny" | "sameorigin" } | false;
  13| |  hidePoweredBy?: boolean;
  14| |  hsts?: { maxAge?: number; includeSubDomains?: boolean; preload?: boolean } | false;
  15| |  noSniff?: boolean;
  16| |  referrerPolicy?: string | false;
  17| |  xssFilter?: boolean;
  18| |}
  20| |const DEFAULTS: SecurityOptions = {
  21| |  contentSecurityPolicy: "default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; font-src 'self' https: data:; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https: 'unsafe-inline'",
  22| |  crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: "require-corp",
  23| |  crossOriginOpenerPolicy: "same-origin",
  24| |  crossOriginResourcePolicy: "same-origin",
  25| |  frameguard: { action: "deny" },
  26| |  hidePoweredBy: true,
  27| |  hsts: { maxAge: 15552000, includeSubDomains: true, preload: true },
  28| |  noSniff: true,
  29| |  referrerPolicy: "no-referrer",
  30| |  xssFilter: true,
  31| |};
  33|▼|export const security = (options: SecurityOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  34| |  const opts = { ...DEFAULTS, ...options };
  36| |  return {
  37| |    name: "security",
  38| |    onResponse(_ctx, response) {
  39| |      const h = response.headers;
  40| |      if (opts.contentSecurityPolicy) h.set("Content-Security-Policy", opts.contentSecurityPolicy);
  41| |      if (opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy) h.set("Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy", opts.crossOriginEmbedderPolicy);
  42| |      if (opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy) h.set("Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy", opts.crossOriginOpenerPolicy);
  43| |      if (opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy) h.set("Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy", opts.crossOriginResourcePolicy);
  44| |      if (opts.frameguard) h.set("X-Frame-Options", opts.frameguard.action.toUpperCase());
  45| |      if (opts.hidePoweredBy) h.delete("X-Powered-By");
  46| |      if (opts.hsts) {
  47| |        let val = `max-age=${opts.hsts.maxAge ?? 15552000}`;
  48| |        if (opts.hsts.includeSubDomains) val += "; includeSubDomains";
  49| |        if (opts.hsts.preload) val += "; preload";
  50| |        h.set("Strict-Transport-Security", val);
  51| |      }
  52| |      if (opts.noSniff) h.set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
  53| |      if (opts.referrerPolicy) h.set("Referrer-Policy", opts.referrerPolicy);
  54| |      if (opts.xssFilter) h.set("X-XSS-Protection", "0");
  55| |      return response;
  56| |    },
  57| |  };
  58| |};

>src/core/plugins/ratelimit.ts

f:rateLimit(options: RateLimitOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
f:getHeaders(entry: WindowEntry):Record<string, string>
t:RateLimitOptions
t:WindowEntry
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Rate Limit Plugin — memory-backed, LRU-based.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   6| |import type { FluxContext } from "../context";
   7| |import { LRUCache } from "../lru";
   9|▼|export interface RateLimitOptions {
  10| |  windowMs?: number;
  11| |  maxRequests?: number;
  12| |  storeMax?: number;
  13| |  keyGenerator?: (ctx: FluxContext) => string;
  14| |  skip?: (ctx: FluxContext) => boolean;
  15| |  message?: string;
  16| |}
  18|▼|interface WindowEntry {
  19| |  count: number;
  20| |  resetTime: number;
  21| |}
  23|▼|export const rateLimit = (options: RateLimitOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  24| |  const {
  25| |    windowMs = 60_000,
  26| |    maxRequests = 100,
  27| |    storeMax = 10_000,
  28| |    keyGenerator = (ctx) =>
  29| |      ctx.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") ||
  30| |      ctx.headers.get("x-real-ip") ||
  31| |      "anonymous",
  32| |    skip,
  33| |    message = "Too many requests",
  34| |  } = options;
  36| |  const store = new LRUCache<string, WindowEntry>({
  37| |    max: storeMax,
  38| |    ttlMs: windowMs,
  39| |  });
  41|▼|  const getHeaders = (entry: WindowEntry): Record<string, string> => ({
  42| |    "X-RateLimit-Limit": String(maxRequests),
  43| |    "X-RateLimit-Remaining": String(Math.max(0, maxRequests - entry.count)),
  44| |    "X-RateLimit-Reset": String(Math.ceil(entry.resetTime / 1000)),
  45| |  });
  47| |  return {
  48| |    name: "rateLimit",
  50| |    onRequest(ctx) {
  51| |      if (skip?.(ctx)) return ctx;
  53| |      const key = keyGenerator(ctx);
  54| |      const now = Date.now();
  56| |      let entry = store.get(key);
  58| |      if (!entry || entry.resetTime <= now) {
  59| |        entry = { count: 0, resetTime: now + windowMs };
  60| |        store.set(key, entry, { ttlMs: windowMs });
  61| |      }
  63| |      entry.count++;
  65| |      store.set(key, entry, {
  66| |        ttlMs: Math.max(0, entry.resetTime - now),
  67| |      });
  69| |      if (entry.count > maxRequests) {
  70| |        return Response.json(
  71| |          { error: message },
  72| |          {
  73| |            status: 429,
  74| |            headers: {
  75| |              "content-type": "application/json",
  76| |              ...getHeaders(entry),
  77| |            },
  78| |          }
  79| |        );
  80| |      }
  82| |      ctx.setState("__ratelimit", entry);
  83| |      return ctx;
  84| |    },
  86| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  87| |      const entry = ctx.getState<WindowEntry>("__ratelimit");
  89| |      if (entry) {
  90| |        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(getHeaders(entry))) {
  91| |          response.headers.set(k, v);
  92| |        }
  93| |      }
  95| |      return response;
  96| |    },
  97| |  };
  98| |};
---

>src/core/plugins/compression.ts
l:../plugin
e:CompressionOptions|compression
f:shouldCompress(ct: string):boolean
f:compression(options: CompressionOptions = {}):FluxPlugin
t:CompressionOptions
---
   1| |/**
   2| | * @fileoverview Compression Plugin — real gzip/deflate compression.
   3| | */
   5| |import type { FluxPlugin } from "../plugin";
   7|▼|export interface CompressionOptions {
   8| |  threshold?: number;
   9| |  filter?: (contentType: string) => boolean;
  10| |}
  12| |const COMPRESSIBLE = new Set([
  13| |  "text/",
  14| |  "application/json",
  15| |  "application/javascript",
  16| |  "application/xml",
  17| |  "image/svg+xml",
  18| |]);
  20|▼|const shouldCompress = (ct: string): boolean => {
  21| |  for (const prefix of COMPRESSIBLE) {
  22| |    if (ct.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
  23| |  }
  24| |  return false;
  25| |};
  27|▼|export const compression = (options: CompressionOptions = {}): FluxPlugin => {
  28| |  const { threshold = 1024, filter = shouldCompress } = options;
  30| |  return {
  31| |    name: "compression",
  33| |    onResponse(ctx, response) {
  34| |      if (!response.body) return response;
  35| |      if (response.headers.get("content-encoding")) return response;
  37| |      const ct = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  38| |      if (!filter(ct)) return response;
  40| |      const len = Number(response.headers.get("content-length") || "0");
  41| |      if (len && len < threshold) return response;
  43| |      const acceptEncoding = ctx.headers.get("accept-encoding") || "";
  45| |      const encoding = acceptEncoding.includes("gzip")
  46| |        ? "gzip"
  47| |        : acceptEncoding.includes("deflate")
  48| |          ? "deflate"
  49| |          : null;
  51| |      if (!encoding) return response;
  53| |      const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  54| |      headers.set("content-encoding", encoding);
  55| |      headers.delete("content-length");
  57| |      const compressed = response.body.pipeThrough(
  58| |        new CompressionStream(encoding)
  59| |      );
  61| |      return new Response(compressed, {
  62| |        status: response.status,
  63| |        statusText: response.statusText,
  64| |        headers,
  65| |      });
  66| |    },
  67| |  };
  68| |};
